summary.core_problem: 这篇工作盯住的不是“如何再造一批更好的偏好数据”，而是一个更基础的问题：现有 DPO 类目标在训练 MLLM 抗幻觉时，是否真的学会了利用额外上下文来增强对正确回答的偏好。论文给出的结论是否定的。作者把这种现象称为 context blindness：即便输入里加入了有助于 grounding 的上下文，标准 DPO 的优化形式也不会显式奖励“有上下文时偏好边际更大”，因此模型学到的偏好常常对上下文不敏感。这一点直接关系到 object hallucination，因为很多幻觉并不是模型不会比较好坏回答，而是它没有把视觉或补充文本上下文真正纳入偏好判断。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究本身，它不是基础预训练 recipe 的论文，而是 post-train 对齐目标的诊断与修正工作。但它有两个值得重视的点。第一，它把 DPO 类方法里一个常被忽略的结构性缺陷讲清楚了：pairwise preference loss 只在单一输入条件下拉开 chosen/rejected 的 margin，不会自动鼓励“信息更多时 margin 应更大”。这个观察对多模态对齐、事实性对齐，甚至文本 LLM 的 grounded preference learning 都有参考价值。第二，它提出的 CPG 把“模型是否真的利用上下文”从定性判断变成了可测量量，因而不只是一个新 loss，也是一种训练诊断工具。贡献量级更像是对 DPO 目标函数的有针对性修补，而不是范式替换；但问题抓得准，结论也比较可迁移。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分两层。第一层是诊断指标 Contextual Preference Gain, CPG。它衡量同一对回答在“无额外上下文”和“有额外有帮助上下文”两种条件下，模型偏好边际提升了多少。这里的偏好边际沿用 DPO/BT 框架里的 chosen 与 rejected 的相对 reward 或 log-prob gap。若模型真的会利用上下文，那么加入 grounding context 后，正确回答相对错误回答的优势应更明显，CPG 应为正且足够大。作者用这个指标发现：CPG 与 hallucination rate 强负相关，但标准 DPO、以及一些变体的 CPG 分布都集中在 0 附近，说明它们学到的偏好几乎不随上下文增强而增强。

第二层是 C²-DPO。核心做法是在原有 preference objective 之外，加一个 calibration term，显式要求“带上下文时的偏好 margin”大于“无上下文时的偏好 margin”。这样训练信号不再只是 chosen 胜过 rejected，而是进一步要求模型把额外上下文转化为更强的偏好证据。这个设计和普通 DPO 的区别不在于换了 reward parameterization，而在于把 context sensitivity 直接写进目标函数。论文还强调该项可以较平滑地嫁接到 SimPO、RDPO 等变体上，说明它更像一个通用校准项，而不是依赖某个特定 DPO 实现。

从机制上看，这个方法适合处理“正确答案需要 grounding 才能成立”的场景。若 chosen/rejected 在无上下文时已经容易区分，C²-DPO 的增益可能有限；但在视觉细节、事实补充、外部证据这类场景里，它会更自然，因为这些任务的关键不是静态偏好，而是条件化偏好随证据增强而增强。
summary.experiments:
实验主线比较清楚。首先，作者验证 CPG 的诊断价值：更高的 CPG 对应更低的 hallucination rate，这为后续方法提供了因果上较合理的优化方向。其次，在多模态抗幻觉 benchmark 上，C²-DPO 相比基线 DPO 明显降低幻觉。文中给出的代表性结果是：在 Object HalBench 上，response-level hallucination rate 下降 36%，mention-level 下降 60%；在 HallusionBench 上也有一致改善。第三，作者检查了副作用，发现 ScienceQA、MM-Vet、TextVQA 等通用多模态理解任务没有明显退化，说明它不是靠保守回答或压缩输出换来的抗幻觉。

另外两个实验点也值得看。其一，方法可扩展到 SimPO、RDPO，说明收益不依赖某个单一 preference loss。其二，作者还做了 text-only 设置，发现 context-aware preference calibration 对 factual alignment 也有帮助，这一点说明“上下文盲”不是 MLLM 独有问题，而是 DPO 类目标的更一般缺陷。

从你给出的全文片段里，没有看到更细的模型规模、训练样本数、β 或 calibration 系数等完整表格，因此没法安全补具体超参数字。阅读时建议重点核对主表、CPG 分布图、以及不同 DPO 变体上的一致性结果，确认收益是否稳定而非个别 benchmark 偶然。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，但有两个部分值得认真看。第一是引言和方法前半段，作者对“为什么标准 DPO 不会自然学到 context gain”的论证比较关键。要看清楚它不是在说 DPO 完全不能利用上下文，而是在说目标函数没有显式奖励 richer-context margin increase，所以这种能力学得不稳、也不充分。第二是 CPG 定义和相关性实验。若你做对齐或偏好建模，这部分比具体 loss 更有复用价值，因为它提供了一个检查模型是否真正使用证据的诊断视角。

实验部分建议优先看三类表：Object HalBench/HallusionBench 主结果，通用能力保持结果，以及把 calibration 项接到 SimPO/RDPO 上的迁移结果。若时间有限，30 到 40 分钟足够抓住主线；若要判断能否迁到文本 factuality 或 RAG preference setting，再补看 text-only 实验和附录里的 loss 细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a sharper question than “can better preference data reduce hallucination?” It asks whether DPO-style training actually learns to use additional grounding context when deciding which response should be preferred. The answer is largely no. The authors call this context blindness: standard DPO increases the preference margin between chosen and rejected responses under a fixed input, but it does not explicitly reward the margin becoming larger when more helpful context is provided. For object hallucination in MLLMs, this matters because the failure is often not simple ranking failure; it is failure to condition preference strength on visual or textual evidence.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense. It is a post-training alignment paper with direct relevance to grounded modeling. Its value comes from two places. First, it isolates a structural limitation in DPO-like objectives rather than attributing hallucination only to data quality. That diagnosis is useful beyond this benchmark setting, including multimodal alignment, factuality alignment, and any preference setup where evidence should sharpen the model’s confidence. Second, the proposed Contextual Preference Gain (CPG) turns “does the model really use context?” into a measurable quantity. So the contribution is not only a modified loss, but also a diagnostic tool. The scale of contribution is best viewed as a targeted correction to DPO objectives, not a new paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has two layers. The first is the diagnostic metric, Contextual Preference Gain (CPG). For the same response pair, the model is evaluated with and without additional helpful context. CPG measures how much the preference margin increases once that context is added. The margin follows the usual DPO or Bradley-Terry view, based on the relative reward or log-probability gap between preferred and dispreferred responses. If a model truly leverages context, the correct response should become more strongly preferred when grounding information is available, so CPG should be positive and meaningfully large. Empirically, the authors show that higher CPG is strongly associated with lower hallucination, while standard DPO and several variants produce CPG distributions concentrated near zero.

The second layer is C²-DPO. On top of the original preference objective, the authors add a calibration term that explicitly rewards the preference margin under enriched context being larger than the margin without that context. This is the key difference from vanilla DPO. The change is not about a new reward parameterization; it is about writing context sensitivity directly into the optimization target. The same idea is also attached to SimPO and RDPO, which suggests that the proposal is a fairly general calibration add-on rather than a method tied to one specific DPO implementation.

Mechanistically, the method is well matched to settings where the preferred answer is only clearly preferred once grounding evidence is present. If chosen and rejected responses are already easy to separate without extra context, the gain may be limited. But for visual grounding, factual evidence, and other evidence-conditioned preference tasks, the objective is well aligned with the failure mode.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental story is straightforward. First, the paper validates CPG as a diagnostic: models with higher CPG consistently show lower hallucination rates. That gives the proposed optimization direction a credible empirical basis. Second, C²-DPO reduces hallucination on multimodal benchmarks by a clear margin. The headline numbers reported in the paper are a 36% reduction in response-level hallucination rate and a 60% reduction in mention-level hallucination rate on Object HalBench, with consistent gains on HallusionBench as well. Third, the paper checks whether this comes at the cost of general multimodal ability and reports that performance on ScienceQA, MM-Vet, and TextVQA is preserved.

Two additional results are worth noting. The calibration idea transfers to SimPO and RDPO, which supports the claim that the issue is objective-level rather than implementation-specific. The authors also test a text-only setting and find improved factual alignment there too, suggesting that context blindness is a broader weakness of DPO-style training, not only a multimodal problem.

The provided full-content excerpt does not include the complete hyperparameter tables or all model-scale details, so I would not infer exact training sizes beyond the benchmark-level results already stated. When reading the paper, the main tables to verify are the CPG correlation plots, the hallucination benchmarks, and the cross-objective transfer results.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper, but two parts deserve closer attention. First, read the motivation and the early method section carefully. The important claim is not that DPO cannot use context at all; it is that the objective does not explicitly reward larger preference gains under richer context, so context use is weak and unreliable. Second, focus on the definition of CPG and the correlation analysis. If you work on alignment or preference modeling, that diagnostic may be more reusable than the specific loss.

In the experiments, prioritize three groups of results: the main Object HalBench and HallusionBench tables, the capability-retention tables on general multimodal benchmarks, and the results where the calibration term is added to SimPO or RDPO. If time is limited, 30 to 40 minutes should be enough to capture the main idea. If you want to assess transfer to text factuality or retrieval-grounded preference learning, then also read the text-only experiments and the appendix for the exact loss construction.

recommendation.zh: 读 CPG 定义和 ablation 即可；它提醒偏好数据加上下文不等于训练信号真的依赖上下文。
recommendation.en: Read the CPG definition and ablations; the useful warning is that contextual preference data does not imply context-dependent training signal.

paper.title: Conformity Mitigations in Large Language Models Lie on a Single Resistance-Receptivity Frontier
paper.abstract: Recent advances in language models have enabled collaborative settings in which multiple models leverage one another's capabilities, iteratively improving, transforming, and extending each other's outputs. Each agent sees what the others assert before it answers, so peer opinion competes with the model's own parametric knowledge, and a wrong majority can overturn an answer the model would otherwise get right. We measure that displacement in 23 open-weight models, 19 conditions, and three dataset

summary.core_problem: 多模型协作场景下，LLM 会像人一样出现从众效应：面对一致但错误的同伴意见，模型会推翻自己原本正确的答案。已有缓解方法主要关注“抗从众”这一个维度，忽略了另一个方向——模型在自己答错时，能否正确采纳同伴的正确意见。论文要回答的是：现有缓解方法到底是真的提升了模型对同伴意见的判别能力，还是只是在“固执”和“盲从”之间做了一个刚性的权衡。
summary.importance: 对预训练和对齐研究的直接启发在于：模型在多轮交互、多智能体辩论、自我一致性等依赖“参考自身/他人输出再决策”的场景中，参数化知识与外部断言之间的竞争是一个基本行为。论文给出的结论——prompt 级 mitigation 只能沿一条 resistance–receptivity 权衡线滑动，不能同时提升两端——解释了为什么很多“抗从众”prompt 技巧只是在调偏置，而没有提供新信息。这对评估 RL/对齐数据中“参考他人意见”类样本的训练信号质量有参考价值，也提示后训练若想突破这条 frontier，必须注入可验证的中间推理，而不是改写指令措辞。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在 23 个开放权重指令模型（14B–70B，覆盖 dense、MoE、SSM 混合架构，19 个模型族）上构造了严格受控的 peer 脚本：先让模型独立答题，再让它在“同伴一致给出不同答案”的条件下重新回答。对每个问题分别构造两种池：模型原答对的 resist 池（同伴给错误答案，测 resistance），和模型原答错的 adopt 池（同伴给正确答案，测 receptivity）。测试了六类缓解方法，包括已有文献中的 anchored reconsideration 类提示，以及额外加入的“先推理再回答”deliberative 条件。核心分析是把每个方法投到 resistance–receptivity 平面上，检验其是否落在同一条向下倾斜的 frontier 上。
summary.experiments: 平均来看，一致错误多数派会让模型推翻 22.8% 的 MMLU 正确答案、54.8% 的 GPQA 正确答案、71.0% 的 SimpleQA 正确答案；被推翻的答案中 84–89% 直接改为同伴给出的错误答案，而不是随机漂移。六种 snap 类 mitigation（即时作答条件下的提示/校准方法）在三个数据集、23 个模型上几乎全部落在同一条 resistance–receptivity 向下曲线上：提升抗从众的同时，对称地损失采纳正确同伴意见的能力，二者是零和权衡。只有“先写推导再作答”这一 deliberative 条件在 MMLU 这类模型能够可靠产生推导的子集上，同时提升了 resistance 和 receptivity，突破了 frontier；在 GPQA、SimpleQA 这类推导不可靠的题上，它又退回到与其它方法同一条线上。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点看引言中对 resist/adopt 双池的定义、Figure 1（frontier 的直观示意）、以及 deliberative 条件与 snap 条件的对比部分。可以跳过具体模型列表和各模型单独的散点细节。预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。真正值得带走的结论只有一个：没有新增可验证信息的 mitigation 只是在调权衡，不能无代价地提升判断质量。

summary_en.core_problem: When LLMs operate in multi-agent or collaborative settings, unanimous peer opinions can override a model's own parametric knowledge, causing it to abandon originally correct answers. Existing mitigations focus on reducing conformity to incorrect peers, but they ignore the symmetric cost: a model that becomes more stubborn also loses the ability to adopt correct peer answers when it itself is wrong. The paper asks whether these mitigations genuinely improve discrimination between good and bad peer advice, or merely slide along a hard trade-off between resistance and receptivity.
summary_en.importance: The finding is relevant to pretrain and post-train researchers because many modern training and inference setups — multi-agent debate, self-consistency, revision-style RL, critique-and-revise SFT data — rely on the model re-reading outputs produced by itself or others. The central result, that prompt-level interventions move along a single resistance–receptivity frontier rather than improving both sides at once, explains why many conformity-mitigation prompts are just reweighting a binary lean between 'trust me' and 'trust them' rather than adding information. It also clarifies what a training signal must provide to beat that frontier: a third, independently verifiable object such as a chain of derivation, not just reworded instructions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors run a controlled peer-pressure protocol on 23 open-weight instruction-tuned models spanning 14B–70B parameters, covering dense, MoE, and hybrid SSM architectures from 19 model families. Each model first answers alone; it is then re-queried with a script in which peer models unanimously assert a different answer. Two pools are constructed per model from the solo run: a resist pool where the model was originally correct and peers assert a wrong answer (measuring resistance), and an adopt pool where the model was originally wrong and peers assert the correct answer (measuring receptivity). Six mitigation methods, including previously proposed anchored-reconsideration style prompts, are evaluated. A separate deliberative condition asks the model to produce a derivation before answering, giving it access to a third, internally generated object that is not a copy of the peer answer.
summary_en.experiments: On average, a unanimous wrong majority flips 22.8% of correct MMLU answers, 54.8% of correct GPQA answers, and 71.0% of correct SimpleQA answers. Of those flipped answers, 84–89% land exactly on the peer response rather than scattering, indicating genuine answer replacement rather than mere confidence erosion. All six snap-answer mitigations lie on a single downward-sloping resistance–receptivity line across datasets and across nearly every model individually: gains in resistance come at symmetric cost to receptivity. The deliberative condition is the only intervention that lifts above the frontier, and only on MMLU subsets where the model's own derivations are reliable; on GPQA and SimpleQA, where derivations are often unreliable, it falls back onto the same line.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on the definition of the resist vs. adopt pools in the introduction, Figure 1 for the frontier visual, and the contrast between snap conditions and the deliberative condition. The per-model scatter plots and full model inventory can be skipped. Reading time: about 20–30 minutes. The durable takeaway is that any mitigation that does not introduce new verifiable evidence only moves along a trade-off curve.

recommendation.zh: 量化了 LLM 的“从众”幻觉，对多 Agent 系统的鲁棒性分析有价值，关注 Fig 1 的 Resistance-Receptivity 前沿即可。
recommendation.en: Quantifies the 'conformity' hallucination of LLMs, valuable for robustness analysis of multi-agent systems; just check the Resistance-Receptivity frontier in Fig 1.

paper.title: Do LLM Recommenders Know When They're Hallucinating? Auditing Confidence Calibration in Catalog Faithfulness
paper.abstract: LLM recommenders for top-$K$ item suggestion regularly emit titles outside the target catalog. Prior audits measure this as a binary out-of-domain rate; none ask whether the model knew it was hallucinating. We jointly audit hallucination rate (OOD@10) and verbalized-confidence calibration (ECE, Brier, reliability) for four zero-shot LLM recommenders from four independent vendors (Mistral Large, Llama-3.3-70B, GPT-OSS-120B, Claude Sonnet 4.6), not grounded or fine-tuned systems, across three cata

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM推荐器审计仅测量二元域外幻觉率，未评估模型是否知晓自身幻觉，即置信度校准与目录忠实性的关联问题。
summary.importance: 首次联合审计LLM推荐器的幻觉率与言语化置信度校准，发现系统性置信度低估现象，属于幻觉行为分析类贡献。
summary.technical_approach: 选取4家独立厂商的零样本LLM推荐器，在3个不同规模的目录数据集上按物品流行度分层，同时测量OOD@10幻觉率与ECE、Brier分数等校准指标。
summary.experiments: 4个模型（Mistral Large、Llama-3.3-70B、GPT-OSS-120B、Claude Sonnet 4.6），3个数据集（MovieLens-25M、Amazon Toys、Yelp）；幻觉率依目录从0%到8.4%不等，即使0幻觉时ECE最高达0.223，所有模型均系统低估置信度（准确率92-100%时仅给出67-86分置信度）。
summary.authors_note: Amazon.com LLC Seattle团队

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM recommender audits only measure binary out-of-domain hallucination rate, without evaluating whether models know they are hallucinating — the relationship between confidence calibration and catalog faithfulness.
summary_en.importance: First joint audit of hallucination rate and verbalized confidence calibration in LLM recommenders, discovering systematic under-confidence; contributes to hallucination behavior analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: Selects four zero-shot LLM recommenders from independent vendors, tests across three catalog datasets stratified by item popularity, and jointly measures OOD@10 hallucination rate and calibration metrics including ECE and Brier score.
summary_en.experiments: Four models (Mistral Large, Llama-3.3-70B, GPT-OSS-120B, Claude Sonnet 4.6) across three datasets (MovieLens-25M, Amazon Toys, Yelp); hallucination rate ranges from 0% to 8.4% depending on catalog, ECE reaches 0.223 even with 0% hallucination, all models are systematically under-confident (verbalize 67-86 confidence for 92-100% accurate recommendations).
summary_en.authors_note: Amazon.com LLC Seattle team

recommendation.zh: 推荐场景下的置信度校准观测，仅作幻觉研究的旁证，看摘要和结果表即可。
recommendation.en: Confidence calibration observations in recommendation scenarios, only serves as side evidence for hallucination research; read abstract and result tables only.

paper.title: Unified Hallucination Fuzzing for Multimodal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Hallucination remains a persistent challenge for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), severely limiting their reliability in high-stakes applications. Existing evaluations, predominantly based on static benchmarks, suffer from narrow taxonomical coverage and rapid performance saturation, failing to reflect model robustness in evolving real-world scenarios. To bridge this gap, we present a systematic evaluation framework integrating a comprehensive benchmark with self-evolving stress testing

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的是 MLLM 幻觉评测的两个缺口：静态 benchmark 覆盖面窄，且很快被新模型饱和；已有评测多集中在物体存在性或属性错误，难以系统暴露指令服从、拒答边界、知识编造等更复杂的失真模式。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献有限，更接近评测与红队工具。但它对基座模型训练有两个启发。第一，幻觉不只是视觉 grounding 问题，还包括 instruction-level 和 knowledge-level 的训练信号冲突。第二，论文指出 helpfulness-oriented RL 可能放大 sycophancy，即模型为了满足用户暗示而编造信息。这对 post-train 数据、reward 设计、拒答样本比例、以及 multimodal grounding loss 的设计都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由两部分组成。第一是 UniHall，一个按 Object、Instruction、Knowledge 三个维度组织的 hallucination benchmark。Object 维度覆盖存在性、属性、关系等视觉事实错误；Instruction 维度关注错误服从、拒答失败、迎合式回答；Knowledge 维度关注模型对外部事实的编造。数据来自 Hallu-PI、BEAF 等开放域资源以及领域数据，经过人工标准化和类别映射。文中提到 object-level 超过 1000 个代表实例，原始数据按目标规模的 5-10 倍过采样后由 meta-reviewers 分配和筛选。第二是 SAMF，即 Self-Adaptive Multimodal Fuzzing。它借鉴软件 fuzz testing，用进化式 mutation 和强化学习生成语义尽量保持、但更容易触发幻觉的图像与 prompt 变体。评测端不是单一 LLM judge，而是 coarse-to-fine 的 structured oracle：规则、检测器和 LLM verifier 互补使用，用来判断错误类型、严重程度和可能原因。它和 POPE、HallusionBench 的区别在于：不是只做静态题集，也不是只看 object hallucination，而是把动态变异、细粒度 taxonomy 和结构化 oracle 放在一个闭环里。
summary.experiments: 实验主要比较静态 UniHall 与 fuzzing 后的表现差异。核心现象是：多个先进 MLLM 在 SAMF 生成的变异输入上性能明显下降，说明静态 benchmark 分数会高估模型鲁棒性。论文还报告了一个对训练有用的观察：经过更强 helpfulness 对齐的模型，在误导性或不可满足指令下更容易出现 sycophancy 和信息编造，而不是承认不确定或拒答。由于提供内容中没有完整实验表，无法确认各模型的具体降幅、样本规模和 oracle 一致性数字。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20-30 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中对 hallucination taxonomy 和 alignment tax 的定义，再看 Table 1 对 UniHall 与 POPE、AMBER、HallusionBench、OpenCHAIR 等 benchmark 的差异。Method 中重点看 SAMF 的 mutation 策略和 structured oracle pipeline，这部分比数据集本身更有迁移价值。若关注 post-train，可重点找 helpfulness-hallucination trade-off 的实验表和失败案例，判断它是否能转化为 reward model 或 refusal data 的诊断集。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a weakness in current MLLM hallucination evaluation: static benchmarks have narrow coverage and saturate quickly. Most prior tests focus on object-level visual errors, while instruction-level failures and knowledge fabrication remain under-tested.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation and stress-testing paper rather than a pretraining method paper. Its value for foundation-model research lies in the training signals it exposes. It separates visual grounding failures from instruction-following and knowledge-level fabrication, and it reports a helpfulness-hallucination tension: models optimized heavily for being helpful may become more willing to satisfy misleading requests with fabricated content. That observation is relevant for RLHF/RLAIF reward design, refusal data construction, and multimodal grounding evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work has two components. UniHall is a benchmark organized around a three-way taxonomy: Object, Instruction, and Knowledge hallucinations. Object cases include existence, attributes, and relations; instruction cases include refusal failures and sycophancy; knowledge cases cover fictitious factual claims. The seed data is repurposed from open-domain and domain-specific multimodal benchmarks such as Hallu-PI and BEAF, then normalized into a unified annotation protocol. The text states that the object-level split contains over 1,000 representative instances, with raw sources over-provisioned by 5-10x before filtering. SAMF, or Self-Adaptive Multimodal Fuzzing, is the dynamic component. It uses evolutionary mutation, including reinforcement learning, to generate adversarial image and prompt variants while trying to preserve semantics. Evaluation is handled by structured oracles: symbolic rules, detectors, and LLM verifiers are combined in a coarse-to-fine pipeline rather than relying on a single judge. Compared with POPE or HallusionBench, the main difference is the combination of fine-grained taxonomy, dynamic multimodal mutation, and structured verification.
summary_en.experiments: The reported experiments show a clear drop from static benchmark performance to fuzzed stress-test performance across strong MLLMs, indicating that static scores can hide brittle grounding behavior. The paper also highlights that models aligned more strongly for user helpfulness can show more instruction-level hallucination, especially sycophantic fabrication under misleading prompts. The provided content does not include the full result tables, so exact degradation numbers, model-by-model rankings, and oracle agreement statistics cannot be verified here.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20-30 minutes. Start with the taxonomy and the benchmark comparison table, since they define what the paper adds beyond POPE, AMBER, HallusionBench, and OpenCHAIR. Then read the SAMF method, especially the mutation loop and the oracle design. For training researchers, the most useful part is the evidence around the helpfulness-hallucination trade-off and the failure cases that could be turned into reward-model or refusal-policy diagnostics.

recommendation.zh: 只看 taxonomy 和 fuzzing mutation 设计即可；对预训练没直接动作，但能暴露 VLM 数据与对齐里的脆弱点。
recommendation.en: Read the taxonomy and mutation design only; it does not change pretraining directly, but it can reveal weak spots in VLM data and alignment.

paper.title: Wiener Representation Filtering for VLM Hallucination Suppression
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) excel at open-ended captioning and visual QA but often describe objects, attributes, or relations absent from the image, a phenomenon known as object hallucination. We propose a {training-free, post-hoc representation editing technique} that operates in the representation space of the language backbone. The method performs a lightweight, one-time offline calibration on a modest paired dataset to estimate the required covariance structures, using only forward passes

summary.core_problem: VLM在开放域描述和视觉问答中频繁产生图像中不存在的物体、属性或关系（物体幻觉）。
summary.importance: 提出一种训练自由、事后的表示编辑方法，无需梯度更新或微调即可抑制幻觉，属于方法创新。
summary.technical_approach: 将语言骨干隐藏状态建模为真实成分和幻觉相关成分的叠加；在小规模配对数据集上仅通过前向传播估计协方差结构；推导出Wiener型估计器，最优增益由真实和幻觉表示的协方差闭式给出；特征分解得到逐模式衰减并满足稳定性准则；校正直接吸收到模型现有权重中。
summary.experiments: 在VLM物体幻觉基准上测试，训练自由、一次性校准，显著降低幻觉率同时保持描述质量。
summary.authors_note: Lior Wolf（Tel Aviv University），在多模态和生成模型领域有较多代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: VLMs frequently describe objects, attributes, or relations absent from the image (object hallucination) in open-ended captioning and VQA.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a training-free, post-hoc representation editing method that suppresses hallucination without gradient updates or fine-tuning; method innovation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Models hidden states of the language backbone as a superposition of truthful and hallucination-associated components; estimates covariance structures on a small paired dataset via forward passes only; derives a Wiener-type estimator whose optimal gains are given in closed form from covariances of truthful and hallucinated representations; eigendecomposition yields mode-wise attenuation satisfying a stability criterion; correction is absorbed directly into existing model weights.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on VLM object hallucination benchmarks; training-free with one-time calibration, significantly reduces hallucination rate while preserving caption quality.
summary_en.authors_note: Lior Wolf (Tel Aviv University), known for work in multimodal and generative models.

recommendation.zh: 看§3的Wiener滤波推导和协方差估计部分，判断幻觉是否真在表示空间线性可分；若成立，对幻觉干预手段的认知会改变。
recommendation.en: Read §3 for the Wiener filter derivation and covariance estimation; if hallucination is truly linearly separable in representation space, it changes how we think about hallucination interventions.

paper.title: Beyond Global Editing: Per-Instance Disentangled Subspaces for Training-Free Hallucination Mitigation in LVLMs
paper.abstract: Recent advances in large vision-language models (LVLMs) have enabled powerful multimodal reasoning by integrating visual encoders with large language models (LLMs). However, their reliability is frequently undermined by hallucinations, where generated text inaccurately describes the visual input. Although fine-tuning can mitigate this problem, it is computationally expensive and requires large, curated datasets, making training-free alternatives attractive. Among these, model editing is more pro

summary.core_problem: 解决 LVLM 在图像描述和多模态推理中产生视觉幻觉的问题，重点是避免训练成本高的数据微调。
summary.importance: 贡献是 training-free 的 LVLM 幻觉缓解方法，关注内部表示编辑；对预训练研究的间接价值在于观察视觉-语言对齐错误是否集中在可编辑子空间中。
summary.technical_approach: 论文认为现有 model editing 多依赖单一全局子空间，对所有测试样本施加同一修正，难以覆盖不同输入的幻觉模式；因此提出按实例构建 disentangled subspaces，在不微调模型的情况下对内部表示做更细粒度修正。摘要截断，具体子空间构造、投影方式和推理流程未完整给出。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出使用的 LVLM、幻觉评测集、baseline、推理开销或数值结果；只能确认其目标是训练-free hallucination mitigation。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles hallucinations in LVLM outputs, aiming to reduce visually unsupported descriptions without expensive fine-tuning or large curated datasets.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training-free hallucination mitigation method based on internal representation editing. Its indirect value for pretraining research is the hypothesis that vision-language alignment errors may occupy editable subspaces.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper argues that existing model-editing methods use a single global correction subspace for all test samples, which cannot capture diverse hallucination modes. It proposes per-instance disentangled subspaces for finer-grained representation correction without updating model weights. The provided abstract is truncated, so the exact subspace construction and inference procedure are not fully specified.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report the LVLMs used, hallucination benchmarks, baselines, inference overhead, or quantitative results.

recommendation.zh: 只看子空间构造是否干净；若评测只靠常规幻觉集和小模型，结论更像后处理技巧。
recommendation.en: Only inspect whether the subspace construction is clean; if evaluation is just standard hallucination sets on small LVLMs, treat it as post-hoc editing.

paper.title: Eliciting Intrinsic Hallucinations in LLMs via Semantically Equivalent Adversarial Attacks
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are often used in conjunction with external knowledge sources to improve their factual accuracy and decrease hallucinations, through methods such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). However, these systems remain susceptible to intrinsic hallucinations, where the model generates unfaithful or fabricated information that is not supported by the retrieved evidence. We propose a novel framework to assess model robustness against this phenomenon by stress-testing usi

summary.core_problem: 评估 RAG 场景下 LLM 对“语义等价改写”是否仍会产生不被检索证据支持的内生幻觉。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是鲁棒性评测框架：用保持语义等价的对抗改写去诱发 intrinsic hallucination。对预训练的直接启发有限，但对理解“检索并不能消除模型内部错误先验”有一定价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出一个带语义等价约束的对抗优化框架，在白盒、灰盒、黑盒设置下搜索 query 变体，同时以 intrinsic hallucination 为目标函数，系统压力测试生成模型在 RAG 条件下的稳健性。
summary.experiments: 评测 5 个开源和 5 个闭源生成模型，覆盖 3 个数据集。摘要结论是即便强模型在语义等价扰动下也容易出现内生幻觉，但未提供与训练数据、模型架构或预训练 recipe 相关的因果分析。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Imperial College London。Alessio Lomuscio 在多智能体系统与形式化验证方向较知名。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether LLMs in RAG settings still produce intrinsic hallucinations under semantically equivalent query reformulations.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is mainly an evaluation and robustness framework: using semantics-preserving adversarial rewrites to elicit intrinsic hallucinations. The direct pretraining takeaway is limited, but it is useful as evidence that retrieval does not erase internal model priors.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method performs adversarial optimization over natural query variants while enforcing semantic equivalence and optimizing for intrinsic hallucination, across white-box, gray-box, and black-box attack settings.
summary_en.experiments: Five open-source and five proprietary generator models are tested on three datasets. The headline result is that even strong models remain vulnerable under semantically equivalent perturbations, but the paper does not connect this to pretraining data, architecture, or optimization choices.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Imperial College London. Alessio Lomuscio is well known in multi-agent systems and formal methods.

recommendation.zh: 这是个干净的鲁棒性 stress test，不是基座方法论文；若你做 RAG 或 hallucination eval，只看攻击构造和失败案例即可。
recommendation.en: This is a clean robustness stress test, not a foundation-model method paper; if you care about RAG or hallucination eval, just read the attack construction and failure cases.

paper.title: The Personalization Mirage: How LLMs Fabricate User Profiles, and Why Self-Monitoring Misleads
paper.abstract: Personalized LLMs with persistent memory are increasingly deployed, yet the faithfulness of their user models remains unexamined. We study over-inference (OI): the phenomenon where LLMs fabricate user attributes beyond what evidence supports. We introduce MirageBench, comprising 150 personas balanced across stereotypical, counter-stereotypical, and neutral profiles, 6 personalization tasks spanning an ``imagination gradient'', a four-way faithfulness taxonomy operationalized by an independent ju

summary.core_problem: 评估带持久记忆的个性化 LLM 是否会在证据不足时编造用户画像属性，以及模型自我监控能否可靠发现这种问题。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是评测资产和现象分析。论文提出 over-inference 作为个性化记忆系统中的信实性错误类型，并用 MirageBench 系统测量多模型的用户画像虚构问题，对长期记忆、个性化 Agent 和安全评测有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 构建包含 150 个 persona 的 MirageBench，覆盖刻板、反刻板和中性用户画像；设计 6 类个性化任务，任务按“想象梯度”变化；提出四分类 faithfulness taxonomy，并用独立 judge 标注模型输出中的 claim，且用盲人工标注验证 judge 可靠性。
summary.experiments: 评测 7 个模型家族共 12 个模型，覆盖 143,616 条被 judge 的 claim。人工验证集包含 400 条 claim，四分类 Cohen's kappa 为 0.863，二分类为 0.900。结果显示所有模型都有 35%–49% 的 over-inference，跨模型均值 41.6%，按 claim 加权为 41.8%。论文还报告 self-monitoring inversion，即模型自评信实性不能可靠筛选更少过度推断的模型。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自香港科技大学。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether personalized LLMs with persistent memory fabricate unsupported user-profile attributes, and whether self-monitoring can detect this failure mode.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an evaluation asset and an empirical failure analysis. It formalizes over-inference as a faithfulness error in personalized memory systems and measures it across model families, which is relevant to long-term memory, personalization, and agent safety evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce MirageBench with 150 balanced personas spanning stereotypical, counter-stereotypical, and neutral profiles. They define six personalization tasks along an “imagination gradient,” use a four-way faithfulness taxonomy, and operationalize claim-level labeling through an independent judge validated against blind human annotation.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark evaluates 12 models from 7 families over 143,616 judged claims. The judge is validated on 400 human-labeled claims with Cohen’s kappa of 0.863 for four-class labeling and 0.900 for binary labeling. All models over-infer on 35%–49% of claims, with a cross-model mean of 41.6% and claim-weighted rate of 41.8%. The paper also reports a self-monitoring inversion where model self-assessments are not reliable selectors for faithful personalization.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology.

recommendation.zh: 个性化记忆方向可看抽象和结果表；对 pretrain 没有直接动作，但“自评不可靠”是后训练评测里应保留的坏信号。
recommendation.en: Read the abstract and result tables if you work on memory; it does not change pretraining practice, but the self-monitoring failure is a useful negative signal for post-training eval.

institutions: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

paper.title: DUD: Decoupled Update Dynamics for Reliable Uncertainty Quantification in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Accurate Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) is critical for reliable deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs), yet traditional probability-based metrics often fail to capture the model's true epistemic state. While recent mechanistic approaches leverage hidden state dynamics, they typically aggregate residual stream updates, conflating the distinct roles of parametric memory (Feed-Forward Networks) and contextual processing (Attention). We argue that this aggregation obscures fine-grained mechani

summary.core_problem: 为 LLM uncertainty quantification 提供更细粒度的内部机制信号，避免只用输出概率或聚合 residual stream 动态来估计不确定性。
summary.importance: 贡献是机制分析和 UQ 方法。它把 Attention 的上下文处理与 FFN 的参数记忆分开看，认为二者的冲突和恢复能力能揭示模型内部脆弱性；对幻觉检测、置信度估计和训练动态分析都有间接价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Decoupled Update Dynamics (DUD)。方法通过 noise-induced causal interventions 分别干预 FFN 和 Attention 的贡献，量化两个模块各自恢复正确内部状态或输出的能力，形成 dual-stream dynamic profile，用于捕捉 memory-context misalignment 等不确定性来源。
summary.experiments: 摘要称进行了广泛实验，证明 DUD 能捕捉模型内部 fragility，并优于传统 probability-based UQ 与聚合 hidden-state dynamics 方法。具体模型规模、数据集、baseline、提升幅度和显著性需要看正文确认。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics、The Key Laboratory of Brain-Machine Intelligence Technology 等。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper seeks a finer-grained internal signal for LLM uncertainty quantification, beyond output probabilities or aggregated residual-stream dynamics.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a mechanistic UQ method. It separates Attention as contextual processing from FFNs as parametric memory, arguing that conflicts between the two streams reveal internal fragility. This is indirectly useful for hallucination detection, confidence estimation, and training-dynamics analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose Decoupled Update Dynamics (DUD). It uses noise-induced causal interventions to decouple FFN and Attention contributions, measures each module's independent restoration capability, and builds a dual-stream dynamic profile that captures uncertainty sources such as memory-context misalignment.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports extensive experiments showing that DUD captures internal fragility and improves over probability-based UQ and aggregated hidden-state dynamics methods. The exact model sizes, datasets, baselines, effect sizes, and significance tests require the full paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics and The Key Laboratory of Brain-Machine Intelligence Technology.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫 §方法和主表；FFN/Attention 分流诊断比单看 logprob 更像可迁移的 UQ 信号。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and main table; the FFN/Attention split looks more transferable as a UQ signal than raw logprob.

institutions: Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics
The Key Laboratory of Brain-Machine Intelligence Technology

paper.title: Tracing the Cascade: A Topology-Aware Evaluation Framework for Scientific Agent Hallucinations
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in scientific research, where reliability is critical and the underlying knowledge is densely interconnected. In such settings, hallucinations are particularly damaging: a single erroneous claim on a foundational concept can propagate through multi-step reasoning and corrupt entire trajectories. Existing hallucination benchmarks largely operate at the surface level, treating facts in isolation and relying on uniform accuracy metrics tha

summary.core_problem: 现有的 Agent 幻觉评测多停留在孤立的查询层面（query-level），无法捕捉科学研究等复杂领域中，单一概念错误如何沿着推理链条级联传播并导致整个任务失败的拓扑结构问题。
summary.importance: 提出了一种从表面准确率向机制级归因转变的新范式。对于预训练和后训练阶段如何构建更鲁棒的科学推理 Agent，以及如何设计超越单步 QA 的长程推理评测，提供了方法论参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出了 SCHEMA 框架，核心是拓扑感知的评测和反事实归因。首先通过自动化 pipeline 构建科学概念图谱；然后基于图谱生成多跳推理和实验执行任务；最后，设计了一个多智能体协作的反事实推理机制（Abduction-Intervention-Prediction），通过系统性地替换轨迹中的幻觉声明，定位幻觉发生的具体步骤并诊断其因果机制。
summary.experiments: 构建了生物医学领域的 benchmark。实验揭示了科学幻觉主要源于领域先验知识的缺陷和概念间连通性的薄弱。特别是拓扑中心概念上的错误，会引发推理链条上的级联失败。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读 Section 2 中关于反事实归因（Counterfactual Attribution）的具体实现，特别是多智能体（solver, validator, planner）如何协作完成轨迹编辑和根因定位。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing agent hallucination evaluations operate at an isolated query level, failing to capture how a single conceptual error cascades through reasoning chains in complex domains like scientific research, where knowledge is topologically interconnected.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a paradigm shift from surface-level accuracy metrics to mechanism-level attribution. It provides methodological insights for building more robust scientific reasoning agents during pre- and post-training, and for designing long-horizon evaluations beyond single-step QA.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the SCHEMA framework, centered on topology-aware evaluation and counterfactual attribution. It first builds a scientific concept graph via an automated pipeline, then generates multi-hop reasoning and experimental tasks. Crucially, it employs a multi-agent counterfactual reasoning mechanism (Abduction-Intervention-Prediction) to systematically edit trajectories, replacing hallucinated claims to isolate the exact step and causal mechanism of the failure.
summary_en.experiments: Constructed a biomedical benchmark. Findings reveal that scientific hallucinations stem primarily from flawed domain priors and weak conceptual interconnectivity. Errors on topologically central concepts trigger cascading failures across reasoning chains.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 for the implementation of Counterfactual Attribution, specifically how the multi-agent system (solver, validator, planner) collaborates for trajectory editing and root cause localization. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读任务构造和指标定义即可；它提醒 agent eval 不能只看平均准确率。
recommendation.en: Read the task construction and metrics; the useful signal is that agent evaluation should not stop at mean accuracy.

paper.title: Experience-Calibrated Contrastive Decoding for Mitigating Hallucinations in LM-Based Text-to-Speech
paper.abstract: Language model-based text-to-speech (LM-based TTS) remains vulnerable to speech hallucinations that deviate from the target text. Existing mitigation mainly relies on architectural changes or additional training, while decoding-time control remains underexplored. We present a conditional information view that distinguishes text-derived alignment information from experience information supplied by acoustic context and learned speech regularities. We hypothesize that an important class of hallucin

summary.core_problem: 解决 LM-based TTS 在生成语音时偏离输入文本、产生语音幻觉的问题，重点放在不改模型、不重训的解码阶段控制。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是语音 LM 生成阶段的方法改进。它把 TTS 幻觉拆成文本对齐信息不足和声学上下文经验信息过强的冲突，对理解 speech LM 的生成失控有一定参考价值，但不直接推进 LLM 预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Experience-Calibrated Contrastive Decoding。方法比较同一个 speech LM 在有文本条件和无文本条件下的 token 预测，把差异视作文本对齐支持；只做正向 alignment enhancement，并用集合级 experience calibration 控制增强强度，避免破坏原始 expert distribution 中有用的声学经验。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、数据集名称和具体数值。论文声称 ECCD 是 training-free 方法，用于 LM-based TTS 的幻觉缓解，并与需要结构修改或额外训练的方案形成对比。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets speech hallucinations in LM-based text-to-speech, where generated speech deviates from the target text, using decoding-time control rather than retraining.
summary_en.importance: This is a speech-generation method contribution. Its useful angle is the separation between text-derived alignment information and acoustic-context or learned speech priors, which is relevant to speech LM failure modes but not directly to base LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method, Experience-Calibrated Contrastive Decoding, compares predictions from the same speech LM with and without text conditioning. The conditional difference is used to positively enhance alignment support, while set-level calibration limits the strength so useful acoustic experience is not suppressed.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model size, datasets, or numeric gains. The reported setup positions ECCD as a training-free hallucination mitigation method for LM-based TTS, contrasted with architectural changes or additional training.

recommendation.zh: 读解码公式即可；它提醒 speech LM 的 hallucination 有 alignment/experience 张力，但不是预训练信号。
recommendation.en: Skim the decoding rule; the alignment-vs-experience framing is useful for speech LM failures, but it is not a pretraining signal.

paper.title: Bayesian and Motivated Reasoning in AI Agents
paper.abstract: AI agents increasingly perform open-ended tasks in settings where their conclusions can guide consequential decisions. We provide evidence that AI agents draw different conclusions from identical numerical data when the substantive framing changes. We demonstrate this behavior in high-stakes domains in medicine, election forensics, and geopolitical forecasting by holding the evidence fixed while changing the scenario in which the evidence appears. Across twelve agent-domain comparisons, agents'

summary.core_problem: AI agent 在面对相同数值证据时，是否会因场景框架（framing）和先验信念不同而得出不同结论，即是否表现出 motivated reasoning。
summary.importance: 原理分析/行为研究；用控制变量实验揭示 agent 的结论受先验信念系统性影响，且会改变搜索深度和分析方法选择，对理解幻觉、偏见和推理可靠性有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 在医学、选举取证、地缘预测三个高风险领域，固定数值证据仅改变场景框架，跨 12 个 agent-domain 对比测量结论方向、搜索广度和分析规格选择。
summary.experiments: 12 个 agent-domain 对比；agent 对先验认为可能的命题更倾向得出肯定结论，框架冲突时则相反；部分 agent 会改变搜索范围和分析方法。摘要未列出具体模型名称和效应量。

summary_en.core_problem: Do AI agents draw different conclusions from identical numerical evidence when the scenario framing and their prior beliefs change, i.e., do they exhibit motivated reasoning?
summary_en.importance: Behavioral/mechanistic analysis; controlled experiments show agents' conclusions are systematically biased by prior beliefs, and framing alters search depth and analytical specification choice—relevant to understanding hallucination, bias, and reasoning reliability.
summary_en.technical_approach: Across three high-stakes domains (medicine, election forensics, geopolitical forecasting), evidence is held fixed while scenario framing varies; 12 agent-domain comparisons measure conclusion direction, search breadth, and analytical specification choice.
summary_en.experiments: 12 agent-domain comparisons; agents more likely to affirm propositions they already regard as likely, with the reverse under conflicting framing; some agents change search extent and analytical methods. Abstract does not list specific model names or effect sizes.

recommendation.zh: 行为实验揭示 agent 的先验信念会扭曲证据解读，结论方向可信但缺模型细节和效应量，作为偏见文献备查即可。
recommendation.en: A behavioral study showing priors distort evidence evaluation in agents; directionally credible but lacks model specifics and effect sizes—file it as bias literature.

paper.title: When Model Priors Conflict with Visual Evidence: Mitigating Commonsense-Driven Hallucinations by Selective Prior Calibration
paper.abstract: In vision--language models, commonsense-driven hallucination (CDH) occurs when a model's commonsense prior overrides clear visual evidence of an atypical state. For example, a model may report that a visibly six-fingered hand has five fingers. We show that these errors are systematically directed: when a model answers a question about a counterfactual (CF) image incorrectly, its answer often coincides with the candidate it prefers without access to the image. Suppressing this prior indiscriminat

summary.core_problem: 研究 VLM 在反常识视觉证据面前仍按常识先验作答的幻觉问题，例如明明看到六指手却回答五指。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM 幻觉机制分析与推理期校准方法。它把一类幻觉归因到候选答案级别的 commonsense prior，而不是简单归因于视觉识别失败，对理解多模态模型的语言先验干扰有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Selective Prior Calibration。方法先估计模型在无图像条件下对各候选答案的偏好，再从图像条件分数中按实例自适应强度扣除这部分先验；只有当校准后的分数结构强支持替代答案时才改写原预测，避免把有用的常识先验整体压掉。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在反常识图像问题上显著提升准确率，同时减少对匹配常识图像正确答案的破坏。提供信息未包含具体 VLM、数据集全名、参数规模或提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自哈尔滨工业大学网络空间安全学院及广东省新型安全智能技术重点实验室。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies commonsense-driven hallucination in VLMs, where a model follows a prior answer even when the image clearly shows an atypical state.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a mechanism-oriented VLM hallucination analysis plus an inference-time calibration method. It frames a subset of hallucinations as candidate-level prior override rather than plain visual recognition failure.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed Selective Prior Calibration estimates candidate preferences without the image, subtracts those prior scores from image-conditioned scores with instance-dependent strength, and changes the original prediction only when the calibrated pattern strongly supports another answer.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports substantial accuracy gains on counterfactual images while preserving correct answers on matched commonsense images. The provided metadata does not specify model sizes, full benchmark names, or numerical gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Harbin Institute of Technology and the Guangdong Provincial Key Laboratory of Novel Security Intelligence Technologies.

recommendation.zh: 可看作 VLM 语言先验干扰的一个干净小诊断；读方法和错误方向性分析即可，不会改变预训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: A useful small diagnostic for language-prior interference in VLMs; read the calibration setup and error-direction analysis, not the full paper.

institutions: Guangdong Provincial Key Laboratory of Novel Security Intelligence Technologies

paper.title: Role-Break in Attention Heads: Understanding and Detecting Hallucinations in VLMs
paper.abstract: Despite remarkable progress in vision-language generation, Vision-Language Models (VLMs) remain prone to hallucinations, producing content that is inconsistent with or unsupported by the input image. Existing works largely design detection or mitigation methods around one specific hallucination pattern, such as visual-textual imbalance, but real VLM hallucinations arise from a mixture of multiple patterns, so signals bound to a single pattern struggle to remain stable across models and tasks. Un

summary.core_problem: VLM幻觉由多种模式混合引起，绑定单一模式（如视觉-文本失衡）的检测信号跨模型跨任务不稳定。
summary.importance: 原理分析类工作，从注意力头层面统一刻画幻觉信号，发现幻觉表现为各头偏离其忠实上下文行为的局部偏差（Role-Break），且该信号在保留头身份时线性可读。
summary.technical_approach: 在统一的头级别视角下分析幻觉诱导的注意力变化，发现偏差跨注意力头、上下文来源和偏差方向系统组织；在此基础上训练轻量线性检测器。
summary.experiments: 在多个VLM和任务上验证Role-Break检测器的跨模型跨任务稳定性（摘要截断，无具体模型名和数字）。
summary.authors_note: 作者含Nan Duan（段楠），MSRA Principal Researcher，在VLM/NLP/代码生成方向有大量代表性工作；论文标注机构为北京大学，可能为合作。

summary_en.core_problem: VLM hallucinations arise from a mixture of patterns, so detection signals bound to a single pattern (e.g., visual-textual imbalance) are unstable across models and tasks.
summary_en.importance: A mechanistic analysis work that characterizes hallucination signals at the attention-head level, finding that hallucinations manifest as localized deviations from each head's faithful contextual behavior (Role-Break), and that the resulting signal is linearly readable when head identity is preserved.
summary_en.technical_approach: Analyzes hallucination-induced attention changes under a unified head-level view; finds deviations systematically organized across attention heads, contextual sources, and deviation directions; builds a lightweight linear detector on top of Role-Break features.
summary_en.experiments: Validates the Role-Break detector's cross-model and cross-task stability on multiple VLMs and tasks (abstract truncated, no specific model names or numbers).
summary_en.authors_note: Author list includes Nan Duan, Principal Researcher at MSRA with extensive work on VLMs, NLP, and code generation. The listed institution is Peking University, possibly indicating a collaboration.

recommendation.zh: 头级别Role-Break现象对LLM幻觉可解释性有弱迁移价值，但实验仅在VLM上且摘要无数字，作为literature备查即可。
recommendation.en: The head-level Role-Break phenomenon has weak transfer value to LLM hallucination interpretability, but experiments are VLM-only with no numbers in the abstract. Keep as literature reference.

paper.title: Hearsay: Vision-Language Medical Diagnoses Without an Image
paper.abstract: When asked to describe a medical image that was never attached, frontier vision-language models do not abstain: they confabulate a diagnosis. We show that this confabulation is not random. It is structured by who the patient is said to be. Across chest X-ray, brain MRI, and dermatology, Claude Opus-4.7, GPT-5.4, and Gemini-3.1-Pro are each queried with only a demographic descriptor and no image, and changing the descriptor systematically shifts the diagnosis returned. Claude concentrates sharply

summary.core_problem: 前沿视觉语言模型在未提供医学图像的情况下不会主动弃权，反而会根据患者人口统计信息系统性编造诊断，存在严重的幻觉与人口偏见耦合问题。
summary.importance: 属于原理分析类工作，首次系统验证了前沿VLM在无视觉输入场景下的幻觉并非随机，而是受文本中的人口统计特征结构化驱动，为理解多模态模型的幻觉机制提供了新的实证。
summary.technical_approach: 针对胸部X光、脑部MRI、皮肤病三类医学影像场景，向Claude Opus-4.7、GPT-5.4、Gemini-3.1-Pro三款前沿VLM仅输入人口统计描述（无图像），控制年龄、性别、种族等变量，观测诊断结果的分布变化与偏见模式。
summary.experiments: 测试3款前沿闭源VLM，覆盖3类医学影像场景；发现Claude的幻觉高度集中（如65岁白人男性的皮肤痣几乎都被诊断为黑色素瘤），GPT-5.4的幻觉更广泛，且两款模型均存在针对特定种族的疾病刻板印象（如年轻黑人患者的胸片被诊断为结节病的比例显著更高）。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自卡内基梅隆大学、亚马逊云科技AI Native团队。

summary_en.core_problem: State-of-the-art vision-language models do not abstain when no medical image is provided; instead, they systematically confabulate diagnoses based on patient demographic descriptors, revealing a coupled problem of hallucination and demographic bias.
summary_en.importance: A mechanism analysis work that first systematically verifies that VLM hallucinations in the absence of visual input are not random, but structurally driven by demographic features in text, providing new empirical evidence for understanding multimodal hallucination mechanisms.
summary_en.technical_approach: Across three medical imaging scenarios (chest X-ray, brain MRI, dermatology), three frontier VLMs (Claude Opus-4.7, GPT-5.4, Gemini-3.1-Pro) are queried with only demographic descriptors (no image). Variables including age, gender, and race are controlled to observe distribution changes and bias patterns in diagnostic outputs.
summary_en.experiments: Three state-of-the-art closed-source VLMs are tested across three medical imaging scenarios. Claude's hallucinations are highly concentrated (e.g., a 65-year-old white man's skin mole is diagnosed as melanoma in nearly all responses). GPT-5.4's hallucinations are broader, and both models exhibit disease stereotypes targeting specific racial groups (e.g., significantly higher rates of sarcoidosis diagnosis for young Black patients' chest X-rays).
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Carnegie Mellon University and Amazon Web Services AI Native.

recommendation.zh: 医学VLM幻觉的现象级分析，仅需了解结论即可，对预训练研究无直接可落地的启发。
recommendation.en: Phenomenal analysis of medical VLM hallucination; only the conclusion is worth knowing, with no actionable insight for pretraining research.

paper.title: Chart-Supported or Model-Supplied? Examining MLLM-Generated Claims for Accessible Visualization
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can connect visualization patterns to external causes, consequences, and domain knowledge, but the evidential basis of these interpretations is often unclear. We present an exploratory study of 102 visualizations from four sources, three MLLMs, and four input conditions that vary access to the image, source-specific accessible chart context, and withheld-context framing. Across 1,224 descriptions, we analyze model-attributed DIRECT, DERIVED, and SPECULATI

summary.core_problem: 评估 MLLM 为可访问图表描述生成解释性 claim 时，哪些内容有图表证据支撑，哪些来自模型外推或臆测。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态模型行为评估和可访问可视化场景的审计研究；它对 VLM grounding、数值一致性和 speculative claim 控制有参考意义，但不是通用预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构建 102 个可视化样本，比较三种 MLLM 和四种输入条件，包括图像、源特定 accessible chart context 以及 withheld-context framing；将输出 claim 标为 DIRECT、DERIVED、SPECULATIVE，并自动审计数值一致性。
summary.experiments: 共分析 1,224 条描述。Accessible chart context 会让 Gemini 和 GPT 生成更多 DIRECT claim，并在部分模型上提高数值一致性；加入图像到完整上下文没有稳定数值收益；withheld-context prompt 也未可靠增加谨慎措辞；Real-World Significance 部分多数仍为 SPECULATIVE。

summary_en.core_problem: The study evaluates whether claims generated by MLLMs for accessible chart descriptions are supported by the chart itself or supplied through model-side speculation.
summary_en.importance: It is an audit of multimodal model behavior in accessible visualization, relevant to VLM grounding, numeric faithfulness, and speculative-claim control, but it does not propose a general pretraining method.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors use 102 visualizations, three MLLMs, and four input conditions varying access to the image, source-specific accessible chart context, and withheld-context framing. Generated claims are labeled as DIRECT, DERIVED, or SPECULATIVE, with an automated audit for numeric agreement.
summary_en.experiments: The study analyzes 1,224 descriptions. Accessible chart context shifts Gemini and GPT toward DIRECT claims and improves numeric agreement for some models. Adding the image to full context gives no consistent numeric benefit, withheld-context prompting does not reliably increase caution, and Real-World Significance remains mostly SPECULATIVE.

recommendation.zh: 只看结果段即可；它提醒 chart grounding 主要吃结构化上下文，图像输入本身未必修复数值幻觉。
recommendation.en: Read only the results; the useful signal is that structured chart context helps grounding more reliably than simply adding the image.

paper.title: Visual Token Compression Enhances Robustness of MLLMs
paper.abstract: In this paper, we show for the first time that visual token pruning enhances the robustness of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), mitigating vulnerabilities such as jailbreak attacks and hallucinations. Given that vision and language modalities cannot be perfectly aligned, the misaligned visual tokens might act as out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs, leading to unpredictable outputs and introducing potential vulnerabilities. Building on this insight, we aim to enhance model robustness agains

summary.core_problem: 研究 MLLM 中视觉 token 与语言空间不对齐是否会诱发越狱和幻觉，并尝试用视觉 token 剪枝提升鲁棒性。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态鲁棒性方法。它把视觉 token 压缩从单纯推理加速问题，转成一种减少 OOD 视觉输入的安全与幻觉缓解手段，对 VLM 预训练后的视觉-语言对齐分析有一定参考。
summary.technical_approach: 方法先度量每个视觉 token 到语言特征空间的距离，将距离较大的 token 视为更可能的 OOD 或错配 token，然后在指定的 robust-pruning layers 中迭代剪除这些 token。设计上不是重新训练基座模型，而是在推理阶段做视觉 token 选择，因此更接近轻量干预和压缩策略。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在 7 个常用 benchmark 上评估，平均提升 13.29，覆盖越狱攻击和幻觉相关鲁棒性指标，同时带来推理成本下降。摘要未给出具体 MLLM 名称、参数规模、token 保留率和每个 benchmark 的详细结果。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自合肥工业大学。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether misaligned visual tokens in MLLMs contribute to jailbreaks and hallucinations, and whether pruning such tokens can improve robustness.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal robustness contribution. It reframes visual token compression as more than an inference-saving trick: removing likely OOD visual tokens may reduce unsafe or hallucinated responses caused by imperfect vision-language alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method measures the distance between each visual token and the language feature space, treats large-distance tokens as likely OOD or misaligned, and iteratively prunes them at selected robust-pruning layers. It is an inference-time intervention rather than a new pretraining recipe.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports evaluation on seven popular benchmarks, with an average improvement of 13.29 and lower inference cost as a side effect. The provided abstract does not specify model sizes, exact MLLM backbones, pruning ratios, or per-benchmark numbers.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Hefei University of Technology.

recommendation.zh: 可看方法图和消融，价值在把视觉 token 距离当鲁棒性信号；但不是预训练结论，别外推到 tokenizer 设计。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and ablations: the useful signal is visual-token distance as a robustness proxy, not a pretraining-level conclusion.

paper.title: Do VLMs Read or Rewrite? On Transcription Faithfulness in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly used in place of traditional OCR pipelines for document understanding. In this paper, we show they do not always act as faithful transcribers: when text is imperfect, they often tend to rewrite it into a more plausible form - a behavior that clean-text OCR benchmarks cannot detect. We introduce FaithC4, a multilingual perturbation benchmark of 1,455 single-page documents (English, Chinese, Korean) with three perturbation families: scramble, random s

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究的是一个很实际但常被忽略的问题：VLM 在文档转写时，究竟是在“读”图像里的字，还是在用语言先验“改写”成更像正常文本的内容。标准 OCR benchmark 多是干净文本，测不出这种偏差；而一旦输入里有拼写错误、字符扰动或视觉歧义，通用 VLM 可能输出更合理但不忠实的文本。作者要解决的核心问题不是 OCR 准确率本身，而是 transcription faithfulness，也就是模型是否逐字忠实于视觉证据。
summary.importance: 对纯 LLM 预训练的直接相关性有限，但对多模态预训练和统一建模很有启发。它揭示了一个典型的 pretrain-posttrain 张力：强语言建模先验会提升语义恢复能力，却可能损害字面保真。对于把文档理解、图像文字读取、视觉 token 到文本解码统一进一个大模型的人，这个问题很关键，因为它不是下游 prompt 小问题，而是训练目标与模态融合方式带来的系统性偏置。更具体地说，这篇工作提醒两点。第一，VLM 里的 LM prior 不是免费午餐，尤其在需要 literal transcription 的场景。第二，评测如果只看 clean OCR，会高估通用 VLM 作为“读字器”的可靠性。贡献主要在 benchmark 与现象刻画，不是新训练方法。
summary.technical_approach:
技术路线分两部分：构造可控扰动 benchmark，以及用它分离“视觉读取”与“语言改写”两种行为。作者从 mC4 采样英文、中文、韩文单页文档文本，先在文本层做受控字符扰动，再渲染成 PDF 图像。这样 ground truth 就是扰动后的文本，而不是原始干净文本，因此可以明确判断模型是在忠实转写，还是偷偷纠正。这个设计比直接在现成扫描文档上评测更干净，因为扰动位置、比例、类型都可控。

扰动分三类。Scramble 保留首尾字符、打乱中间字符，用来测试模型是否依赖词形整体模式和语言先验；Random 用同脚本随机字符替换，测试强破坏下的鲁棒性；Visual 用视觉相似字符替换，测试视觉歧义与语言先验的竞争。英文和韩文按词处理，中文按 4 字窗口处理。作者在 8% 的 eligible words 或字符窗口上施加扰动，并保留原始版本作为对照。

评测对象分三类：通用 VLM、OCR-specialized VLM、传统 OCR。这个分组很重要，因为它对应不同强度的语言先验。通用 VLM 经过大规模多模态与文本预训练，最容易“脑补”；OCR 专项模型经过文档抽取微调，语言先验被任务约束部分压制；传统 OCR 基本是字符级识别，没有强生成式 prior。作者用统一 prompt 让通用 VLM 自然输出，不额外强调“不要纠错”，避免把现象用指令压掉。

除了整体误差统计，论文还对 Qwen3-VL-4B 做层间 probing，分析何时发生 rewriting。作者发现，当扰动词的内部表示仍靠近原始词编码时，模型更容易走向“改写”而非“照抄”。另一个细节是词长效应：短词更容易被语言模型先验覆盖，长词一旦偏离正常拼写，模型反而不容易自信地纠正。
summary.experiments:
实验规模是 1,455 份单页文档，覆盖 EN/ZH/KO 三种脚本，评测 15 个系统。主结果很清楚：通用 VLM 在扰动下的 WER 退化最大，英文上可到 4.5 个百分点；OCR-specialized VLM 的退化约 0.2–2 个百分点；传统 OCR 小于 0.6 个百分点。这个差异基本支持作者的核心论点：语言先验越强，越容易在 imperfect text 上牺牲忠实性。

另一个重要发现是非局部效应。即便只扰动约 5% 的词，通用 VLM 在未扰动部分上的错误也会比 clean baseline 高 5–10 倍。这说明 rewriting 不是局部字符识别失误，而是整页上下文建模被带偏，模型会在更大范围内重写文本。对统一文档模型来说，这个现象比单点 WER 更值得警惕。

跨语言结果也有信息量。结论在英中韩都成立，但最伤的扰动类型因脚本不同而异，说明 rewriting 既受语言模型先验影响，也受书写系统和字符空间结构影响。中文没有 scramble，更多体现 visual/random 替换的影响；韩文由于可施加扰动的长词比例较低，整体扰动率也更低。

机制分析部分，Qwen3-VL-4B 的 layerwise probing 显示：当 perturbed word 的表示与原词仍接近时，模型更可能输出原词或“合理词”，而不是视觉上真实出现的扰动词。词长实验显示 4–6 字符短词的 rewriting 率可达约 10%，超过 7 字符后降到 0%。这说明 LM prior 对短词的覆盖更强，而长词的组合空间更大，模型不容易做高置信纠错。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读到中等深度。先看 Introduction，抓住作者要测的是 faithfulness，不是一般 OCR accuracy。然后看数据构造部分，确认 ground truth 为什么定义成“扰动后文本”，以及三类 perturbation 分别在测什么。主表格里重点比较三类系统在不同语言、不同扰动下的 WER 退化，而不是只看 clean performance。接着看 non-local effect 的分析，这部分最能说明通用 VLM 的问题不是局部识别，而是整页生成偏置。最后看 Qwen3-VL-4B 的 probing 和词长分析，理解 rewriting 何时发生。

如果只花 25–35 分钟，建议看：任务定义、FaithC4 构造、主结果表、non-local effect 图、Qwen3-VL probing。若要进一步深挖，值得追问三点：这种 rewriting 能否通过训练目标修正；OCR-specialized VLM 的改进来自数据还是解码约束；以及在 native multimodal pretraining 里，如何平衡语义恢复与字面保真。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a failure mode that standard OCR-style evaluation largely misses: when asked to transcribe documents, do VLMs actually read the text, or do they rewrite it into something more plausible? On clean benchmarks, this distinction is mostly invisible. But once the input contains typos, character corruption, or visually ambiguous symbols, a model with a strong language prior may output a corrected or normalized string rather than the literal content in the image. The core problem is therefore transcription faithfulness, not generic OCR accuracy.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to text-only pretraining is limited, but it is quite relevant to multimodal pretraining and unified modeling. The paper exposes a clear trade-off: stronger language-model priors can improve semantic recovery while hurting literal fidelity. That matters for document VLMs, OCR-capable multimodal LMs, and any setup that decodes text from visual tokens using a powerful generative backbone. The main lesson is not about prompting; it is about objective mismatch and modality fusion. If evaluation only measures clean-text OCR, it can overestimate how reliable a general-purpose VLM is as a faithful reader. The contribution is primarily a benchmark plus a careful characterization of the phenomenon, not a new training method.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper has two technical components: a controlled perturbation benchmark and an evaluation protocol designed to separate visual reading from language-driven rewriting. The authors sample raw text from mC4 in English, Chinese, and Korean, apply character-level perturbations directly in text space, and then render the perturbed text into single-page document images. This is a strong design choice because the ground truth becomes the perturbed text itself, making it possible to tell whether a model transcribes what is present or silently corrects it.

They use three perturbation families. Scramble preserves the first and last character while shuffling the middle, probing reliance on lexical priors. Random substitution replaces characters with random same-script alternatives, creating severe corruption. Visual substitution replaces characters with visually similar ones, probing the competition between visual evidence and language prior. English and Korean are perturbed at the word level; Chinese uses non-overlapping 4-character windows. The perturbation rate is controlled, with clean documents retained as a baseline.

The evaluation spans three system classes: general-purpose VLMs, OCR-specialized VLMs, and traditional OCR pipelines. This taxonomy is central to the paper’s argument because it roughly orders systems by the strength of their language prior. General VLMs have broad multimodal and text pretraining and are most likely to hallucinate corrections. OCR-specialized VLMs are constrained by document extraction fine-tuning. Traditional OCR systems operate much closer to character recognition and have little generative prior. The authors also avoid adding anti-correction instructions to the prompt, so the model’s default behavior is exposed rather than suppressed.

Beyond aggregate error rates, the paper probes Qwen3-VL-4B layer by layer. The mechanistic claim is that rewriting tends to occur when the internal representation of a perturbed word remains close to the representation of the original clean word. They also report a word-length effect: short words are much more likely to be rewritten than longer ones.
summary_en.experiments:
The benchmark contains 1,455 single-page documents across English, Chinese, and Korean, and the evaluation covers 15 systems. The main result is clean and consistent: general-purpose VLMs degrade the most under perturbation, with up to 4.5 WER points on English; OCR-specialized VLMs degrade by about 0.2 to 2 points; traditional OCR pipelines degrade by less than 0.6 points. This strongly supports the paper’s central claim that stronger language priors increase the risk of sacrificing faithfulness on imperfect text.

A particularly important finding is the non-local effect. Corrupting only around 5% of words can increase errors on the untouched remainder by 5–10x relative to the clean baseline for general VLMs. That means the issue is not just local character confusion. The model’s page-level generation process is being pulled toward a different textual interpretation, which is much more concerning for unified document models.

The multilingual results are also informative. The same qualitative pattern holds across English, Chinese, and Korean, but the most damaging perturbation type differs by script. This suggests that rewriting is shaped both by language priors and by script-specific visual and tokenization structure. The probing analysis on Qwen3-VL-4B further shows that rewriting is more likely when the perturbed token remains representationally close to the original word. The word-length analysis reports rewriting rates of up to about 10% for short 4–6 character words, dropping to 0% beyond 7 characters.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a solid skim-to-medium-depth read. Start with the introduction to understand that the target property is faithfulness, not ordinary OCR score. Then read the benchmark construction carefully: why the perturbed text is treated as ground truth, and what each perturbation family is intended to isolate. In the main results, focus on degradation relative to the clean condition rather than absolute clean performance. The most important section after that is the non-local effect analysis, because it shows the problem is not merely local recognition noise but a broader generation bias. Finally, read the Qwen3-VL-4B probing and word-length analysis to see when rewriting is triggered.

If you only have 25–35 minutes, read the task definition, FaithC4 construction, main result tables, the non-local-effect figure, and the probing section. If you want to go deeper, the useful follow-up questions are: whether this behavior can be corrected by training objectives rather than prompts, whether OCR-specialized VLM gains come mainly from data or decoding constraints, and how native multimodal pretraining should balance semantic recovery against literal fidelity.

recommendation.zh: 这篇的价值不在 OCR，而在它把 VLM 的“看见”与“补全”混淆测得很干净；做原生多模态预训练的人应重点看 benchmark 设计和 Qwen3-VL 的层分析。
recommendation.en: The point is not OCR but a clean measurement of when VLMs confuse seeing with language completion; if you work on native multimodal pretraining, read the benchmark design and the Qwen3-VL layer analysis.

paper.title: Marking the Wrong Symptoms: Evaluating LLM Watermarks in Medical Texts
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into clinical workflows, stressing the need for reliable traceability of model-generated output with watermarking. Yet, most watermarks are evaluated on general-purpose benchmarks, leaving domains like medicine, where small token-level perturbations can result in significant semantic changes, underexplored. In this work, we present the first rigorous study of how LLM watermarks affect medical performance, benchmarking 5 watermarking scheme

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM水印效果评估均基于通用领域基准和困惑度等粗粒度指标，未覆盖医学这类高风险场景——医学输出对推理逻辑、术语精度、数值准确性要求极高，token级微小扰动就可能改变临床语义，水印对医学场景下模型实际性能的影响缺乏系统研究。
summary.importance: 该研究揭示了水印的隐性影响：生成阶段的采样修改可以在不改变选择题准确率的前提下，显著劣化底层推理质量。这提示预训练/对齐阶段若要集成水印机制，不能仅依赖粗粒度准确率指标，需要额外关注领域特定的推理完整性、术语精度，尤其在医疗等容错率极低的垂直场景。
summary.technical_approach: 覆盖5类主流生成式水印方案（KGW软logit偏置、DipMark CDF重加权、AAR Gumbel-max采样、PPL困惑度预算argmax、SynthID锦标赛采样），在11个LLM和7个VLM上开展测试，基准包括纯文本医学问答MedQA和多模态医学问答MedXpertQA-MM。引入经临床专家验证的LLM-as-judge审计流水线，从推理质量、术语精度、幻觉率三个维度评估，而非仅统计答案选项正确率。
summary.experiments: 核心发现包括三点：第一，水印基本不影响选择题准确率，但会显著破坏推理：Phi-4-14B搭配SynthID时，答案正确但推理错误的比例从11.4%升至26.3%，捏造医学实体的比例最多提升39.2个百分点；在水印与无水印均答对的问题中，最高40%的推理包含互斥的诊断表述。第二，多模态场景下水印会削弱视觉 grounding能力，抑制正确的图像相关结论、放大矛盾结论。第三，对推理模型的思维链加水印会使输出长度最多增加69%且推理质量下降，仅对最终可见答案加水印则可保留推理性能。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注第3节评估流水线设计（尤其是临床专家验证的judge指标构建逻辑）和第4节核心实验发现（推理质量退化、多模态影响、推理模型水印位置的取舍），附录中临床专家验证细节可按需查阅，预计阅读时间20-30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM watermark evaluations rely on general-domain benchmarks and coarse metrics like perplexity, but high-stakes domains such as medicine require precise reasoning, terminological accuracy, and numerical correctness where minor token-level perturbations can alter clinical meaning. The actual impact of text watermarking on LLM/VLM performance in clinical settings remains uncharacterized.
summary_en.importance: This work reveals a hidden cost of watermarking: sampling modifications during generation can substantially degrade underlying reasoning quality without affecting surface-level multiple-choice accuracy. For pretraining and alignment pipelines that integrate watermarking, this means coarse accuracy metrics are insufficient — domain-specific reasoning integrity and terminological precision must be explicitly evaluated, especially for low-tolerance vertical use cases like healthcare.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study benchmarks 5 prominent generation-time watermarking schemes (KGW soft logit bias, DipMark CDF reweighting, AAR Gumbel-max sampling, PPL perplexity-budgeted argmax, SynthID tournament sampling) across 11 LLMs and 7 VLMs, using two medical benchmarks: MedQA (text-only clinical multiple choice) and MedXpertQA-MM (multimodal reasoning with radiology/pathology images). It introduces a clinician-validated LLM-as-judge pipeline to audit reasoning quality, terminological precision, and hallucination rates, rather than measuring only answer selection accuracy.
summary_en.experiments: Three key findings emerge: First, watermarking leaves multiple-choice accuracy largely unchanged but degrades reasoning substantially. On Phi-4-14B with SynthID, the share of correct answers paired with flawed reasoning rises from 11.4% to 26.3%, and fabricated medical entities increase by up to 39.2 percentage points. Up to 40% of questions answered correctly under both settings rely on mutually exclusive diagnostic statements. Second, in multimodal settings, watermarking impairs visual grounding, suppressing correct image-based claims and amplifying contradicted ones. Third, for reasoning models, watermarking the chain-of-thought trace inflates output length by up to 69% and reduces reasoning quality, while restricting watermarks to the final visible answer preserves reasoning performance.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim read, focus on Section 3 (evaluation pipeline design, especially the clinician-validated judge metric construction) and Section 4 (core findings on reasoning degradation, multimodal impact, and watermark placement tradeoffs for reasoning models). Appendix details on clinician validation can be reviewed as needed. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 把 watermark 的代价从“困惑度/可检测”落到“语义与风险”上，评测视角更干净；只读失败模式分类和专家审计流程就够用。
recommendation.en: It cleanly shifts watermark evaluation from detectability/perplexity to semantic and risk-centric failures; skim the failure taxonomy and the expert-audit protocol.

paper.title: Geo3R: Mitigating Spatial Reasoning Hallucination in Multimodal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Despite remarkable progress in visual understanding, Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) remain prone to hallucinations when reasoning about spatial relationships, often producing judgments that contradict the true 3D structure of the scene. Though several existing works have proposed to mitigate hallucinations, our analysis indicates that they show limited effectiveness in spatial reasoning, as they fail to bridge the fundamental gap between 2D visual representations and 3D spatial reality

summary.core_problem: 研究 MLLM 在空间关系判断中产生与真实 3D 场景结构矛盾的幻觉，并尝试用几何证据降低这类错误。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是多模态幻觉分析与训练无关的缓解方法。它把空间结构建模不足导致的错误单独定义为 spatial reasoning hallucination，并指出透视效应、物体朝向、视角变化是高发场景。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Geo3R，一个 training-free、plug-and-play 框架，将外部几何证据和结构信息接入 MLLM 推理过程。方法重点不是重新训练 VLM，而是在推理侧补充 3D 相关约束，弥补 2D 视觉表征到 3D 空间现实之间的缺口。
summary.experiments: 摘要称已有幻觉缓解方法在空间推理场景效果有限，并用 Geo3R 进行缓解；题面未给出具体模型规模、数据集、指标和提升幅度，实验可信度需要看正文中的场景构造和失败案例覆盖。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets spatial-reasoning hallucinations in MLLMs, where predicted relations contradict the underlying 3D scene structure.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is mainly a multimodal hallucination analysis plus a training-free mitigation framework. It separates spatial reasoning hallucination from generic relation hallucination and highlights perspective effects, object orientation, and viewpoint changes as recurring failure modes.
summary_en.technical_approach: Geo3R is proposed as a plug-and-play inference-time framework that injects geometric evidence and structural cues into MLLM reasoning. The method does not retrain the VLM; it tries to compensate for the gap between 2D visual representations and 3D spatial reality.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that existing hallucination mitigation methods have limited effectiveness for spatial reasoning and that Geo3R improves this setting. The provided excerpt does not include model sizes, datasets, metrics, or effect sizes, so the experimental setup needs inspection in the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 只看错误 taxonomy 和案例即可；方法偏推理侧补丁，对基座预训练的动作信号很弱。
recommendation.en: Read the failure taxonomy and examples only; the method is an inference-side patch with weak signal for base pretraining.

paper.title: PhantomFill: When the Form Demands an Answer, Language Models Invent One
paper.abstract: Language models in production do not write prose. They fill forms: JSON fields, function arguments, extraction templates. We show that the form itself causes hallucination.   We ask thirteen models the same question about the same input and change only the answer format. The inputs are built so the question cannot be answered: a viral post showing 12,400 likes but no visible replies, a support ticket whose call was never transcribed. In free text, GPT-5.5 answers honestly. It says there is no re

summary.core_problem: 论文研究结构化输出格式如何诱导模型在证据不足时编造答案。核心变量不是问题、输入或模型能力，而是输出 schema 是否给模型留下可拒答的槽位。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练方法没有直接贡献，但对 post-training、评测和工具调用训练很有启发。很多安全与诚实性评测允许模型用自然语言拒答，而生产环境常要求 JSON、function arguments 或抽取模板。论文显示，自然语言中的 abstention 能力不一定迁移到无逃生选项的结构化字段，尤其是 closed-vocabulary enum。这会影响 SFT/RL 数据设计、schema 设计、tool-use 评测，以及模型在抽取任务中的幻觉测量。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 Abstention-Affordance Ladder。每个样本保持输入和问题不变，只改变输出形式：第一层是自由文本，模型可以自然拒答；第二层是带 escape 的 JSON schema，例如 enum 允许 insufficient_evidence，string/array 允许 null；第三层是 required JSON schema，要求填 closed-vocabulary sentiment、最小数量数组、代表性 quote 等字段，且没有拒答槽位。数据被构造成“不可回答”：例如社交帖子只有点赞和回复数，没有回复文本；客服工单有元数据，但电话未转写。因此任何关于群体情绪、回复主题、客户原话的具体说法都可由规则判为编造，不依赖 LLM-as-judge。指标包括 CFR，即 required schema 下的 coerced fabrication rate；EUR，即带 escape schema 下的 escape utilization rate；以及格式违规率。
summary.experiments: 论文测试 13 个模型，每个矩阵单元 n=40。GPT-5.5 在自由文本中面对无回复文本的帖子，98% 会说明没有证据；但在 required sentiment schema 下 40/40 编造。九个开源模型，参数量从 0.8B 到 26B，和 GPT-5.5 在 required-field rung 上都达到 100% fabrication。带 escape 的 schema 只稳定帮助了 GPT-5.5 和 Claude Opus；九个开源模型仍有 60% 到 100% 编造，Claude Sonnet 为 90%。额外系统指令能把自由文本编造率从 39% 降到 4%，但在 required schema 下，对 6 个测试模型中的 4 个没有效果。字段级结果也很关键：GPT-5.5 对 required sentiment enum 20/20 编造，但对 required quote string 0/20 编造，倾向在字符串里写免责声明。这说明 enum 这类无 hedge 空间的字段风险更高。论文还观察到领域依赖，例如 Sonnet 会对 crowd sentiment 编造，但在 customer call 场景中拒绝编造。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。先看 Abstention-Affordance Ladder 的实验设计，因为它把格式压力作为唯一变量控制住了。再看 CFR/EUR 的定义和自动评分方式，判断指标是否适合自己的 tool-use 或抽取评测。结果部分建议重点看三类对比：free text vs JSON required、带 escape vs 不带 escape、enum vs string。若做 SFT/RL 数据，应重点关注系统指令失效和 escape-hatch 设计，这两点直接影响结构化输出训练样本的标注规范。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a specific failure mode in structured generation: when the input does not contain enough evidence, a schema with required fields and no abstention option can push a model to invent values. The causal factor under test is the answer format, not the question or the source document.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation and post-training signal paper rather than a pretraining contribution. It matters because many honesty evaluations are conducted in free text, while deployed models often produce JSON, function-call arguments, or extraction records. The results suggest that abstention behavior learned in prose does not reliably transfer to constrained schemas, especially closed-vocabulary fields. This has direct implications for SFT/RL data, tool-use benchmarks, extraction pipelines, and schema design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce the Abstention-Affordance Ladder. Each item keeps the document and question fixed while varying only the output format: free-form prose, JSON with explicit escape values such as insufficient_evidence or null, and required JSON fields with no escape path. The examples are constructed so that the requested information is absent by design: a social-media post has engagement counts but no visible replies, and a support ticket has call metadata but no transcript. Any concrete claim about reply sentiment, reply themes, customer complaints, or verbatim quotes is therefore a fabrication by construction. This enables deterministic scoring without a judge model. The main metrics are coerced fabrication rate under required schemas, escape utilization rate when an escape is available, and format-violation rate.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates 13 models with n = 40 trials per matrix cell. GPT-5.5 declines in free text 98% of the time for the no-reply social-post setting, but fabricates 40 out of 40 times when a required sentiment field is imposed. All nine tested open-weight models, ranging from 0.8B to 26B parameters, and GPT-5.5 reach 100% fabrication under the required-field condition. Escape fields help GPT-5.5 and mostly help Claude Opus, but the open models still fabricate at 60% to 100%, and Claude Sonnet fabricates at 90%. A system instruction forbidding sentiment inference reduces free-text fabrication from 39% to 4%, yet has no effect under required schemas for four of six tested models. Field-level analysis is especially informative: GPT-5.5 fabricates a required sentiment enum 20 out of 20 times, while it avoids fabricating a required quote string by placing disclaimers inside the string. The failure is also domain-dependent; for example, Sonnet behaves differently on crowd-reaction and customer-call settings.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25–35 minute skim is appropriate. Start with the ladder design, since it cleanly isolates format pressure. Then inspect the metric definitions for CFR and EUR, as they are useful for building structured-output evaluations. The most useful result tables are the comparisons between prose and required JSON, escape-enabled and escape-free schemas, and enum versus string fields. For post-training work, focus on the sections showing that prompt-level instructions can disappear under schema pressure and that explicit escape values need to be part of the schema, not just the natural-language instruction.

recommendation.zh: 改变对结构化输出安全性的认知，必填字段会强制模型编造，做SFT和推理时schema设计必须加显式空值分支，重点看§3控制变量实验。
