summary.core_problem: 解决 MLLM 在细粒度视觉感知中，即使输入保留局部细节，也无法稳定选择并使用关键局部证据的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM/MLLM 训练方法创新，提出“visual context rot”这个诊断，并把细粒度感知瓶颈从分辨率不足转向局部证据搜索失败；对 native multimodal pretraining 和视觉 token 使用效率有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: LOCUS 在训练时提供一个 local crop 作为 visual cue，并要求模型在完整图像中恢复该局部证据的位置；训练信号是基于 IoU 的 reward。这个 cue 只在训练时使用，推理时仍保持标准 image-question 接口，目标是让模型内化局部证据搜索策略。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在细粒度感知、幻觉、通用理解和推理 benchmark 上验证，提升 localization-sensitive visual understanding，同时保持广泛能力；还做了 attention analysis，显示模型更会关注局部线索。摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据量、baseline 名称和具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a failure mode where MLLMs cannot reliably select and use decisive local visual evidence for fine-grained perception, even when the image contains the required details.
summary_en.importance: This is a VLM/MLLM training-method contribution. Its useful framing is “visual context rot”: the bottleneck is not only input resolution, but failure to search and bind local evidence. That is relevant to native multimodal pretraining and visual token utilization.
summary_en.technical_approach: LOCUS provides a local crop as a visual cue during training and optimizes the model to recover its spatial support in the full image using an IoU-based reward. The cue is removed at inference time, preserving the standard image-question interface while encouraging the model to internalize local evidence search.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports evaluations across fine-grained perception, hallucination, general understanding, and reasoning benchmarks. LOCUS improves localization-sensitive visual understanding while preserving broader capabilities, with attention analyses suggesting stronger focus on local evidence. Model size, data scale, baselines, and numerical gains are not given in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和 attention 分析；若效果成立，它把细粒度 VLM 的瓶颈从分辨率改写成证据检索。
recommendation.en: Read the method and attention analysis; if the results hold, it reframes fine-grained VLM failure as evidence search, not resolution.

paper.title: Authority, Truth, and Citation Bias: A Large-Scale Multi-Domain Benchmark for Studying Epistemic Susceptibility in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed in citation-augmented settings, yet the effect of citation presence on model behavior independent of factual content remains poorly understood. We introduce AuthorityBench, a 220,564-prompt multi-domain benchmark that isolates how citation-based authority signals influence epistemic behavior in LLMs. The benchmark uses a fully balanced 2x2 factorial design crossing claim veracity with citation veracity, the first to do so, across four domains (gene

summary.core_problem: 构造一个评测来隔离“引用看起来权威”这一信号本身如何改变 LLM 对事实真假的判断和幻觉行为。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Benchmark 和评测协议：AuthorityBench 用大规模平衡实验设计把 claim 真伪和 citation 真伪解耦，直接测量模型对权威线索的认识论脆弱性；这对 RAG、引用增强回答、后训练偏好数据和事实性评测都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是 2x2 factorial design：同时控制 claim veracity 与 citation veracity，并加入无引用 baseline。数据覆盖 general knowledge、science、law、medicine 四个领域，包含 40 个 prompt templates、四档 venue prestige、带国家编码的作者姓名变量，尽量把“引用存在感”“引用真实性”“命题真实性”“声望线索”分开测。
summary.experiments: Benchmark 规模为 220,564 个 prompts，评测 7 个模型和 12 个结构化研究问题。主要发现是：无论引用真实还是伪造，引用存在都会相对无引用 baseline 提高幻觉率；当真实命题搭配伪造引用时，幻觉率上升最明显，幅度为 3 到 22 个百分点。

summary_en.core_problem: The benchmark isolates how citation-based authority cues, independent of factual content, change LLM truth judgments and hallucination behavior.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an evaluation asset and protocol. AuthorityBench decouples claim veracity from citation veracity, making it useful for studying citation-augmented generation, RAG-style interfaces, factuality training, and post-training reward design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark uses a balanced 2x2 factorial design crossing true versus false claims with true versus fabricated citations, plus a no-citation baseline. It spans general knowledge, science, law, and medicine, with controlled prompt templates, venue prestige tiers, and country-coded author-name variation.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset contains 220,564 prompts and evaluates seven models across 12 structured research questions. The reported finding is that citation presence, whether real or fabricated, consistently increases hallucination relative to no citation; fabricated citations attached to true claims raise hallucination by 3 to 22 percentage points.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验设计和 hallucination 分解表；它会提醒你别把“带引用”当作事实性 reward 的干净信号。
recommendation.en: Read the design and hallucination breakdown; it is a useful warning against treating citation presence as a clean factuality reward signal.

paper.title: Mitigating Manifold Departure: Uncertainty-Aware Subspace Rectification for Trustworthy MLLM Decoding
paper.abstract: MLLMs frequently hallucinate objects inconsistent with visual inputs. This issue is typically attributed to the over-reliance on language priors, which can override the visual context. Recent training-free decoding strategies address this by penalizing language priors. However, these methods overlook the dual nature of language priors, where they can be both helpful and harmful depending on the alignment with visual evidence. In particular, blindly suppressing language priors often disrupts the

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 MLLM 解码阶段的目标幻觉，但切入点不是再做一轮“更强的对比解码”，而是解释为什么很多 training-free 抑制方法会在减幻觉的同时伤害正常描述。作者把问题表述为：语言先验并不总是有害；当视觉证据充分且与文本先验一致时，先验会帮助模型稳定生成。现有线性抑制方法把先验当成统一噪声做全局减法，容易把隐藏状态从正常解码的高密度语义区域推离，导致描述能力下降。作者把这个几何失效模式命名为 Manifold Departure，并据此设计只在“先验子空间”内做选择性衰减的解码干预。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身的直接贡献有限，它主要是一个 MLLM 推理期校正方法。但有两个点对预训练研究仍有启发。第一，它把“语言先验过强”从经验现象推进到表示空间几何问题，说明解码干预若不尊重隐藏状态流形，容易破坏模型已经学到的语义结构。第二，它把 hallucination 缓解从 logit 级别的统一减法，改成 hidden-state 级别的子空间选择性控制，这种思路对后续研究预训练阶段的表示解耦、模态冲突诊断、以及是否能在训练中显式塑造‘安全干预方向’有参考价值。整体看，更像一篇有想法的 decoding paper，而不是会直接改变预训练 recipe 的工作。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 MGAP，Manifold-Guided Adaptive Projection。它分三步。第一步，估计语言先验子空间。作者构造 blind hidden states，也就是在缺失或弱化视觉条件时模型产生的隐藏状态，把这些状态视作语言先验较强的样本集合，然后对其做 SVD，提取一个低秩 prior subspace。这个设计的含义是：不去假设先验是一个固定偏置向量，而是承认先验在表示空间里更像一个低维方向簇。

第二步，在每个解码步把当前隐藏状态分解为子空间内分量和正交分量。只有投影到 prior subspace 的那一部分会被干预，正交部分尽量保留。这样做是为了避免传统方法那种对整个表示做平移，连与视觉一致的语义成分也一起削弱。

第三步，自适应衰减。作者不是固定强度地压制 prior component，而是先检测 vision-language conflict，再决定衰减幅度。冲突越强，prior 分量衰减越多；若视觉与语言一致，则尽量少动。这一点对应论文一开始强调的“先验有双重作用”。

论文还给出一个流形视角的分析框架。作者用正常解码得到的 hidden-state bank 近似 semantic manifold，并用 kNN 距离定义 off-manifoldness score。若某种干预后隐藏状态的 kNN 距离显著增大，就认为发生了 manifold departure。这个定义不算严格理论证明，但作为诊断工具是清楚的：它把‘为什么减幻觉会伤 fluency 和 fidelity’变成了可观测量。

和已有方法相比，差异主要有三点。其一，干预位置从 logits 转到 hidden states。其二，干预形状从全局线性减法变成子空间投影后的局部修正。其三，干预强度从固定系数变成冲突感知的自适应系数。代价是需要额外构建参考 hidden bank、估计子空间，并在解码时做投影与邻域统计，工程上比简单 contrastive decoding 更重一些。
summary.experiments:
实验主要在 POPE 和 CHAIR 上，目标是看 hallucination 缓解与描述保真之间的 trade-off。全文给出的结论是，MGAP 相比几类 training-free baseline 能更稳定地降低幻觉，同时较少损伤正常描述质量。作者反复强调的不是单点最优，而是 Pareto trade-off 更好：在相近的幻觉抑制强度下，MGAP 保留更多语义 fidelity；或者在相近描述质量下，MGAP 能进一步压低 hallucination 指标。

从消融看，几个部件都不是可有可无。去掉 prior subspace，只做整体抑制，会更容易出现 manifold departure；去掉 adaptive conflict gating，方法会退化成较硬的统一压制，在视觉一致样本上损失更明显；若不在 hidden-state 层面做分解，而回到 logit-level bias subtraction，几何优势会减弱。论文还展示了 off-manifoldness score 与生成退化之间的相关性，支持它提出的诊断框架。

需要说明的是，给定你提供的全文片段里没有完整表格数字、模型规模和所有超参，我不能可靠复述具体百分点提升、rank 维度、bank 大小等精确数值。能确认的是：实验重点不是大规模训练，而是多个现有 MLLM 上的 training-free decoding 对比；评价维度围绕 object hallucination、caption fidelity，以及作者定义的 manifold departure 指标展开。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读即可，重点看三处。第一是 Introduction 和方法动机图，先把“language prior 既可能帮忙也可能添乱”这个前提吃透，否则会把它误读成普通的 prior suppression。第二是 Section 3.3 附近关于 Manifold Departure 的定义和 Figure 3，这部分是全文最有信息量的地方，它解释了作者为什么坚持在 hidden-state 子空间里做干预。第三是方法章节里 prior subspace 的构造、投影分解和 adaptive attenuation 公式，再配合消融表看每个模块的作用。

预计 20 到 30 分钟可以抓住主线。如果只关心是否值得跟进，不必深究所有几何表述；重点判断两件事：一是 blind states 学到的子空间是否真的稳定、可迁移；二是这种 hidden-level intervention 是否能推广到更强的多模态模型或训练期正则化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies object hallucination in MLLM decoding, but the real target is narrower and more interesting than generic hallucination reduction. It asks why many training-free suppression methods reduce hallucinations yet also damage normal generation. The authors argue that language priors are not uniformly harmful: when visual evidence is weak or conflicting, priors can cause hallucinations; when vision and language agree, the same priors stabilize and sharpen decoding. Existing linear suppression methods treat priors as a global bias to subtract, which can push hidden states away from the high-density region of normal decoding. The paper names this failure mode Manifold Departure and proposes a decoding intervention that only attenuates the prior-related subspace instead of shifting the whole representation.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining paper, and its direct impact on LLM pretraining is limited. Still, it carries two useful ideas for foundation-model researchers. First, it reframes over-reliance on language priors as a representation-geometry issue rather than only a calibration issue. Second, it moves the intervention from logits to hidden-state subspaces, suggesting that safe control of multimodal generation may require respecting the learned semantic manifold. That perspective could matter for future work on representation disentanglement, modality-conflict diagnostics, or even training-time objectives that make intervention directions cleaner. In short, it is more relevant as a decoding/representation paper than as a new pretraining recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method is MGAP, short for Manifold-Guided Adaptive Projection. It has three main components.

First, it estimates a language-prior subspace. The authors collect blind hidden states, meaning hidden states produced when visual information is removed or weakened, and treat them as samples dominated by language priors. They then run SVD on this bank and extract a low-rank prior subspace. This is a meaningful departure from prior work: instead of assuming priors are a single bias vector, the paper models them as a low-dimensional subspace in representation space.

Second, at each decoding step, the current hidden state is decomposed into two parts: the component inside the prior subspace and the orthogonal residual. Only the projected prior component is modified. The orthogonal component is preserved as much as possible. This is the key mechanism for avoiding the blunt global translation used by logit-level suppression methods.

Third, the attenuation is adaptive. MGAP does not always suppress the prior component with the same strength. It first detects vision-language conflict, then scales the suppression accordingly. Strong conflict leads to stronger attenuation; aligned vision-language evidence leads to weaker intervention. This directly matches the paper’s claim that priors have a dual role.

The paper also introduces a manifold-based diagnostic view. A bank of hidden states from normal decoding is used as a proxy for the semantic manifold, and kNN distance defines an off-manifoldness score. If an intervention increases this score substantially, the hidden state is considered to have departed from the manifold. This is not a formal theorem, but it is a useful empirical diagnostic for explaining why some hallucination-mitigation methods hurt fluency and fidelity.

Relative to prior training-free baselines, the differences are clear: intervention at hidden states instead of logits, subspace-selective modification instead of global subtraction, and conflict-aware adaptive scaling instead of a fixed suppression coefficient. The trade-off is extra machinery: a reference hidden-state bank, subspace estimation, and projection during decoding.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are centered on POPE and CHAIR, with the main goal being the trade-off between hallucination reduction and descriptive fidelity. The paper’s main empirical claim is not just a better single operating point, but a better trade-off curve: at similar hallucination levels, MGAP preserves more faithful description; at similar fidelity levels, it reduces hallucinations more than prior training-free baselines.

The ablations support the design choices. Removing the prior subspace and applying global suppression makes manifold departure more likely. Removing adaptive conflict gating turns the method into a harder uniform suppression scheme and hurts visually aligned cases more. Moving back from hidden-state intervention to logit-level bias subtraction weakens the geometric advantage. The paper also shows that the proposed off-manifoldness score correlates with generation degradation, which supports the diagnostic framing.

One caveat: the provided full-content excerpt does not include the complete result tables, model sizes, or all hyperparameters, so I cannot safely restate exact gains, rank choices, or bank sizes. What is clear is that the evaluation is done as a training-free decoding comparison on existing MLLMs, with metrics covering object hallucination, caption fidelity, and the proposed manifold-departure analysis.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Focus on three parts. First, read the introduction and the motivation figure to internalize the paper’s central claim: language priors can be helpful or harmful depending on visual alignment. Without that, MGAP looks like another suppression trick. Second, read the section around the Manifold Departure definition and Figure 3. That is the most informative part of the paper because it explains why the authors intervene in hidden-state space. Third, read the method details for prior-subspace construction, projection, and adaptive attenuation, then check the ablations to see which component actually matters.

About 20 to 30 minutes should be enough to capture the main idea. If the goal is only to assess relevance, the two questions worth keeping in mind are whether the blind-state subspace is stable across models and whether hidden-level intervention could be turned into a training-time regularization idea.

recommendation.zh: 训练自由解码的几何化改造，思路干净但属推理侧小改进；看 §3 的子空间构造和门控公式就够了。
recommendation.en: A clean geometry-based training-free decoding tweak; read §3 for the subspace construction and gating formula, then move on.

paper.title: Steer Where It Matters: Token-Level Visual-Sensitivity Steering for LVLMs Hallucination Mitigation
paper.abstract: Large vision language models (LVLMs) have made rapid advancements and are deployed across various applications, yet hallucinations remain a major challenge. Activation steering is appealing due to its minimal training overhead and controllability at inference time. However, we found that during autoregressive decoding, visual conditioning affects token prediction sparsely and locally across decoding steps, and many existing methods that average image-versus-no-image differences over the entire s

summary.core_problem: LVLM 幻觉缓解中，现有 activation steering 往往用全序列平均的“有图-无图”差分方向，信噪比低且固定强度会误伤非关键 token；如何做更细粒度、稳定的视觉条件干预。
summary.importance: 提供一个可操作的诊断：视觉条件对 AR 解码的影响是稀疏且局部的；对 VLM 推理期控制/干预与“哪些 token 真在看图”的机制分析有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: TLVS：提取 token-level 的视觉敏感 steering 向量并做精炼，然后按 token 的视觉敏感度自适应分配 steering strength，在关键 token 上更强、非关键 token 上更弱以减少不稳定与副作用。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型与数据；宣称相较序列级平均 steering，在幻觉缓解上更有效且更稳定（需看正文具体基准与消融）。

summary_en.core_problem: Activation steering for LVLM hallucination mitigation often averages image-vs-no-image differences over the whole sequence (low SNR) and uses fixed strength (over-perturbing non-critical tokens); the paper targets token-level, stable visual interventions.
summary_en.importance: Offers a practical diagnostic: visual conditioning affects AR decoding sparsely and locally; useful for inference-time control and for analyzing which tokens truly depend on vision.
summary_en.technical_approach: TLVS extracts and refines token-level visual-sensitivity steering vectors, then applies sensitivity-aware, per-token adaptive steering strength to focus intervention budget on critical tokens and avoid instability.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract lacks model/dataset specifics; it claims improved hallucination mitigation and stability over sequence-averaged steering baselines (check paper for benchmarks/ablations).

recommendation.zh: 把“视觉影响是稀疏 token 事件”讲清楚了；只需看它的敏感度估计方法与自适应强度消融，别被总体指标带跑。
recommendation.en: The key is the 'vision influence is sparse across tokens' framing; read the sensitivity estimator and adaptive-strength ablations, not just aggregate scores.

paper.title: MechLens: Late Crystallization of Factual Knowledge Explains Intervention Effectiveness in Language Models
paper.abstract: Understanding where LLMs store factual knowledge is critical for hallucination mitigation. We systematically quantify Late Crystallization: factual knowledge does not gradually emerge across layers but "crystallizes" abruptly at the final layers. Across five model families (Pythia, Gemma, Qwen2.5, Llama-3.1, Mistral; 0.5--14B), 26.8%--93.4% of correct answers never enter top-10 predictions at any intermediate layer, with late emergence (>80% depth) consistent across architectures. Cross-scale (Q

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 LLM 的事实知识究竟在层间如何形成，并试图解释为什么某些基于层间干预的方法有效、某些无效。
summary.importance: 这是机制分析工作，但和训练、解码干预、幻觉缓解都有直接接口。它提出“Late Crystallization”这一更强的层间知识形成假设：事实答案不是逐层平滑浮现，而是在最后几层突然结晶。如果这个现象稳健，会改变我们对 logit lens、层编辑和早层可读性的很多默认认知。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在五个模型家族、0.5B 到 14B 范围内，用层级预测轨迹分析 factual answer 何时进入 top-k，统计正确答案是否在中间层出现以及首次出现深度。为避免普通 logit lens 的 probe artifact，论文使用 tuned lens 做控制，并加入情感分类任务作为非事实型对照。基于观察到的 late crystallization，作者进一步提出 crystallization-guided intervention 原则，用它解释并比较 CAA 与 DoLa 这类干预方法在不同模型上的效果差异。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Pythia、Gemma、Qwen2.5、Llama-3.1、Mistral 等家族，参数规模 0.5B-14B。关键结果是：26.8%-93.4% 的正确答案在任何中间层都从未进入 top-10，且首次出现常在网络深度 80% 之后；在 Qwen2.5-14B 和 MMLU 上也观察到一致现象。情感分类对照显著更早出现，说明该现象更偏 factual recall 而非普遍任务属性。干预实验中，CAA 在中等 crystallization 模型上优于 DoLa，而在高 crystallization 的 Qwen 上出现方向相反的结果，作者报告最高可有 25 个点量级的差异，但具体任务和指标需看正文确认。

summary_en.core_problem: This paper studies how factual knowledge forms across layers in LLMs and uses that analysis to explain why some layer-based interventions work while others do not.
summary_en.importance: It is a mechanism paper with direct implications for training-time interpretation, decoding interventions, and hallucination mitigation. The main proposal, Late Crystallization, is a stronger claim than the usual gradual-emergence picture: factual answers often do not become readable until the final layers. If robust, this updates several priors around logit lens, layer editing, and the interpretability of intermediate representations.
summary_en.technical_approach: The author tracks when the correct factual answer first enters top-k predictions across layers for five model families from 0.5B to 14B. To reduce ordinary logit-lens probe artifacts, the paper uses a tuned lens and includes sentiment classification as a non-factual control task. Based on the observed late crystallization pattern, it proposes a crystallization-guided intervention principle and uses it to explain differential behavior of methods such as CAA and DoLa across model families.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers Pythia, Gemma, Qwen2.5, Llama-3.1, and Mistral models from 0.5B to 14B. The headline result is that 26.8%-93.4% of correct answers never appear in the top-10 at any intermediate layer, and late emergence after 80% depth is common. The pattern also appears in Qwen2.5-14B and on MMLU. A sentiment-classification control shows much earlier emergence, suggesting the effect is specific to factual recall rather than a generic property of all tasks. In intervention experiments, CAA beats DoLa on moderately crystallized models, while the trend reverses on highly crystallized Qwen models, with the abstract mentioning differences up to roughly 25 points pending full-paper metric details.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会动到你对 logit-lens 和层编辑的 prior：先看 late-crystallization 的定义、tuned-lens 控制和 CAA/DoLa 反转结果；若 setup 干净，值得在内部做跨模型复核。
recommendation.en: This one can update your priors on logit-lens readability and layer interventions; focus on the late-crystallization definition, the tuned-lens control, and the CAA-vs-DoLa reversal, then decide whether to replicate across your own model families.

paper.title: How Many Counterfactuals Does It Take? Probing VLM Hallucinations Through Circuits and Causal Effects
paper.abstract: Visual Language Models (VLMs) are known to produce hallucinated predictions that are not grounded in visual evidence, yet existing approaches lack a principled understanding of how robust such predictions are under counterfactual perturbations. In this work, we study the sample complexity of counterfactual robustness for hallucinated outputs in VLMs. We define a causal influence metric based on log-probability differences between factual, counterfactual, and activation-patched runs, and use it t

summary.core_problem: 如何量化和理解视觉语言模型（VLMs）中幻觉预测在反事实扰动下的鲁棒性？
summary.importance: 提供了一种基于因果影响和电路发现的原则性方法，用于分析 VLM 幻觉的稳定性，并给出了检测不稳定性所需的反事实样本数量的经验界限。
summary.technical_approach: 定义了一个基于事实、反事实和激活修补运行之间对数概率差异的因果影响指标。利用电路发现技术（CD-T）识别负责幻觉预测的模型组件，并跟踪它们在反事实样本中的激活差异。使用浓度不等式和因果影响分布的方差估计，推导出可靠检测幻觉输出不稳定性所需的最小反事实样本数 $m$ 的经验界限。
summary.experiments: 未详细说明具体模型和数据集，但提出了理论界限和基于激活差异的分析方法。

summary_en.core_problem: How to quantify and understand the robustness of hallucinated predictions in Visual Language Models (VLMs) under counterfactual perturbations?
summary_en.importance: Provides a principled approach based on causal influence and circuit discovery to analyze the stability of VLM hallucinations, and derives empirical bounds on the number of counterfactual samples needed to detect instability.
summary_en.technical_approach: Defines a causal influence metric based on log-probability differences between factual, counterfactual, and activation-patched runs. Leverages circuit discovery techniques (CD-T) to identify model components responsible for hallucinations and tracks their activation differences across counterfactual samples. Derives empirical bounds on the minimum number of counterfactual samples $m$ required to reliably detect instability using concentration inequalities and variance estimates.
summary_en.experiments: Specific models and datasets are not detailed, but theoretical bounds and analysis methods based on activation differences are proposed.

recommendation.zh: 从因果推断和电路发现角度分析 VLM 幻觉机制，对理解多模态模型的内部表示有一定启发，建议关注其因果影响指标的设计。
recommendation.en: Analyzes VLM hallucination mechanisms from the perspective of causal inference and circuit discovery, providing insights into internal representations of multimodal models; the design of the causal influence metric is worth noting.

paper.title: Whisper Hallucination Detection and Mitigation via Hidden Representation Steering and Sparse AutoEncoders
paper.abstract: Whisper, a widely adopted ASR model, is known to suffer from hallucinations - coherent transcriptions generated for non-speech audio entirely disconnected from the input. We investigate whether hallucinations can be detected and mitigated through Whisper's internal representations. We extract audio encoder activations and evaluate two representation spaces: raw Whisper activations and Sparse AutoEncoder (SAE) latents. We show that both spaces encode linearly separable hallucination-related infor

summary.core_problem: Whisper 等端到端 ASR 模型会对非语音音频片段产生幻觉——生成流畅但与输入完全无关的转录文本。现有解决方法主要依赖输入预处理、文本后处理或微调特定神经元。本文核心问题是：能否通过模型内部隐藏表示来检测和缓解幻觉，而不需要修改模型权重？
summary.importance: 对预训练研究有两点启发：1）验证了稀疏自编码器（SAE）在语音模态上做机制性可解释性分析的可行性，证明幻觉相关信息在激活空间和 SAE 潜空间中均线性可分——这与 NLP 领域的 SAE 分析形成跨模态对照；2）提出的微调-free steering 策略对语音 LLM 训练数据管线有实际价值：Whisper 常被用于为 speech LLM 预训练生成 transcript，幻觉会直接污染训练数据。此外，ASR 幻觉与 LLM 幻觉在表现形式和干预方法上的异同值得对比研究。
summary.technical_approach: 分为检测和缓解两步。检测：提取 Whisper 编码器各层激活值，训练线性分类器区分幻觉输入与正常输入，对比原始激活空间和 SAE 潜空间的分类性能。缓解：提出两种推理时 steering 策略——激活空间 steering（直接在编码器激活上加减幻觉方向向量）和 SAE 潜空间 steering（在 SAE 稀疏潜向量上操作）。SAE 的优势是将稠密多义激活向量分解为稀疏的、更具可解释性的维度，理论上可更精准地定位幻觉相关特征。两种方法均不修改模型权重。
summary.experiments: 核心数字：Whisper small 在非语音数据集上原始幻觉率 72.63%，SAE-based steering 降至 14.11%。实验覆盖两个 Whisper 模型变体、多个非语音/语音数据集、两种语言。关键发现：1）分类性能随编码器层数加深而提升；2）幻觉相关信息集中在稀疏特征子集；3）SAE steering 始终优于原始激活 steering；4）存在幻觉减少与 ASR 指标保持之间的系统性权衡。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，20-30 分钟。重点看 Introduction（ASR 幻觉定义和动机背景）、Background（SAE 和 steering 的基础知识复习）、实验部分的三类图表——hallucination rate 对比表、不同层分类准确率曲线、steering 强度 vs ASR 性能的权衡曲线。SAE 训练细节和 steering 向量具体计算方法可快速浏览。

summary_en.core_problem: End-to-end ASR models like Whisper produce hallucinations — fluent but completely irrelevant transcriptions — for non-speech audio segments. Existing solutions rely on input preprocessing, text post-processing, or fine-tuning specific neurons. This paper asks: can we detect and mitigate hallucinations using the model's internal hidden representations, without modifying model weights?
summary_en.importance: Two implications for pretraining research: 1) Validates the feasibility of Sparse AutoEncoder (SAE) based mechanistic interpretability in the speech modality, showing hallucination-related information is linearly separable in both activation and SAE latent spaces — a cross-modal parallel to NLP SAE studies. 2) The proposed fine-tuning-free steering strategy is practically relevant for speech LLM training pipelines: Whisper transcripts are commonly used to generate training data for speech LLMs, and hallucinations directly corrupt pretraining data. The parallels and differences between ASR hallucinations and LLM hallucinations are also worth comparative study.
summary_en.technical_approach: Two-stage pipeline: detection and mitigation. Detection: extract encoder activations across layers, train linear classifiers to distinguish hallucination-prone inputs from normal inputs, comparing raw activation space vs SAE latent space. Mitigation: two inference-time steering strategies — activation-space steering (adding/subtracting hallucination direction vectors to encoder activations) and SAE latent-space steering (operating on SAE sparse latent vectors). SAEs decompose dense polysemantic activations into sparse, more interpretable dimensions, theoretically enabling more precise targeting of hallucination-related features. Neither method modifies model weights.
summary_en.experiments: Key metric: Whisper small hallucination rate reduced from 72.63% to 14.11% via SAE-based steering on non-speech datasets. Experiments span two Whisper model variants, multiple non-speech/speech datasets, and two languages. Key findings: 1) Classification performance improves with deeper encoder layers; 2) Hallucination-related information concentrates in a sparse feature subset; 3) SAE steering consistently outperforms raw activation steering; 4) There is a systematic trade-off between hallucination reduction and ASR metric preservation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level, 20-30 minutes. Focus on Introduction (ASR hallucination definition and motivation), Background (SAE and steering fundamentals), and three types of experimental figures — hallucination rate comparison tables, per-layer classification accuracy curves, and steering strength vs ASR performance trade-off plots. SAE training details and steering vector computation can be browsed quickly.

recommendation.zh: 把“幻觉”落到可线性分离的稀疏特征并可 steering，这个结论值得复现；重点看层深趋势和 SAE 介入是否真比直接激活干预稳。
recommendation.en: Worth replicating: hallucination maps to linearly separable sparse features and is steerable; focus on depth trends and whether SAE interventions are genuinely more stable than raw-activation steering.

paper.title: Diagnosing Visual Ignorance in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) frequently rely on language priors, producing confident answers that are weakly grounded in visual evidence. While this behavior is widely observed, its internal mechanisms and its impact on benchmark evaluation remain insufficiently understood. In this work, we study language-prior reliance from both mechanistic and behavioral perspectives. Internally, we combine counterfactual layer replacement with supervised layer-wise MLP probing to trace how ground-truth visua

summary.core_problem: 探究视觉-语言模型（VLMs）为何过度依赖语言先验而忽视视觉证据，并提出量化这种‘视觉忽视’的指标。
summary.importance: 机制分析。结合内部表征探测和外部行为测试，揭示了 VLM 在解码过程中视觉信号被语言偏置压制的动态过程，为理解 VLM 幻觉提供了机制层面的解释。
summary.technical_approach: 内部机制：结合反事实层替换和逐层 MLP 探测，追踪视觉语义和语言先验在语言解码器中的竞争。外部行为：提出基于多步高斯模糊的渐进式视觉衰减指标，识别即使视觉内容被破坏答案仍保持不变的实例。
summary.experiments: 未详细说明模型规模和数据集，但通过内部探测和外部模糊测试，证实了 VLM 存在多阶段瓶颈：中间层未能有效检索视觉信息，而后期层进一步抑制视觉信号以偏向文本空间偏差。

summary_en.core_problem: Investigating why Vision-Language Models (VLMs) over-rely on language priors and ignore visual evidence, and proposing a metric to quantify this 'visual ignorance'.
summary_en.importance: Mechanism analysis. By combining internal representation probing and external behavioral testing, it reveals the dynamic process of visual signals being suppressed by language biases during decoding, providing a mechanistic explanation for VLM hallucinations.
summary_en.technical_approach: Internal mechanism: Combines counterfactual layer replacement with supervised layer-wise MLP probing to trace the competition between visual semantics and language priors across the language decoder. External behavior: Introduces a progressive visual decay metric based on multi-step Gaussian blurring to identify instances where answers remain invariant even as visual content is destroyed.
summary_en.experiments: Model scale and datasets are not detailed, but through internal probing and external blurring tests, it confirms a multi-stage bottleneck: intermediate layers fail to retrieve visual info, while later layers suppress visual signals in favor of text biases.

recommendation.zh: 作为 VLM 幻觉机制的 literature 备查，揭示了视觉信号在 decoder 中后期被语言先验压制的现象，可作为改进 VLM 架构或 loss 的动机。
recommendation.en: Good for literature review on VLM hallucination mechanisms; reveals visual signals are suppressed by language priors in later decoder layers, motivating architecture or loss improvements.

paper.title: What's in a Name? Morphological Shortcuts by LLMs in Pharmacology
paper.abstract: The morphological form of a word can often give cues to its meaning, but purely relying on these mappings can lead to overgeneralization in high-stakes domains. In the medical domain, for instance, LLMs can confidently reason about fictitious drugs from their affixes alone (e.g., wugcillin) and generate plausible-looking clinical content. We present a behavioral and mechanistic study of LLM "affix heuristics" in pharmacology. Using fictitious drug names built from real affixes, we show that affi

summary.core_problem: 研究 LLM 在药理学名词理解中是否过度依赖词缀形态线索，从而对虚构药名也生成看似合理但错误的语义与推理。
summary.importance: 这是行为分析加机制分析工作。虽然场景在医学药理，但核心问题是 tokenizer/词形模式与语义捷径学习，对理解语言模型如何把表面形态映射成概念有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构造带真实 affix 的虚构药名，测试模型是否仅凭词缀就给出药物类别级反应；再提出一个框架，区分模型语义判断主要来自 affix、stem 还是完整词形。随后在 653 个真实药物上分析这种依赖，并用 activation patching 定位 affix heuristic 的内部表征位置。
summary.experiments: 覆盖 653 个药物，并跨多个模型做行为与 activation patching 分析。摘要显示模型常主要由 affix 诱导药物含义，却很少显式承认这种依赖，还会把共享 affix 的药物属性混淆。没有看到与预训练数据或 tokenizer 设计直接联动的实验，因此对基座研究的直接动作性有限。
summary.authors_note: University of Texas at Austin、Northeastern University、MD Anderson Cancer Center。Byron C. Wallace 与 Junyi Jessy Li 在医疗 NLP 与模型分析方向较活跃。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether LLMs over-rely on morphological affixes in pharmacology, causing them to assign plausible but incorrect semantics even to fictitious drug names.
summary_en.importance: This is a behavioral plus mechanistic analysis paper. Although the domain is pharmacology, the underlying issue is shortcut learning from word form, which is relevant to how language models map surface morphology to semantic concepts.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors create fictitious drug names using real affixes and test whether affix signals alone trigger class-level pharmacological responses. They then introduce a framework to attribute model semantics to the affix, the stem, or the whole name, apply it to 653 drugs, and use activation patching to localize the internal basis of the affix heuristic.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers 653 drugs and multiple models with both behavioral tests and activation patching. The abstract suggests that models often derive drug meaning mainly from affixes, rarely disclose that reliance explicitly, and sometimes conflate properties among drugs sharing affixes. It does not obviously connect these findings back to pretraining data or tokenizer design, so the direct actionability for foundation-model pretraining is limited.
summary_en.authors_note: University of Texas at Austin, Northeastern University, and MD Anderson Cancer Center. Byron C. Wallace and Junyi Jessy Li are active in medical NLP and model analysis.

recommendation.zh: 题目偏医学，但可当 shortcut learning 个案看；只读行为结果和 activation patching，别把领域现象误当通用结论。
recommendation.en: The domain is medical, but it is a decent shortcut-learning case study; read the behavioral results and activation patching, but do not overgeneralize from a domain-specific setup.

institutions: The University of Texas at Austin

paper.title: SVHalluc: Benchmarking Speech-Vision Hallucination in Audio-Visual Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Despite the success of audio-visual large-language models (LLMs), they can produce plausible but ungrounded outputs, termed hallucination. Existing benchmarks focus on environmental sounds (e.g., dog barking) to indicate event occurrence. In contrast, human speech carries fundamentally different, rich semantics and temporal structures, yet it remains unexplored whether current models can accurately align speech content with corresponding visual signals. In this work, we show that speech content

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是一般意义上的多模态幻觉，而是一个此前几乎没被单独刻画的问题：音视频大模型能否把“语音内容”与“视觉证据”正确对齐。已有音视频幻觉评测大多围绕环境声，把声音当作事件是否发生的指示器，例如狗叫、警笛、敲门声。这类设定语义简单，时间关系也通常局限在“声音出现的当下”。但真实语音不同。语音里有实体、动作、指令、评论、回忆、预告，既有更丰富的语义，也有更复杂的时间结构。模型可能听到一句话后，在画面里臆造并不存在的对象或事件，或者把语音提到的过去/未来事件误判成当前正在发生。SVHalluc的核心问题，就是系统评估这两类失败：语义错配，以及时间错配。
summary.importance: 对预训练和原生多模态建模的启发主要有两点。第一，它把“会不会听懂语音”和“能不能把语音与视觉联合建模”明确区分开了。很多模型在单模态语音识别上并不差，但一旦需要把转写内容与视频证据绑定，性能会明显掉下去。这说明当前音视频模型的瓶颈不只是编码器能力，而是跨模态对齐目标、训练数据构成、以及时序监督信号不足。第二，这个 benchmark 暴露出开源与闭源模型在 speech-vision grounding 上的明显差距，说明商业系统很可能已经在更大规模、更高质量的对齐数据，或者更细粒度的训练目标上做了额外工作。对做统一多模态预训练的人来说，这篇文章的价值不在提出新模型，而在于把一个过去被环境声 benchmark 掩盖的问题单独拎出来，并给出可复现的诊断框架。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上它是一个评测基准，而不是训练方法。设计重点有三层。第一层是任务维度划分。作者把 speech-vision hallucination 分成 semantic 和 temporal 两个维度。semantic 关注“语音里说到的内容，画面里是否真有对应证据”；temporal 关注“语音提到的事件，究竟发生在过去、现在还是未来，相对说话时刻的位置是否被模型判断正确”。第二层是 coarse-to-fine 的任务设计。每个维度都设计了三类互补任务，用统一的问答形式组织，问题以二选一或多选题为主，便于稳定打分和统计分析。这样的设计不是只测最终答对率，而是希望把失败模式拆开：模型到底是没抓住语义对应，还是抓住了内容但没抓住时间关系。第三层是数据构建。文章强调样本不是简单抓取带语音的视频，而是围绕 speech content 与 visual evidence 的对应关系来构造问题，覆盖语音描述当前画面、回顾过去事件、预告未来事件、以及语音与画面弱相关甚至误导的情况。这样做的关键，是让 benchmark 真正测“跨模态绑定”，而不是退化成 ASR 或视频分类。全文给出的 framing 很清楚：如果一个模型只会把语音转成文本，再凭语言先验猜答案，它会在这套题上暴露得很明显。
summary.experiments: 实验部分最重要的结论是：当前开源音视频大模型在这套 benchmark 上表现很弱，很多设置下接近随机猜测；而 Gemini 2.5 Pro 明显更强，但仍非无误。文中评测对象包括开源的 Qwen3-Omni，以及商业模型 Gemini 2.5 Pro。作者的分析指出，模型在单模态能力上并不构成主要障碍，例如语音识别本身可能是可用的，但一旦问题要求把 speech content 与视觉证据做联合判断，错误率会显著上升。也就是说，失败不是简单来自“没听清”，而是来自“听清了但没对齐好”。从实验结构看，文章更强调 failure diagnosis 而不是 leaderboard 排名：一方面比较 semantic 与 temporal 两类任务的难度差异，另一方面分析不同题型下模型是否依赖语言偏置、是否把语音当作强先验而忽略视觉反证。摘要和正文片段没有给出完整数字表，但已经明确说明：开源模型常常逼近 random guessing，商业模型存在明显领先，这个量级足以说明问题不是轻微退化，而是当前 open audio-visual LLM 在 speech-grounded reasoning 上还有结构性缺口。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时建议先看 Introduction 和 benchmark taxonomy，理解作者为什么认为“语音”与“环境声”是两类不同的问题。这个区分是全文最重要的立论基础。然后重点看 semantic hallucination 与 temporal hallucination 两节，弄清楚每个维度下三类任务分别在测什么，尤其注意题目构造如何避免模型只靠语言常识作答。接着看 dataset creation pipeline，确认数据筛选、标注和问题生成是否足够严格，是否存在泄漏或模板偏置。最后看实验分析部分，不必只盯总分，更值得看作者如何证明错误来自跨模态整合失败，而不是单模态识别失败。预计 20–30 分钟可以完成有效泛读；如果你做音视频预训练或统一多模态对齐，建议把任务定义和 failure case 图表看细一些。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper isolates a failure mode that prior audio-visual hallucination benchmarks largely miss: whether an audio-visual LLM can correctly ground spoken content in visual evidence. Existing benchmarks mostly use environmental sounds as event indicators, which makes the task relatively shallow: detect whether a bark, siren, or knock aligns with a visible event at the current moment. Speech is different. It carries entities, actions, instructions, commentary, and temporal references to past or future events. A model may therefore hallucinate objects or events that are mentioned in speech but absent in the video, or misplace narrated events in time. SVHalluc is built to diagnose exactly these two issues: semantic misgrounding and temporal misalignment between speech and vision.
summary_en.importance: For multimodal pretraining, the main value is diagnostic rather than algorithmic. First, it cleanly separates single-modality competence from cross-modal integration. A model can be decent at speech recognition and still fail badly when it must bind speech content to visual evidence. That points to weaknesses in alignment objectives, data composition, and temporal supervision, not just encoder quality. Second, the benchmark exposes a large gap between open and commercial systems on speech-vision grounding. That strongly suggests that stronger systems are benefiting from better aligned multimodal corpora, richer supervision, or more careful training recipes. The contribution is not a new model, but a sharper lens on a real weakness in current audio-visual LLMs that older environmental-sound benchmarks tend to understate.
summary_en.technical_approach: This is a benchmark paper, not a training-method paper. The design has three important pieces. First, the taxonomy: the authors split speech-vision hallucination into semantic and temporal dimensions. Semantic hallucination asks whether the content mentioned in speech truly corresponds to visible evidence. Temporal hallucination asks whether the model can identify when the narrated event occurs relative to the speaking moment: past, present, or future. Second, each dimension is probed with three complementary tasks arranged from coarse to fine, all cast in a unified QA format. Questions are mostly binary or multiple choice to support stable scoring and statistical analysis. This matters because the benchmark is not only measuring final accuracy; it is trying to localize failure modes. Third, the dataset construction is centered on speech content–visual evidence relations rather than generic narrated videos. The benchmark includes cases where speech describes the current scene, recalls past events, foreshadows future events, or contains weakly related or misleading commentary. That design prevents the task from collapsing into ASR or generic video QA. The paper’s framing is clear: if a model mainly transcribes speech and answers from language priors, SVHalluc should expose that weakness.
summary_en.experiments: The main empirical result is straightforward: current open audio-visual LLMs perform poorly on SVHalluc, often close to random guessing, while Gemini 2.5 Pro is substantially stronger but still imperfect. The evaluated models include open-source systems such as Qwen3-Omni and the commercial Gemini 2.5 Pro. The analysis argues that the bottleneck is not simply speech perception. Models may do reasonably well on single-modality tasks like speech recognition, yet fail once the question requires joint reasoning over spoken content and visual evidence. In other words, the failure is often 'heard it but did not ground it,' not merely 'did not hear it.' The experiments are structured more as failure diagnosis than leaderboard reporting: they compare semantic versus temporal difficulty, and examine whether models over-trust speech priors while ignoring visual contradiction. The excerpt provided does not include the full numeric tables, but the qualitative result is already strong enough: open models are frequently near chance, and the commercial model shows a clear margin, indicating a structural gap rather than a small regression.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the introduction and the benchmark taxonomy. The key question is why speech should be treated differently from environmental sounds; that is the conceptual anchor of the paper. Then read the semantic and temporal task sections carefully to understand what each of the three tasks under each dimension is actually testing, especially how the prompts are designed to reduce shortcutting through language priors. After that, check the dataset creation pipeline to see whether the sampling, annotation, and question construction are rigorous enough and whether there are obvious template biases. Finally, read the analysis section with an eye on error attribution rather than headline scores: the useful part is how the authors argue that the failures come from cross-modal integration, not just weak ASR. A solid skim should take about 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读 benchmark 构造和错误分解即可；它暴露的是语音 token 语义强、视觉 grounding 弱这一预训练接口问题。
recommendation.en: Skim the benchmark construction and error breakdown; the useful signal is that strong speech semantics can overpower weak visual grounding in AV pretraining.

paper.title: Regret Pre-training: Bridging Prior and Posterior Views for Enhanced Knowledge Grounding

summary.core_problem: 在知识 grounding 上，如何同时利用“先验（模型原有参数化知识）”与“后验（给定证据/上下文后的更新）”来减少幻觉与错误引用。
summary.importance: 如果方法成立，属于把“模型知道什么”与“证据告诉它什么”显式对齐的训练信号设计，可能对 RAG/检索增强、引用一致性、以及持续预训练的目标函数有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出“Regret Pre-training”概念：用某种 regret/差分信号度量先验输出与后验（有证据条件下）输出的偏离，并把这种偏离转成训练目标，鼓励模型在有证据时向后验收敛、在无证据时保持校准；具体实现细节未知（可能是对比学习/偏好式目标/自蒸馏）。
summary.experiments: 摘要缺失，无法确认是否是从头预训练还是 mid-train、数据来源（检索证据构造方式）、以及相对 baselines（RAG、self-consistency、citation training）的增益幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: How to improve knowledge grounding by explicitly bridging a model’s prior (parametric knowledge) and posterior (evidence-conditioned update) to reduce hallucinations and mis-citations.
summary_en.importance: If validated, it is a training-signal design that aligns “what the model thinks” with “what evidence supports”, potentially informing RAG/citation consistency and continual pretraining objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes “Regret Pre-training”: define a regret/difference signal between prior outputs and posterior (with evidence) outputs, and optimize a training objective that pulls the model toward the posterior when evidence exists while keeping calibration otherwise; exact instantiation is unclear (could be contrastive, preference-style, or self-distillation).
summary_en.experiments: No abstract provided; unclear whether this is from-scratch pretraining or mid-training, how evidence is constructed, and gains over baselines like RAG/self-consistency/citation training.

recommendation.zh: 概念听起来像“用证据条件下的自蒸馏做差分训练”，先看它 regret 的定义与负样本构造；没干净对照就当弱信号。
recommendation.en: Sounds like evidence-conditioned self-distillation with a differential objective—check the regret definition and negative construction; without clean controls, treat as weak signal.

paper.title: The Shape of Addition: Geometric Structures of Arithmetic in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large Language Models exhibit paradoxical fragility in fundamental arithmetic, implying a disconnect between internal computation and discrete output. By analyzing the residual stream geometry during multi-operand addition, we identify the Iso-Raw-Sum Trajectory (IRST), a geometric structure where representations are anchored by semantic digits and modulated by continuous carry fibers. We propose the Noisy Quantization Model to explain this geometry, framing arithmetic errors as Geometric Slippa

summary.core_problem: LLM 在复杂数学推理上表现不错，但在多位数、多操作数加法这种“算法基元”上会出现典型的 off-by-one / carry 错误。更反直觉的是：探针往往能从失败样本的残差流里解码出 ground truth 或关键中间量，说明“正确的信息在内部存在，但输出离散 token 时滑掉了”。论文要回答的是：这种“内部连续表征—外部离散输出”之间的断裂，具体对应什么几何结构与失效机制？
summary.importance:
这是一篇机制分析/表示几何论文，不是预训练方法论文。对预训练研究的直接影响有限，但它提供了两个可迁移的启发：
1) 把离散错误解释为连续潜变量跨越量化阈值（noisy quantization），这类视角可用于理解 tokenizer/离散化瓶颈、以及“模型内部有解但输出选错 token”的现象（不仅限算术）。
2) “probe versatility” 的结构性解释：同一激活向量可线性分离多种潜在信号，可能意味着残差流里存在可分解的低维流形/纤维结构；这对做可解释性、以及设计更好的训练目标（让内部中间量更可控）有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
作者选了一个可控任务：三个或更多 10 位整数相加，并且逐位生成（从最高位到最低位）分析每个位置的残差流激活。定义了列和 Raw Sum r_p、进位 c_p、真值 digit s_p，并引入模型侧的潜变量（预测的 raw sum、预测的 carry）。

方法上主要是：
- Probing：用轻量探针（logistic regression/MLP）在单个 activation 上同时解码多种变量，观察到 probe versatility。
- 几何可视化：用 UMAP 在最后层（以及逐位置）把激活降维，发现所谓 IRST（Iso-Raw-Sum Trajectory）：在“digit basins（对应输出 digit 的盆地）”的宏观结构上，叠加“carry 状态的微观纹理”，并且存在沿 raw-sum 常数的连续纤维。
- 失效机制建模：提出 Noisy Quantization Model。核心假设是模型内部先形成连续的 Carry Potential（可理解为对进位强度/概率的连续估计），再在输出阶段被离散化；当神经噪声推动该连续量跨过量化阈值，就会发生 digit 选择的几何滑移（geometric slippage），产生周期性的错误分布（文中提到 bathtub 形状）。
- 验证性干预：提出 inference-time 的 dual-stream consistency，自行解码“局部 raw sum”和“全局 carry potential”并做一致性约束，用来纠正输出，作为“内部确有正确组件”的证据。

与以往算术机制工作相比，它更强调“连续纤维 + 量化阈值”的桥接解释，而不是只停留在能 probe 出什么信息。
summary.experiments:
实验主线是表征与错误分布的对应关系：
- 任务：多操作数、多位数加法，逐位分析。
- 现象：UMAP 上出现 IRST 纤维结构；错误可解释为沿纤维漂移导致跨 digit basin 边界。
- 拟合：Noisy Quantization Model 能解释并预测文中提到的周期性 bathtub error 分布（摘要/引言点名 Fig.5）。
- 干预：dual-stream consistency 的推理期自校正能“显著恢复性能”（引言措辞），用于证明 latent 信号可用。

但就当前提供的全文片段，缺少可复述的关键数字：使用的具体模型（家族/参数量）、错误率下降幅度、探针准确率、以及自校正带来的提升百分比等。它更像一篇以定性结构 + 若干定量曲线支撑的机制论文。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（30–45 分钟）：
- 先看任务与变量定义（Preliminaries）：r_p/c_p/s_p 的定义决定后面所有几何解释是否自洽。
- 重点看 Fig.2（IRST/UMAP 结构）和 Fig.5（bathtub error 分布与模型预测），这是“几何—错误机制”论证链的两根主梁。
- 再看 dual-stream consistency 的方法与 ablation：它是否真的只利用了可解码的中间量，还是引入了额外启发式。

如果你的关注点是预训练/数据/优化，这篇更适合作为“离散输出错误的连续解释”案例阅读，不建议深挖全部细节；但做 tokenizer/离散化、或研究‘internal correctness vs external failure’ 的团队值得精读图表与方法细节。

summary_en.core_problem: LLMs can solve high-level math benchmarks yet remain brittle on multi-digit, multi-operand addition, often making characteristic carry-related off-by-one errors. Probing results deepen the puzzle: even when the model outputs the wrong digit, simple probes can decode the ground-truth digit or intermediate states from the residual stream. The paper asks for a mechanistic bridge: what geometric structure in representation space allows “correct latent computation” to coexist with “wrong discrete token output,” and how does that geometry produce specific arithmetic failures?
summary_en.importance:
This is a mechanistic interpretability / representation-geometry study, not a pretraining-method contribution. Its relevance to pretraining is indirect but non-trivial:
- It frames discrete output errors as threshold crossings of a continuous latent variable under neural noise (“noisy quantization”), a lens that can generalize to other settings where internal signals are present but decoding/token selection fails.
- It offers a structural explanation for probe versatility (multiple latent signals linearly separable from the same activation), suggesting residual-stream manifolds with fiber-like organization—useful for interpretability and for thinking about training objectives that better constrain intermediate variables.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper uses a controlled task: addition of three (or more) 10-digit integers, analyzing residual-stream activations at every generated digit position. It defines column-wise Raw Sum r_p, propagated carry c_p, and ground-truth digit s_p, and introduces model-side latent counterparts (predicted raw sum / predicted carry).

Method components:
- Probing: lightweight probes (logistic regression, small MLPs) decode multiple variables from a single activation vector, establishing “probe versatility.”
- Geometry: UMAP visualizations (primarily final-layer activations) reveal an Iso-Raw-Sum Trajectory (IRST): continuous fibers of constant raw sum threading through a macro-structure of digit “basins,” with micro-structure tied to carry states.
- Mechanistic model: the Noisy Quantization Model posits a continuous Carry Potential internally estimated and then discretized; noise can push it across quantization thresholds, causing “geometric slippages” across digit-basin decision boundaries.
- Validation via intervention: an inference-time dual-stream consistency method decodes local (raw-sum) and global (carry-potential) signals and enforces consistency to self-correct, supporting the claim that correct components exist latently even when output is wrong.

Compared to prior arithmetic-mechanism work, the emphasis is on a continuous-fiber + quantization-threshold explanation rather than only demonstrating probe extractability.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental narrative ties representation geometry to error patterns:
- Setup: multi-operand, multi-digit addition with per-position activation analysis.
- Findings: IRST-like fiber structure in UMAP; errors correspond to drifts along fibers that cross digit-basin boundaries.
- Quantitative fit: the Noisy Quantization Model explains/predicts a periodic “bathtub” error distribution (highlighted as Fig.5 in the intro).
- Intervention: dual-stream consistency yields a sizable inference-time recovery (described as “significant” in the intro), used as evidence that latent signals are usable.

However, in the provided full-text excerpt, key reproducible numbers are missing (exact model(s), parameter counts, probe accuracies, and the magnitude of error reduction from the intervention). The paper reads more like qualitative geometry + supporting curves than a metrics-first study.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Read the task/state definitions carefully (r_p, c_p, s_p). The rest depends on these variables being well-posed.
- Focus on the main geometry figures (IRST/UMAP) and the error-distribution figure (bathtub pattern + model prediction). Those are the core evidence for the proposed mechanism.
- Check the dual-stream consistency section and any ablations to see whether the correction is principled or heuristic-heavy.

If your primary focus is pretraining/data/optimization, treat this as a case study on “continuous latent correctness vs discrete decoding failure.” It becomes more worth deep reading if you work on tokenization/discretization or mechanistic interpretability of decoding failures.

recommendation.zh: 从残差流几何结构（IRST）和连续电位量化阈值的角度解释 LLM 算术错误，视角独特，对理解模型内部机理和设计干预方法有启发。
recommendation.en: Explaining LLM arithmetic errors from the perspective of residual stream geometry (IRST) and continuous potential quantization thresholds is unique and inspiring for understanding internal mechanisms and designing interventions.

paper.title: Hallucination Is Linearly Decodable from Mid-Layer Hidden States in Quantized LLMs
paper.abstract: We investigate whether open-source LLMs encode a linearly separable truthfulness signal in their hidden states, and at which network depth this signal is strongest. Across three $7$B--$8$B instruction-tuned models (Llama-3.1-8B, Mistral-7B, Qwen2.5-7B) loaded in $4$-bit NF4 quantization, we extract per-layer hidden states on four hallucination benchmarks (TruthfulQA, HaluEval-QA, FEVER, and a controlled synthetic set) and compare four detection approaches: linear and MLP probes, INSIDE EigenScor

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的问题很具体：在实际部署常见的 4-bit 量化开源指令模型里，模型内部是否已经编码了一个可线性读出的“真实性/幻觉性”信号；如果有，这个信号主要出现在网络的哪一层；以及这种单次前向的表征探针方法，与需要多次采样的自一致性、INSIDE EigenScore、注意力熵等检测方法相比，谁在统一协议下更有效。论文的关键点不只是做一个 probe，而是把不同检测范式放到同一评测框架里，明确区分“给定候选答案后判断其真假”和“从 prompt 自由生成后看分歧”这两类本来就不完全等价的问题。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接启发不在于“幻觉检测应用”，而在于两个更底层的判断。第一，7B–8B 级别指令模型在中后层已经形成了相当稳定的 truthfulness 表征，而且这个表征近似线性可分，这说明真假相关信息并不只体现在最终 token 概率上，而是作为中层语义状态被显式编码。第二，量化到 NF4 之后这种信号仍然保留，说明某些内部语义判别结构对低比特部署有一定鲁棒性。对做预训练和训练动态的人，这类结果有助于思考：真实性信号是在预训练阶段自然形成，还是主要由 instruction tuning 强化；它为何在中层而不是最后一层最强；以及能否把这种中层可读信号反向用于训练目标、数据筛选或拒答机制。量级上，这更像一篇机制与评测协议澄清工作，不是训练范式层面的推进。
summary.technical_approach:
方法设计比较朴素，但协议控制得较清楚。作者选了三类常见开源 chat model：Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，统一以 4-bit NF4 量化加载，在单张 8GB GPU 上运行。数据上使用四个二分类幻觉基准：TruthfulQA、HaluEval-QA、FEVER，以及一个合成数据集。每个样本都构造成同一 prompt 下的 truthful answer 与 hallucinated answer 配对，类别接近 50:50 平衡。核心表征提取方式沿用 SAPLMA 风格：把 prompt 与候选 answer 拼接，做一次前向，抽取 embedding 输出和每个 transformer block 输出，对 answer span 做 last-token pooling，得到每层一个 D 维向量；然后在每一层分别训练线性 probe 和两层 MLP probe。

对比方法有四类。第一类是 probe，本质是判别给定候选答案在该层隐藏状态中是否带有真假标签。第二类是 INSIDE EigenScore，需要对同一 prompt 采样多个 completion，再从内部状态谱特征估计不确定性。第三类是 self-consistency，用 exact match plurality 或句向量相似度衡量多次采样的一致性。第四类是注意力熵，只取首层、中层、末层最后一个 answer token 的注意力分布熵做特征。论文最重要的技术判断其实在协议解释：在 paired-label 设定下，probe 看到的是“prompt + 指定候选答案”的条件表征，而采样类方法只看到 prompt 后的自由生成分歧，因此两者并不在利用同一信息。作者把很多采样法表现差的原因，归结为这种结构性失配，而不是简单说采样法无效。

从结果看，作者进一步声称 truthfulness signal 近似线性：MLP probe 相比线性 probe 提升很小，说明非线性边界不是主要收益来源。层位上，Llama 和 Mistral 的最佳层集中在 32 层模型的第 13–18 层，Qwen 集中在 28 层模型的第 19–25 层，都是中后层而非最后层。这一点比单纯 AUROC 更值得看，因为它暗示真假判别可能在语义整合后、logit 投影前最清晰。
summary.experiments:
实验规模不大，但设置比较整齐。每个数据集最多取 N=400 个样本，三种模型 × 四个数据集逐层评估。最醒目的结果是：单层线性 probe 在 held-out split 上达到 0.904–1.000 AUROC，而同协议下的采样式检测方法最高不超过 0.541 AUROC，几乎接近随机。作者把这个差距解释为信息可见性不同，而不是简单的算法优劣。

数据集难度上，TruthfulQA 最难，因为错误答案是“看起来合理但错”的对抗式选项；HaluEval 因为显式提供知识上下文，通常更容易分；Synthetic 几乎是最干净的真假对照，因此分数最高。FEVER 介于两者之间。消融上，线性 probe 与 MLP probe 性能接近，支持“线性可解码”这一主张。层分析显示，早层接近词法/局部模式，判别力弱；中后层迅速上升；最后几层有时略回落，可能因为表示更偏向生成分布和表面形式。注意力熵特征整体较弱，说明简单的注意力分散度不足以稳定刻画真假。论文还强调 4-bit NF4 量化并未破坏这一趋势，但没有做与全精度的系统对照，所以更准确的表述应是“在量化模型中该信号仍可读出”，而不是“量化不影响该信号”。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Methodology 里对 paired-label protocol 的解释，这是整篇成立的前提。然后直接看层级 AUROC 曲线和不同方法对比表，重点不是绝对分数，而是 probe 与 sampling 方法到底在回答什么问题。再看作者对线性 probe 与 MLP probe 差距很小的讨论，这关系到“truthfulness 是否近似线性编码”。如果时间有限，30–40 分钟足够抓住主结论。

值得留意的深挖点有三个。第一，truthfulness signal 到底是“事实正确性”还是“与训练分布一致的熟悉度”，论文没有完全分开。第二，候选答案是 benchmark 提供而非模型生成，这让任务更像 conditional verification，而不是在线 hallucination detection。第三，作者只研究 instruction-tuned 模型，无法区分预训练与后训练各自贡献多少。如果你关心预训练机制，这三点都要带着保留去读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a narrow but useful question: in practical 4-bit quantized open-weight instruction models, is there a truthfulness signal in hidden states that can be decoded with a simple linear classifier, and if so, where in depth is it strongest? It also compares this single-pass representation-based route against sampling-based detectors such as self-consistency, INSIDE EigenScore, and attention-entropy features under one unified protocol. The important nuance is that the paper is really comparing two different problem formulations: judging a provided candidate answer versus measuring uncertainty from free generations.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining researchers is not the hallucination application itself, but what it says about internal representations. First, 7B–8B instruction-tuned models appear to carry a fairly stable truthfulness-related signal in mid-to-late layers, and that signal is close to linearly separable. That suggests factuality-relevant information is not only reflected in final token probabilities; it is already organized in intermediate semantic states. Second, the signal remains readable after NF4 quantization, which hints that some internal semantic geometry is robust to low-bit deployment. For pretraining and training-dynamics work, this raises useful questions: whether the signal is mostly inherited from pretraining or sharpened by instruction tuning, why it peaks in middle/late layers rather than the top layer, and whether such layerwise signals could be fed back into training objectives, data filtering, or abstention mechanisms. This is better read as a mechanistic/evaluation clarification than as a new training recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The setup is simple but carefully controlled. The authors study three common open chat models—Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct—loaded in 4-bit NF4 on a single 8GB GPU. They use four binary hallucination benchmarks: TruthfulQA, HaluEval-QA, FEVER, and a synthetic dataset. Each example is turned into a paired-label instance with the same prompt and two candidate answers, one truthful and one hallucinated, yielding an almost perfectly balanced classification task.

For representation extraction, they follow the SAPLMA-style protocol: concatenate prompt and candidate answer, run one forward pass, collect the embedding output plus every transformer block output, and apply last-token pooling over the answer span to get one vector per layer. On top of each layer representation, they train a linear probe and a small MLP probe.

They compare four detector families. Probes operate on the conditional representation of a provided answer. INSIDE EigenScore samples multiple completions and derives an uncertainty score from internal-state spectra. Self-consistency measures agreement across sampled generations using exact-match plurality or embedding similarity. Attention entropy uses per-head entropy summaries from early, middle, and late blocks. The most important methodological point is the protocol asymmetry: probes see the supplied candidate answer, while sampling-based methods only see the prompt and then generate freely. So under this paired-label setup, the two families do not consume the same information. The paper’s negative result for sampling methods is therefore framed as a structural mismatch, not simply as algorithmic failure.

A second notable claim is that the truthfulness signal is approximately linear. MLP probes bring little gain over linear probes, suggesting that nonlinear decision boundaries are not doing most of the work. Layerwise peaks are also consistent: blocks 13–18 out of 32 for Llama and Mistral, and blocks 19–25 out of 28 for Qwen. That mid-to-late concentration is more interesting than the headline AUROC because it hints that factuality-related separation becomes clearest after semantic integration but before the final generation-oriented layers dominate.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental scale is modest but tidy: up to 400 items per dataset, evaluated layer by layer for 3 models × 4 datasets. The headline result is that a single-layer linear probe reaches 0.904–1.000 AUROC on held-out splits, while sampling-based detectors stay at or below 0.541 AUROC under the same protocol, essentially near chance. The authors attribute this gap to information mismatch rather than to a universal superiority of probes.

Dataset difficulty follows intuition. TruthfulQA is the hardest because the negative answers are plausible distractors. HaluEval is easier because explicit supporting knowledge is prepended. The synthetic benchmark is the cleanest true/false contrast and therefore yields the highest scores. FEVER sits in between. Ablations show that linear and MLP probes perform similarly, supporting the “linearly decodable” claim. Layerwise curves show weak separability in early layers, a sharp rise in middle/late layers, and sometimes a slight drop near the top, possibly because top layers are more entangled with generation style and surface-form decisions. Attention-entropy features are consistently weak, suggesting that simple dispersion statistics of attention are not a stable proxy for truthfulness. The paper also stresses that the trend survives 4-bit NF4 quantization, though it does not provide a systematic full-precision comparison, so the safer reading is that the signal remains accessible in quantized models rather than that quantization has no effect.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, start with the Introduction and the paired-label protocol discussion in Methodology. That is the key to interpreting the whole paper. Then jump to the layerwise AUROC plots and the method comparison tables. The main question is not the absolute score, but what each detector is actually being asked to do. Also check the discussion around the small gap between linear and MLP probes, since that underpins the claim of near-linear encoding. Around 30–40 minutes is enough for the main takeaways.

Three caveats are worth keeping in mind. First, the decoded signal may mix factual correctness with familiarity to the model’s training distribution. Second, because candidate answers are benchmark-provided rather than model-generated, the task is closer to conditional verification than online hallucination detection. Third, all tested models are instruction-tuned, so the paper cannot disentangle how much of the signal comes from pretraining versus post-training.

recommendation.zh: 结论不算改 prior，但对“中层是否已有可读出真实性信号”给了干净证据；只看层扫描结果和线性-vs-MLP 对比就够，paired-label 设定要留个心眼。
recommendation.en: It does not overturn priors, but it gives fairly clean evidence that truthfulness is already decodable in mid layers; read the layer sweep and linear-vs-MLP comparison, while treating the paired-label protocol with caution.

institutions: a structural mismatch between paired-label evaluation and the informa-
signal under a paired-label protocol, which we trace to a structural mismatch

paper.title: Synthetic Hallucinations, Real Gains: Hard Negatives from Frontier Models for FIM Hallucination Mitigation
paper.abstract: Small open-source code models that power IDE autocomplete still emit hallucinated Fill-in-the-Middle (FIM) completions: syntactically natural calls to methods, parameters, variables, and imports that do not exist in the surrounding project. Existing mitigations either require per-language execution sandboxes that do not apply at mid-keystroke or preference-optimisation pipelines that need large human-labelled corpora. We propose an execution-free alternative: use frontier code models to synthesi

summary.core_problem: 缓解小型开源代码补全模型在 IDE Fill-in-the-Middle 场景中生成不存在 API、变量、参数和 import 的幻觉问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是代码模型后训练数据构造和负样本学习。它关心的是 mid-keystroke 自动补全中的项目上下文一致性，和通用代码 LM 的实用失效模式相关，但不是基座预训练方法本身。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是用多个 frontier code model 为真实 GitHub FIM 上下文合成“看起来合理但错误”的 hard negatives，并把这些负样本与真实开发者编辑形成对比监督信号，用于小模型 SFT；幻觉类型参考 Delulu taxonomy，避免依赖执行沙箱或大规模人工偏好标注。
summary.experiments: 数据来自 public GitHub，覆盖八种编程语言；每个上下文由三个 frontier generator 生成四类幻觉负样本之一。摘要提到使用 Docker 验证的多语言 FIM hallucination benchmark，但未给出模型参数量、训练 token 数、具体 baseline 和提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Illinois Chicago；摘要未显示与大型代码模型预训练团队的直接关联。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets hallucinated Fill-in-the-Middle completions in small open-source code models, especially nonexistent APIs, variables, parameters, and imports in IDE autocomplete.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a post-training data construction recipe for code models using hard negatives. The problem is relevant to practical code LM reliability, but it is not a foundation pretraining method.
summary_en.technical_approach: The pipeline asks multiple frontier code models to synthesize plausible-but-wrong FIM completions for real GitHub contexts, then contrasts those synthetic hallucinations with the ground-truth developer edit as a supervised fine-tuning signal. The hallucination types follow the Delulu taxonomy and avoid execution sandboxes or large human preference datasets.
summary_en.experiments: The data are scraped from public GitHub across eight languages. Three frontier generators are used to create hard negatives across four hallucination categories, and the paper mentions a Docker-verified multilingual FIM hallucination benchmark. The abstract does not provide model sizes, training scale, baselines, or exact gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institution is University of Illinois Chicago; no clear tie to a major code-model pretraining group is visible from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 可看数据构造流程，不必细读；对代码预训练的价值主要是 hard negative 采样思路。
recommendation.en: Worth a quick look for the hard-negative data recipe; it is not a pretraining result, and the main value is the sampling setup.

institutions: Mahdi Erfanian University of Illinois Chicago

paper.title: The Ghost Couple: Correlated LLM Name Priors and Their Haunting of the Web and Academic Publishing
paper.abstract: These names do not exist. Elena Vasquez and Marcus Chen have appeared as volcano experts, astronauts, thriller protagonists, podcast hosts, and academic co-authors across hundreds of independently produced AI-generated documents, never having lived. We show that large language models do not merely default to high-probability individual names when generating fictional experts: they produce correlated character ensembles, pairs and trios whose co-occurrence rates far exceed chance and are consiste

summary.core_problem: 大语言模型生成内容时存在稳定的、模型家族/版本特有的关联姓名先验（偏好的人物组合），这类先验会通过生成内容污染公开网络与学术出版系统，当前缺乏针对这类隐式行为指纹的检测与溯源方法。
summary.importance: 揭示了预训练数据循环污染的新路径——模型生成的幽灵内容会回流为未来的预训练数据，固化不合理的姓名先验；这类版本特异的隐式行为指纹可作为预训练 checkpoint 溯源、数据污染检测的新信号；提示预训练与对齐阶段需要对高频生成伪像做主动清理，避免向互联网输出系统性偏差。
summary.technical_approach: 首先通过 Contrastive Decoding Diffing（CDD，一种无需权重访问、通过输出分布 logit 空间外推提取微调模型植入内容的灰盒方法）发现重复出现的虚构人名伪像；随后系统探测三个主流模型家族（Claude/GPT/Gemini）的公开API checkpoint，用单人/双人/三人虚构专家生成 prompt 统计姓名频率与共现率，提取模型特异的姓名组合先验；再将这些先验作为搜索特征，在公开网络、Zenodo、ResearchGate 等平台验证幽灵内容的实际传播规模。
summary.experiments: 探测了9个Claude版本、10个GPT版本、Gemini 2.5 Flash，生成温度设为1.0；Claude的幽灵双人组合Elena Vasquez+Marcus Chen在claude-sonnet-4-20250514中双人共现率达23%，随版本更新单调衰减至最新版的0%，幽灵三人组（加Amara Okafor）在Opus线峰值达20%，Sonnet线仅固化双人组合、无三人组出现；在Zenodo发现1655条带正式DOI的幽灵学术记录，2026年3月单月上传991条，Elena Vasquez是该未定向检索语料中出现频率最高的作者；ResearchGate上的假论文发表时间可作为模型部署窗口的时间代理。
summary.reading_guide: 优先看第3章的模型API探测结果与姓名先验的版本变化曲线，第5.4节的Zenodo大规模幽灵作者数据，预计阅读时间15分钟；不需要深究CDD的技术细节，重点关注姓名先验的传播路径与对预训练数据污染的影响。

summary_en.core_problem: Large language models exhibit stable, model-family- and version-specific correlated name priors (preferred character ensembles) during generation. These priors contaminate the public web and academic publishing systems through AI-generated content, and no targeted detection or tracing method exists for such implicit behavioral fingerprints.
summary_en.importance: It reveals a new path for cyclic pretraining data contamination: ghost content generated by models can flow back into future pretraining data and solidify unreasonable name priors. These version-specific implicit fingerprints can serve as new signals for pretraining checkpoint tracing and data contamination detection. It also indicates that active cleanup of high-frequency generation artifacts is required during pretraining and alignment to avoid outputting systematic biases to the internet.
summary_en.technical_approach: Recurring fictional name artifacts were first discovered using Contrastive Decoding Diffing (CDD), a grey-box method that extracts implanted content from fine-tuned models via logit-space extrapolation of output distributions without weight access. Then public API checkpoints of three mainstream model families (Claude/GPT/Gemini) were systematically probed with prompts requesting single, pair, or trio fictional experts to count name frequencies and co-occurrence rates, extracting model-specific name ensemble priors. These priors were then used as search signatures to verify the actual spread of ghost content across the public web, Zenodo, and ResearchGate.
summary_en.experiments: 9 Claude versions, 10 GPT versions, and Gemini 2.5 Flash were probed at temperature 1.0. The Claude ghost pair Elena Vasquez + Marcus Chen reached 23% co-occurrence rate in claude-sonnet-4-20250514, decayed monotonically to 0% in the latest version. The full ghost trio (with Amara Okafor) peaked at 20% in the Opus line, while the Sonnet line only crystallized the pair with no trio occurrences. 1,655 ghost academic records with official DOIs were found on Zenodo, 991 uploaded in March 2026 alone; Elena Vasquez was the most frequent author in this untargeted corpus. Fake paper publication dates on ResearchGate can serve as a temporal proxy for model deployment windows.
summary_en.reading_guide: Prioritize Section 3 for model API probing results and version change curves of name priors, Section 5.4 for large-scale ghost author data on Zenodo. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes. No need to dive into technical details of CDD; focus on the propagation path of name priors and their impact on pretraining data contamination.

recommendation.zh: 揭示 LLM 预训练留下的系统性名字先验污染现象，学术引用数据的警示价值高。只看摘要和 Zenodo 污染数据那一节即可，方法无需深究。
recommendation.en: Reveals systematic name prior correlations left by LLM pretraining with real academic publishing contamination. Abstract + Zenodo section are sufficient; methodology need not be studied deeply.

paper.title: YARD: Y-Architecture Register Decoding for Efficient Hallucination Mitigation in Large Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Contrastive decoding (CD) seeks to mitigate hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) by contrasting the output distributions of a standard model and a visually degraded model. However, existing training-free CD methods suffer from sub-optimal degraded branches: completely dropping visual tokens is too extreme and induces language hallucinations, while corrupting input images offers coarse control over visual evidence and suffers from high inference latency due to requiring two full

summary.core_problem: 解决 LVLM 幻觉缓解中 contrastive decoding 需要双分支完整前向、退化分支过粗且推理代价高的问题。
summary.importance: 属于训练后、推理期的 VLM 解码改造。对“中层视觉 grounding 更关键”和“内部构造退化分支”这两个点有一定方法启发，但离基座预训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出训练自由的 Y-Architecture Register Decoding。方法在解码器浅层共享计算，到中间层再分叉；退化分支不再丢弃视觉 token 或破坏输入图像，而是用 register token 替换 patch token，以保留全局语义但削弱细粒度视觉证据，再做对比分布解码。
summary.experiments: 摘要声称相比现有 CD 方法能降低推理延迟并更有效缓解幻觉，但未给出具体模型、数据集和提升幅度。可预期 baseline 是视觉 token drop、图像 corruption 等 training-free CD 方案。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the inefficiency and poor degraded-branch design of contrastive decoding for hallucination mitigation in large vision-language models.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-time VLM decoding paper. It offers some useful signals—especially that grounding may concentrate in middle layers and that degraded branches can be built internally—but it is still far from core pretraining research.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes a training-free Y-Architecture Register Decoding method. It shares shallow-layer computation, branches at a middle decoder stage, and replaces patch-level visual tokens with register tokens in the degraded branch to preserve global semantics while weakening fine-grained visual evidence, then performs contrastive decoding.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims lower inference latency and better hallucination mitigation than existing CD methods, but gives no concrete model sizes, datasets, or gains. Likely baselines are visual-token dropping and image corruption based training-free CD variants.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但“grounding 主要出现在中层”这个观察值得记一笔；只看方法图和消融，别投入太多时间。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the claim that grounding concentrates in middle layers is worth noting; read the method figure and ablations, not the full paper.

paper.title: What Makes LVLMs Hallucinate Less? Unveiling the Architectural Factors Behind Hallucination Robustness
paper.abstract: Hallucination remains one of the key challenges undermining the reliability of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs). But what makes an LVLM hallucinate less? Many existing efforts focus on improving internal components of the model. We argue that hallucination fundamentally stems from how the model architecture is designed. To investigate this, we factor the architecture design into three dimensions: Linguistic Foundation (LF), Visual Representation (VR), and Semantic Alignment (SA), and categor

summary.core_problem: 分析 LVLM 幻觉与模型架构设计之间的关系，试图回答哪些架构因素会让多模态模型更不容易产生幻觉。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM 幻觉评测与架构因素分析。它把幻觉拆成语言基础、视觉表示、语义对齐三个设计维度，并提出 CoSimUE 基准来构造细粒度幻觉场景；对 VLM 预训练和对齐有间接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文将架构因素分解为 Linguistic Foundation、Visual Representation、Semantic Alignment 三类，并把幻觉划分为 Co-occurrence、Similarity、Uncertainty 三类。CoSimUE 通过受控文本扰动与随机扰动构造样本，用于观察不同设计选择与幻觉行为之间的映射关系。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明实验覆盖 7 个设计方面，并得到一个主要观察：单纯扩大模型参数量对降低三类幻觉的作用有限。摘要未给出模型清单、参数规模、数据量、baseline 或具体数值。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自四川大学、厦门理工学院、香港大学等；摘要中的机构信息格式不完整，无法确认更具体团队背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how LVLM architectural choices affect hallucination robustness, asking which design factors make a vision-language model hallucinate less.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an LVLM hallucination benchmark and architectural-factor analysis. It decomposes design into linguistic foundation, visual representation, and semantic alignment, and introduces CoSimUE to create fine-grained hallucination scenarios. The relevance to VLM pretraining and alignment is indirect but real.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors factor architecture into Linguistic Foundation, Visual Representation, and Semantic Alignment, and categorize hallucinations into co-occurrence, similarity, and uncertainty types. CoSimUE uses controlled textual perturbations and random perturbations to map design choices to hallucination behaviors.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports experiments over seven design aspects and highlights that parameter scaling alone has limited effect on reducing all three hallucination types. It does not provide the model list, parameter scales, data size, baselines, or numerical gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are associated with Sichuan University, Xiamen University of Technology, and the University of Hong Kong, but the provided affiliation text is incomplete.

recommendation.zh: 结论方向合理但信息不足；只看参数规模对幻觉影响有限这条，别把它当干净因果实验。
recommendation.en: The direction is plausible but underspecified; note the limited effect of parameter scaling on hallucination, but do not treat it as a clean causal study.
