recommendation.en: Large-scale empirical study (111M citations) quantifying real-world LLM hallucination impact in science; solid data, especially the social bias findings in hallucinated citations are notable; read results section.

institutions: Haas School of Business, University of California Berkeley, Berkeley
Research conducted when visiting Cornell and UCLA

paper.title: The Cost of Context: Mitigating Textual Bias in Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation
paper.abstract: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly integrated with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to mitigate hallucinations, the introduction of external documents can conceal severe failure modes at the instance level. We identify and formalize the phenomenon of recorruption, where the introduction of even perfectly accurate "oracle" context causes a capable model to abandon an initially correct prediction. Through a mechanistic diagnosis of internal attention matrices, we s

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究多模态 RAG 的一个实例级失败模式：即使检索到的是准确的 oracle 文本，上下文也可能让 MLLM 放弃原本正确的视觉判断，转向错误答案。作者把这种现象称为 recorruption。核心问题不是 RAG 平均准确率是否提升，而是外部文本如何在统一上下文中压制图像证据，导致模型看似有更多信息，实际丢掉了视觉 grounding。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值在于，它暴露了早期融合 MLLM 的结构性弱点：图像 token 和文本 token 在同一个 softmax 注意力预算中竞争，长文本注入会系统性降低视觉信号的注意力质量。这对 VLM 预训练、图文对齐 loss、长上下文多模态训练和 retrieval-augmented multimodal modeling 都有启发。它说明多模态模型不能只用最终任务准确率评估 RAG；正确答案可能来自文本位置偏置，而不是稳健的视觉-文本联合推理。该工作本身是推理期干预和机制诊断，不是新的预训练算法。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先形式化 recorruption：base MLLM 在无检索时答对，但加入准确外部文档后答错。机制诊断基于生成时的内部 attention matrix。两个关键指标是 Visual Attention Mass，即分配给视觉 token 的总注意力质量；以及 Visual Attention Sharpness，即剩余视觉注意力是否集中到关键区域。诊断结果显示两类塌缩同时出现：一是 visual blindness，外部文本吸走 softmax 预算，视觉注意力质量和尖锐度下降；二是 textual positional bias，注意力集中在文本序列边界，类似多模态场景中的 lost-in-the-middle。BAIR 是一个无参数推理期干预，直接修改 pre-softmax attention logits：恢复视觉注意力质量，提高视觉焦点，同时对文本边界或位置偏置施加惩罚，减少机械复制文本片段的倾向。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖医学、地理空间事实性和社会公平性场景。作者报告，加入准确检索文档后，部分原本正确的视觉预测会翻转为错误答案；更关键的是，成功 RAG 和 recorruption failure 的 attention profile 在统计上很接近，说明不少正确输出可能只是答案刚好位于模型偏好的文本边界位置。BAIR 在不训练、不微调的条件下修正了一部分 recorrupted generation，并减少冗余文本带来的幻觉。已给出的内容没有包含完整量化表格，因此不宜补充具体提升幅度；可确认的实验结论是，attention-level 干预比简单信任 oracle context 更能保留视觉 grounding。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。优先看 recorruption 的定义和样例，确认评估集合如何筛出“无 RAG 答对、加 RAG 答错”的实例。机制部分重点看 Visual Attention Mass、Visual Attention Sharpness 的定义，以及成功 RAG 与失败 RAG 的 attention profile 对比。方法部分看 BAIR 如何修改 pre-softmax attention，而不是后处理答案。实验部分重点检查三件事：oracle 文档的构造是否真的无噪声；位置偏置是否随文档长度和答案位置变化；BAIR 是否会在需要依赖文本证据的样例上过度提升视觉权重。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies an instance-level failure mode in multimodal RAG. Even when the retrieved document is accurate, adding it to the context can cause an MLLM to abandon an initially correct visual answer and produce a wrong one. The authors call this recorruption. The key issue is not whether RAG improves average accuracy, but how external text can suppress visual evidence inside a unified multimodal context.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to VLM pretraining and multimodal architecture design because it exposes a weakness of early-fusion models: image and text tokens compete within the same softmax attention budget. Long retrieved text can reduce both the amount and quality of attention allocated to visual tokens. This matters for multimodal long-context training, retrieval-augmented multimodal modeling, and alignment losses that are expected to preserve visual grounding. It also cautions against evaluating multimodal RAG only by final accuracy, since a correct answer may come from positional copying rather than grounded image-text reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors define recorruption as the case where the base model answers correctly without retrieval but fails after receiving an accurate external document. They diagnose the behavior through generation-time attention matrices. Two metrics are introduced: Visual Attention Mass, the total attention assigned to visual tokens, and Visual Attention Sharpness, whether the remaining visual attention is concentrated enough to support perception. The diagnosis identifies two coupled effects: visual blindness, where retrieved text absorbs the attention budget and weakens visual focus; and textual positional bias, where attention spikes at the boundaries of the text sequence. BAIR is a parameter-free inference-time intervention that edits pre-softmax attention logits. It restores visual mass, sharpens visual focus, and applies a position-aware penalty to reduce boundary-driven textual copying.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluations span medical, geospatial factuality, and social-fairness settings. The reported findings show that accurate retrieved context can flip correct visual predictions into wrong outputs. A central diagnostic result is that successful RAG cases and recorruption failures can have statistically similar attention profiles, suggesting that some correct answers arise from favorable text position rather than robust grounding. BAIR corrects part of the recorrupted generations and reduces text-induced hallucination without retraining or fine-tuning. The provided content does not include the full quantitative tables, so exact gains should be read from the experimental section rather than inferred.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. First inspect the formal definition and examples of recorruption, especially how the authors identify cases where the no-RAG model is correct and the oracle-context model fails. Then read the attention diagnostics: the definitions of Visual Attention Mass and Visual Attention Sharpness, and the comparison between successful RAG and failure cases. For the method, focus on how BAIR modifies pre-softmax attention rather than post-processing outputs. In the experiments, check three details: whether the oracle documents are truly clean, how answer position and document length affect the bias, and whether increasing visual attention hurts cases that genuinely require textual evidence.

recommendation.zh: 值得看机制部分，不是因为它解决了 RAG，而是它提醒你很多“检索提升”可能只是文本复制偏置；先读 attention 分析和 Illusion of Success 那几张图。
recommendation.en: Read it for the failure analysis, not for a new RAG recipe: it suggests many multimodal RAG gains may just be text-copy bias; the attention diagnostics and the 'Illusion of Success' section are the real payload.

institutions: Elmore Family School of Electrical and Computer Engineering

paper.title: Attractor Geometry of Transformer Memory: From Conflict Arbitration to Confident Hallucination
paper.abstract: Language models draw on two knowledge sources: facts baked into weights (parametric memory, PM) and information in context (working memory, WM). We study two mechanistically distinct failure modes--conflict, when PM and WM disagree and interfere; and hallucination, when the queried fact was never learned. Both produce confident output regardless, making output-based monitoring blind by design. We show both failures share a unified geometric account. In the hidden-state space of autoregressive ge

summary.core_problem: Transformer存在两类无法通过输出置信度检测的记忆失效模式：训练习得的参数记忆与输入上下文的工作记忆发生冲突时的仲裁失败，以及模型未习得对应知识时的幻觉，两类错误均伴随高输出置信度，现有基于输出熵的监测方法无法有效识别，且效果随模型规模增大反而退化。
summary.importance: 从机制层面统一解释了Transformer记忆冲突与幻觉的几何本质，为预训练阶段的记忆可靠性优化、推理阶段的失效检测提供了新的几何视角，弥补了输出层面监测的固有缺陷。
summary.technical_approach: 构建实体ID映射到5位编码的可控合成记忆任务，通过LoRA分别在Transformer不同组件（QK、VO、MLP、全参数）注入参数记忆，用上下文示例提供工作记忆，建立吸引子几何框架：MLP权重更新塑造持久的吸引子盆地对应参数记忆，注意力提供瞬态转向对应工作记忆，冲突来自两类力的竞争，幻觉来自无对应吸引子盆地时隐藏态的自由漂移。
summary.experiments: 1. 组件因果验证：仅MLP层LoRA会生成持久吸引子盆地，QK层LoRA仅修改路由不改变盆地，VO层仅干扰内容回写，雅可比分解验证该机制是预训练架构的固有属性；2. 冲突模式：单模板训练的脆弱参数记忆盆地浅且受格式限制，冲突时工作记忆占优；多模板带干扰训练的鲁棒参数记忆盆地深且格式无关，冲突时会完全抑制上下文（上下文失聪），两类场景下输出熵均无明显变化，准确率却随生成步骤下降；3. 幻觉模式：无对应吸引子时隐藏态远离所有盆地中心，输出仍维持高置信度，几何间隔可完美区分该场景，且随模型规模增大，高置信度幻觉的比例呈指数增长。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注Introduction部分的吸引子框架核心逻辑、以及三类实验发现的结论，预计阅读时间20分钟；如需深挖可参考实验设计部分的可控合成任务构建方法。

summary_en.core_problem: Transformers have two undetectable memory failure modes: arbitration failure when pre-trained parametric memory conflicts with context-based working memory, and hallucination when the model has not learned the queried fact. Both errors come with high output confidence, and existing output entropy-based monitoring fails to identify them, with performance degrading as model scale increases.
summary_en.importance: Provides a unified mechanistic explanation for the geometric nature of Transformer memory conflict and hallucination. Offers a new geometric perspective for optimizing memory reliability during pre-training and detecting failures during inference, addressing inherent limitations of output-level monitoring.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs a controlled synthetic memory task mapping entity IDs to 5-digit codes. Uses LoRA to inject parametric memory into separate Transformer components (QK, VO, MLP, full parameters), with in-context examples providing working memory. Establishes an attractor geometry framework: MLP weight updates shape persistent attractor basins corresponding to parametric memory, attention provides transient steering corresponding to working memory, conflict arises from competition between the two forces, and hallucination comes from free drift of hidden states when no corresponding attractor basin exists.
summary_en.experiments: 1. Component causal verification: MLP-only LoRA generates persistent attractor basins, QK-layer LoRA only modifies routing without changing basins, VO-layer only interferes with content write-back. Jacobian decomposition confirms this mechanism is an inherent property of the pre-trained architecture. 2. Conflict mode: Brittle parametric memory (single-template training) has shallow, format-gated basins, so working memory dominates during conflict; robust parametric memory (multi-template training with distractors) has deep, format-invariant basins, which completely suppress context (context deafness) during conflict. Output entropy shows no significant change in both scenarios, while accuracy drops with generation steps. 3. Hallucination mode: When no corresponding attractor exists, hidden states stay far from all basin centers, but output remains highly confident. Geometric margin can perfectly distinguish this scenario, and the proportion of high-confidence hallucinations grows exponentially with model scale.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the core logic of the attractor framework in the Introduction and conclusions of the three experimental sets for skimming, with an estimated reading time of 20 minutes. For deeper exploration, review the controlled synthetic task design in the Experimental Design section.

recommendation.zh: 用吸引子几何统一解释冲突和幻觉的机制非常扎实，LM头无法区分盆地状态的结论对预训练目标设计有直接启发。
recommendation.en: The unified attractor geometry account of both conflict and hallucination is mechanistically sound; the LM head's inability to distinguish basin states has direct implications for pretraining objective design.

paper.title: Self-Attention as Transport: Limits of Symmetric Spectral Diagnostics
paper.abstract: Large language models hallucinate in predictable ways: attention routing fails by over-concentrating on a narrow set of positions, or by spreading so diffusely that relevance is diluted, and the shape of the failure carries diagnostic signal. A widely used family of spectral methods analyzes the symmetric component of the degree-normalized attention operator, which governs transport capacity; we prove that every transpose-invariant spectral diagnostic of this operator is structurally orientation

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论的不是如何提升模型能力，而是一个更基础的诊断边界问题：如果把 self-attention 看成 query 到 key 的双部传输算子，那么现有很多基于谱量的 attention 诊断，到底能看见什么、看不见什么。作者指出，常见谱诊断往往只能看到“容量”或“混合程度”，却看不到“方向性”。这会导致两类机制上相反的失败模式——注意力过度集中形成瓶颈，和注意力过度扩散导致信号稀释——在某些对称谱统计下表现得很像。论文要解决的核心问题，就是给这种不可分辨性建立一个严格的结构性上界。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 基座研究的直接相关性不如训练方法论文强，但对机制分析和训练诊断有方法论价值。它的贡献不是提出一个更好的 hallucination detector，而是澄清一类诊断工具的能力边界：凡是只依赖奇异值或对称部分的谱方法，都天然对转置不敏感，也就无法恢复路由方向。这一点对 interpretability、训练动态分析、attention head 健康度诊断都有意义。尤其是当研究者试图用单个谱指标解释 hallucination、长上下文失败或 head specialization 时，这篇论文提醒你：如果诊断对象本身抹掉了反对称信息，那么再精细地调统计量也补不回来。
summary.technical_approach:
作者先把每个 attention head 形式化为 degree-normalized bipartite transport operator。给定 row-stochastic attention matrix B，通过 query/key 度归一化得到 M = D_Q^{-1/2} B D_K^{-1/2}。这样做的目的，是把不同长度、不同度分布下的 attention 映射到一个更可比的、尺度不变的对象上。随后引入 Hermitian dilation，把矩形双部算子的谱分析转成对称块矩阵的谱分析，因此奇异值就成为对称诊断的核心对象。

论文的关键分解是把 M 在 Hilbert–Schmidt 内积下正交分解为对称部分 M_sym 和反对称部分 M_asym。作者给出的主结论是：任何只依赖奇异值，或者只依赖 M_sym 的谱诊断，都对转置不变，因此结构上 orientation-blind。换句话说，这类方法只能看 transport capacity，不能看 transport direction。随后又给出一个定量 converse：任意 Lipschitz 的 transpose-sensitive 诊断，其敏感度都受 ||M_asym||_F 控制。于是反对称残差就成了恢复方向信息所需的最小补充量。

在对称轴上，作者用 conductance 和 Cheeger inequality 建立诊断语义。低 conductance 对应 bottleneck routing，高得异常的 conductance 对应 diffuse mixing。这里有个重要细节：论文不是把高 conductance 简单解释为“好”，而是给出双侧解释——过低和过高都可能是失败模式，只是机制不同。作者还提出 degree sufficiency theorem，说明在什么条件下，耦合结构提供的信息超出单纯度异质性。

另一个有意思的部分是闭式架构基线。对 uniform causal attention，作者推导出一个与序列长度 n 无关的 conductance 下界 1/5，最坏 cut 出现在 t*/n 约 0.32；而 window attention 的 conductance 会按 O(w/n) 下穿这个下界。这个结果把“健康路由”的基线和具体位置编码/注意力架构联系起来，使得经验上统计“有多少 head 跌破 1/5”成为一种架构签名。

经验部分还强调 object vs estimator 的区分。理论对象是真实 conductance ϕ，经验上算的是 spectral sweep estimator \hat{ϕ}。后者会通过有限长度、估计过程引入长度依赖，因此如果不做 length-controlled evaluation，AUROC 之类指标会被长度混淆显著抬高。作者把这点单独拎出来，是因为很多 attention 诊断工作容易把估计器偏差误当成结构信号。
summary.experiments:
实验重点不是大规模 benchmark 刷分，而是验证理论预测是否在真实模型和数据上成立。文中提到长度控制后，原始 AUROC 最多会下降 0.28，说明不少看似有效的谱特征其实部分依赖长度混淆。这个结果本身就很重要，因为它直接影响任何基于 attention 谱量的诊断结论可信度。

在 failure mode 分析上，作者报告了数据集间的极性差异：HaluEval 更偏 bottleneck routing，MedHallu 更偏 diffuse routing。这正对应前面 conductance 双侧理论的预测，也说明 hallucination 不是单一机制。对称轴承载了 decoder-only transformer 中的主要诊断信号，而反对称轴通常较稀疏，但在某些架构里更明显，例如 Flan-T5 的 cross-attention 和带 RoPE 的 Pythia。这个观察说明方向信息不是普遍强信号，却在特定结构中不能忽略。

还有一类实验是架构签名验证。uniform causal attention 的 1/5 下界和 window attention 的 O(w/n) 穿透行为，为经验统计提供了参照。作者据此考察不同位置编码/注意力机制下，多少 head 会跌破 1/5，用来区分架构族。虽然这部分更偏分析性而非性能导向，但对理解 attention 结构差异很有帮助。

从基座研究员角度看，实验的局限也很清楚：它没有把这些诊断直接接到训练 loss spike、数据污染、长上下文退化等更贴近训练的问题上，因此当前更像一套机制分析工具箱，而不是可直接部署的训练监控方案。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，不建议逐行啃完证明。先看 Introduction，把作者要立的边界条件读清楚：不是做更强检测器，而是证明一类谱诊断天然看不到方向。然后看 Section 2 和 Section 3，理解 M 的定义、Hermitian dilation、conductance 与 spectral gap 的关系。

如果只花 25 分钟，优先看四处：
1. Theorem 4：orientation blindness 的正式表述；
2. 定量 converse，也就是 transpose sensitivity 如何受 ||M_asym||_F 控制；
3. uniform causal attention 的 1/5 conductance 下界；
4. length-controlled evaluation 的实验图，尤其 AUROC 被校正后下降的幅度。

阅读时要抓住一个主线：作者把 attention 诊断拆成“对称轴看容量/混合，反对称轴看方向”。只要这个框架吃透，后面的定理和实验就容易定位。若想进一步深挖，可以思考两件事：一是这些指标能否用于训练过程中的 head collapse / over-mixing 监控；二是反对称残差是否能和特定位置编码、因果掩码设计、跨注意力结构建立更直接的机制联系。预计 30–45 分钟可以完成有效泛读。

summary_en.core_problem: This paper is not about improving model quality directly. It asks a more basic diagnostic question: if self-attention is treated as a bipartite transport operator from queries to keys, what can spectral attention diagnostics actually detect, and what do they fundamentally miss? The authors argue that many existing spectral methods only capture transport capacity or mixing, but not directionality. As a result, two mechanistically opposite failure modes—over-concentrated bottlenecks and over-diffuse routing—can look deceptively similar under symmetric spectral summaries. The core contribution is to place a formal structural limit on that indistinguishability.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model research is more methodological than directly pretraining-oriented, but it matters for mechanistic analysis and diagnostic design. The paper does not propose a better hallucination detector. Instead, it clarifies the capability boundary of a whole class of attention diagnostics: any method that depends only on singular values or on the symmetric component is inherently blind to orientation. That matters for interpretability, training diagnostics, and analyses of head specialization. If one tries to explain hallucination, long-context failure, or routing collapse with a single spectral statistic, this paper is a useful warning: once antisymmetric information has been projected away, no amount of refinement on the symmetric side can recover direction.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Each attention head is formalized as a degree-normalized bipartite transport operator. Starting from a row-stochastic attention matrix B, the paper defines M = D_Q^{-1/2} B D_K^{-1/2}, where D_Q and D_K are query and key degree matrices. The normalization is important: it removes scale effects and makes operators more comparable across lengths and degree profiles. The authors then use Hermitian dilation to reduce spectral analysis of a rectangular bipartite operator to spectral analysis of a symmetric block matrix, making singular values the natural object for symmetric diagnostics.

The central decomposition writes M as an orthogonal sum of a symmetric component M_sym and an antisymmetric component M_asym under the Hilbert–Schmidt inner product. The main theorem states that any spectral diagnostic depending only on singular values, or only on M_sym, is invariant under transpose and therefore structurally orientation-blind. In practical terms, such diagnostics can measure transport capacity but cannot recover transport direction. A quantitative converse then shows that the transpose sensitivity of any Lipschitz diagnostic is controlled by ||M_asym||_F. This makes the antisymmetric residual the minimal complementary quantity needed to recover directional information.

On the symmetric axis, the paper builds semantics through conductance and Cheeger-type reasoning. Low conductance corresponds to bottleneck routing; abnormally high conductance corresponds to diffuse mixing. A useful nuance is that high conductance is not treated as automatically healthy. The theory is explicitly two-sided: both too little and too much mixing can indicate failure, but for different reasons. The degree sufficiency theorem further characterizes when coupling structure contributes information beyond simple degree heterogeneity.

A particularly interesting part is the closed-form architectural benchmark. For uniform causal attention, the authors derive an n-independent lower bound of 1/5 on conductance, with the worst cut near t*/n ≈ 0.32. For window attention, conductance can fall below this floor at O(w/n). This links a notion of healthy routing to concrete architectural choices, and turns the empirical fraction of heads falling below 1/5 into a population-level architectural signature.

The paper also makes a careful distinction between the object and the estimator. The theoretical object is true conductance ϕ, while empirical work uses a spectral sweep estimator \hat{ϕ}. The latter inherits finite-length artifacts, so length dependence in experiments may come from estimation bias rather than from the underlying transport property. That distinction is one of the more practically useful parts of the paper.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are designed to validate the theory rather than to maximize benchmark scores. One of the clearest empirical findings is that length-controlled evaluation matters a great deal: raw AUROC can drop by as much as 0.28 after controlling for length. This means a nontrivial part of the apparent predictive power of spectral attention features may come from sequence-length confounding rather than genuine routing structure.

For failure-mode analysis, the paper reports polarity differences across datasets. HaluEval is more consistent with bottleneck routing, while MedHallu is more consistent with diffuse routing. This matches the two-sided conductance theory and supports the claim that hallucination is not a single mechanism. The symmetric axis carries most of the usable signal in decoder-only transformers, whereas the antisymmetric axis is usually sparse but becomes more visible in certain architectures, including Flan-T5 cross-attention and RoPE-based Pythia models. That is a useful empirical nuance: directional information is not always dominant, but it is architecture-dependent and sometimes essential.

Another set of experiments uses the architectural benchmark. The 1/5 conductance floor for uniform causal attention and the O(w/n) behavior for window attention provide a reference for measuring how many empirical heads pierce the floor. The resulting population statistic helps distinguish architectural regimes. This is more analytical than performance-driven, but it gives a concrete way to compare routing structure across model families.

From a foundation-model perspective, the limitation is also clear. The paper does not yet connect these diagnostics directly to training-time phenomena such as loss spikes, data corruption, or long-context degradation under optimization. At this stage, it is better viewed as a mechanistic diagnostic toolkit than as an immediately deployable training monitor.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. It is not necessary to read every proof in detail. Start with the introduction to understand the boundary the authors are trying to establish: not a stronger detector, but a theorem showing that a broad class of spectral diagnostics cannot see direction. Then read Sections 2 and 3 to understand the operator M, the role of Hermitian dilation, and the link between conductance and spectral gap.

If you only have about 25 minutes, focus on four items:
1. Theorem 4, which formalizes orientation blindness.
2. The quantitative converse showing how transpose sensitivity scales with ||M_asym||_F.
3. The 1/5 conductance floor for uniform causal attention.
4. The length-controlled evaluation figures, especially the AUROC drop after debiasing.

The main conceptual thread is simple and worth retaining: the symmetric axis measures capacity and mixing, while the antisymmetric axis carries direction. Once that split is clear, the rest of the paper becomes easier to place. Two natural follow-up questions are whether these diagnostics can be used to monitor head collapse or over-mixing during training, and whether the antisymmetric residual can be tied more directly to positional encoding, causal masking, or cross-attention design. A useful skim should take around 30–45 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会修正你看 attention 谱图的习惯：凡是只看对称谱的诊断都可能把方向性抹平；读定理和 causal/window 两个解析例子就够了。
recommendation.en: This should update how you read attention spectra: any diagnostic built only on the symmetric part can erase directionality; the theorem and the causal/window examples are the parts to read.

paper.title: Gradients with Respect to Semantics Preserving Embeddings Tell the Uncertainty of Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Uncertainty quantification (UQ) is an important technique for ensuring the trustworthiness of LLMs, given their tendency to hallucinate. Existing state-of-the-art UQ approaches for free-form generation rely heavily on sampling, which incurs high computational cost and variance. In this work, we propose the first gradient-based UQ method for free-form generation, SemGrad, which is sampling-free and computationally efficient. Unlike prior gradient-based methods developed for classification tasks t

summary.core_problem: 为 LLM 自由生成提供低成本不确定性估计，避免依赖多次采样带来的计算开销和方差。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是方法创新和可靠性分析。它把不确定性估计从采样式语义聚类转向语义空间梯度，适合关注幻觉检测、模型置信度和训练信号质量的研究员，但与预训练目标本身距离较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SemGrad，核心假设是：如果模型对输入语义有把握，那么在语义等价扰动下输出分布应保持稳定。方法先用 Semantic Preservation Score 选择更能保持语义的 embedding 表示，再计算相对于这些语义保持 embedding 的梯度，用梯度稳定性估计不确定性。还提出 HybridGrad，将梯度信号与其他不确定性信号结合。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、数据集、baseline、指标或提升幅度。可确认比较对象是现有依赖采样的 free-form generation UQ 方法，以及传统面向分类任务、在参数空间中计算梯度的不确定性方法。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to estimate uncertainty for free-form LLM generation without relying on expensive and high-variance sampling.
summary_en.importance: This is a reliability and analysis method contribution. It shifts uncertainty estimation from sample-based semantic clustering toward gradients in semantic embedding space, which is relevant to hallucination detection and confidence measurement but not directly to pretraining objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach: SemGrad assumes that a confident LLM should maintain stable output distributions under semantically equivalent input perturbations. It introduces a Semantic Preservation Score to select embeddings that best preserve semantics, then computes gradients with respect to those embeddings. HybridGrad combines this gradient signal with other uncertainty signals.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, datasets, baselines, metrics, or improvement numbers. The stated comparison points are sampling-heavy UQ methods for free-form generation and prior gradient-based UQ methods designed for classification.

recommendation.zh: 读方法直觉即可，实验数字先打折；语义等价扰动的定义若不稳，梯度置信度会很脆。
recommendation.en: Read the method intuition, but discount the numbers until the semantic-preserving perturbation setup is inspected; that choice can make the gradient signal brittle.

paper.title: From Priors to Perception: Grounding Video-LLMs in Physical Reality
paper.abstract: While Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) excel in general understanding, they exhibit systematic deficits in fine-grained physical reasoning. Existing interventions not only suffer from limited generalization but fundamentally conflate generative artifacts with genuine physical fallacies. Furthermore, we find that models fail systematically not only in anti-physics anomalies but also in counter-intuitive scenarios where visual facts contradict statistical expectations. Accordingly, we prop

summary.core_problem: Video-LLM存在细粒度物理推理的系统性缺陷，现有干预方法泛化性差且混淆生成伪影与真实物理谬误，模型同时在反物理异常和视觉事实违背统计预期的反常识场景下失败，根因未被明确
summary.importance: 机制分析贡献，首次提出语义先验主导（Semantic Prior Dominance）假说来解释Video-LLM的物理推理缺陷，构建了首个基于物理定律合成的高保真对抗视频数据集PACC，提出了视觉锚定推理链VARC方法
summary.technical_approach: 原创提出统一归因理论，将双重失败归因于语义先验主导而非感知缺陷；构建程序生成的对抗课程数据集PACC，解耦视觉伪影与逻辑错误；设计VARC方法强化推理过程的视觉锚定
summary.experiments: 在PACC数据集上验证了VARC方法对物理推理能力的提升效果，验证了语义先验主导假说的合理性
summary.authors_note: 作者来自上海交通大学，无已知知名大模型研究者

summary_en.core_problem: Video-LLMs have systematic deficits in fine-grained physical reasoning, existing intervention methods have poor generalization and conflate generative artifacts with genuine physical fallacies; models fail both on anti-physics anomalies and counter-intuitive scenarios where visual facts contradict statistical expectations, with unclear root causes
summary_en.importance: Mechanism analysis contribution: first proposes the Semantic Prior Dominance hypothesis to explain Video-LLM physical reasoning deficits, constructs PACC, the first high-fidelity adversarial video dataset synthesized based on physical laws, and proposes the Visual-Anchored Reasoning Chain (VARC) method
summary_en.technical_approach: Originally proposes the Unified Attribution Theory, attributing the dual failure mode to semantic prior dominance rather than perception deficiency; builds programmatically generated adversarial curriculum dataset PACC to decouple visual artifacts from logical errors; designs VARC to strengthen visual anchoring during reasoning
summary_en.experiments: Verified the improvement effect of VARC on physical reasoning capability on the PACC dataset, and validated the rationality of the Semantic Prior Dominance hypothesis
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Shanghai Jiao Tong University, no well-known large model researchers identified

recommendation.zh: Video-LLM物理推理缺陷的机制分析，仅需查看摘要中关于语义先验主导的核心结论即可
recommendation.en: Mechanism analysis of Video-LLM physical reasoning deficits, only check the core conclusion on Semantic Prior Dominance in the abstract

paper.title: Local Intrinsic Dimension Unveils Hallucinations in Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion models are prone to generating structural hallucinations - samples that match the statistical properties of the training data yet defy underlying structural rules, resulting in anomalies like hands with more than five fingers. Recent research studied this failure mode from several viewpoints, offering partial explanations to their occurrence, such as mode interpolation. In this work, we propose a complementary perspective that treats hallucinations as instabilities on the model-induced

summary.core_problem: 解释并缓解扩散模型中的结构性幻觉，尤其是样本外观统计合理但结构规则错误的生成失败模式。
summary.importance: 贡献更偏机制分析与诊断：把 hallucination 解释为模型流形上的不稳定性，并提出可操作的校正机制。对做新型语言建模范式、尤其 diffusion LM/生成稳定性的研究员有间接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先构造基于 instability 的 hallucination 过滤器，再追踪不稳定性的来源，提出局部内在维度（LID）是主要驱动因素。基于这一判断，作者提出 Intrinsic Quenching（IQ），直接压低局部内在维度以减少幻觉。方法核心不是换 backbone，而是引入一个几何诊断量并把它变成干预信号。
summary.experiments: 摘要称 IQ 在多种 benchmark 和现有 hallucination reduction baseline 上持续更优，并且基于 instability 的过滤器达到或超过近期 temporal 方法。但摘要未给出模型规模、数据规模、具体数据集和提升幅度，因此证据强度需要看正文中的定量表格再判断。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 Warsaw University of Technology、University of Warsaw、Massachusetts General Hospital、Harvard Medical School。更像一篇生成模型机制分析工作，而非大规模基础模型训练报告。

summary_en.core_problem: It aims to explain and mitigate structural hallucinations in diffusion models, where samples match training statistics but violate structural rules.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly mechanistic and diagnostic: it frames hallucinations as instabilities on the model-induced manifold and turns that view into a corrective method. This is indirectly relevant to researchers working on alternative language modeling paradigms, especially diffusion-style generation stability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper first builds an instability-based hallucination filter, then traces the source of those instabilities and argues that local intrinsic dimension (LID) is the main driver. Based on that, it proposes Intrinsic Quenching (IQ), which directly suppresses local intrinsic dimension to reduce hallucinations. The key idea is not a new backbone but a geometric diagnostic turned into an intervention signal.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims that IQ consistently beats standard hallucination-reduction baselines across multiple benchmarks, and that the instability-based filter matches or exceeds a recent temporal baseline. However, the abstract does not report model sizes, data scales, datasets, or effect sizes, so the strength of evidence depends on the full paper tables.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include Warsaw University of Technology, University of Warsaw, Massachusetts General Hospital, and Harvard Medical School. This reads as a generative-model mechanism paper rather than a large-scale foundation-model training report.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在看 diffusion LM 或生成稳定性，只读 LID 假说和 IQ 实验段落；机制视角有意思，但离基座预训练主线仍偏远，先当弱信号。
recommendation.en: If you care about diffusion LM or generation stability, read the LID hypothesis and IQ experiments only; the mechanism angle is interesting, but it is still peripheral to core pretraining.

institutions: Centre for Credible AI, Warsaw University of Technology

paper.title: Geometric Deviation as an Unsupervised Pre-Generation Reliability Signal: Probing LLM Representations for Answerability
paper.abstract: A reliable language model should be able to signal, prior to generation, when a query falls outside its knowledge. We investigate whether representation geometry can provide such a pre-generation signal by measuring the deviation of hidden states from an answerable reference set, requiring no labeled failure data and no access to model outputs. Across three instruction-tuned models (Llama 3.1-8B, Qwen 2.5-7B, and Mistral-7B-Instruct) and three prompt forms (Math, Fact, Code), we find that geomet

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究一个轻量可靠性信号：在生成之前，仅根据 hidden states 的几何位置，判断一个输入是否可能不可回答。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在表示层面。论文显示，某些不可回答性不是只在输出阶段或拒答策略中出现，而是在早层 hidden states 中已经形成几何偏离。更具体地说，数学问题中的不可回答样本会偏离可回答样本的表示中心，而事实类问题没有稳定信号。这提示 answerability 不是一个统一的模型属性，它与任务形式、输入结构和对齐策略都有关系。对基座模型研究来说，这有助于区分两类问题：模型是否编码了“不该回答”的结构信息，以及 post-train 是否把这种信息转化成拒答或谨慎回答。
summary.technical_approach: 方法很简单。作者先构造可回答样本的参考集合，取 hidden states 的均值作为 answerable centroid；对新输入，计算其 hidden state 与这个中心的余弦距离，距离越远则越可能不可回答。为减弱 Transformer 表示的各向异性，方法使用 mean-centering。实验设计使用 matched pairs：每个不可回答提示都匹配一个同领域、同长度、同句法形式的可回答提示，只改变导致不可回答的属性。这样可以尽量排除表面形式差异。分析覆盖不同层，并比较不同任务形式：Math、Fact、Code。方法不需要失败样本标签、不需要模型输出、不需要采样，也不需要训练 probe。它与 PRISM、MHAD 这类监督内部状态检测不同，后者依赖标注的幻觉或事实性信号。
summary.experiments: 实验使用三个 7–8B instruction-tuned 模型：Llama 3.1-8B-Instruct、Qwen 2.5-7B-Instruct 和 Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3。数学提示上，几何偏离能稳定区分不可回答输入，ROC-AUC 为 0.78–0.84，超过简单 refusal baseline，也优于需要 5 倍推理成本的 multi-sample self-consistency baseline。事实类提示上，三种模型都没有显著几何信号，说明该方法不能直接泛化到所有知识问答。代码提示上，三个模型都有较大 effect size，但在当前样本量下显著性不稳定。层分析显示信号在早层最强，通常集中在第 2–5 层，越接近输出层越弱。模型行为也不同：同样的几何 outlier，Qwen 更可能拒答，Llama 不一定拒答，说明 alignment 决定了模型如何使用这些内部信号。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 15–25 分钟。重点看方法部分的 centroid distance 定义、mean-centering 处理和 matched-pair 构造；再看分任务结果表，尤其是 Math 有信号、Fact 无信号、Code 不稳定这三个边界。层级分析图值得看，因为“早层最强”是最有研究含义的观察。读的时候应保留一个限制：这种方法依赖任务形式较规整、可回答参考集容易获得的场景；如果输入分布混杂，几何距离可能首先编码 task form，而不是 answerability。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether hidden-state geometry can provide a pre-generation signal of answerability, without using model outputs, labeled failure data, or a trained probe.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining research is diagnostic. The results suggest that some forms of unanswerability are encoded early in the representation geometry, before decoding and before explicit refusal behavior. The signal is not universal: it is reliable for mathematical prompts, absent for factual prompts, and suggestive but less statistically stable for code. This distinction is useful for separating representation-level knowledge from alignment-level action. A model may internally mark an input as structurally out-of-distribution while its post-training policy may or may not turn that signal into refusal.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method builds an answerable reference set and computes a centroid in hidden-state space. A new prompt is scored by cosine distance from that centroid after mean-centering, which reduces the dominant-direction anisotropy common in LLM representations. The design uses matched answerable and unanswerable prompt pairs that share domain, length, and syntactic form, changing only the property that makes the prompt unanswerable. This is meant to isolate answerability from surface form. The analysis is layer-wise and task-form-specific, covering Math, Fact, and Code. Unlike supervised hallucination detectors such as PRISM or MHAD, the method does not train a classifier on labeled failures and does not require generated text.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover Llama 3.1-8B-Instruct, Qwen 2.5-7B-Instruct, and Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3. On mathematical prompts, centroid deviation separates unanswerable from answerable inputs with ROC-AUC between 0.78 and 0.84 across the three models. It outperforms a simple refusal-based baseline and compares favorably to a five-sample self-consistency baseline with higher inference cost. On factual prompts, no significant signal appears in any model. On code prompts, effect sizes are large across models, but statistical significance is mixed at the studied sample size. Layer-wise results show the strongest signal in early layers, around layers 2–5, and a general decline toward the output layer. The same geometric outliers can lead to different behaviors: Qwen is more likely to refuse, while Llama may not, indicating that alignment changes how the model acts on the signal.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 15–25 minutes. Focus on the centroid-distance method, the mean-centering step, and the matched-pair construction. Then read the task-form results, because the boundary between Math, Fact, and Code is the main empirical point. The layer-wise plots are the most relevant part for researchers interested in representation formation. The main caveat is that geometry can encode task form more strongly than answerability; the approach is most plausible when the query format is controlled and an answerable reference set is available.

recommendation.zh: 读数学/事实对比那组结果；它提醒别把 hidden geometry 的不确定性信号误当通用能力。
recommendation.en: Read the math-vs-fact comparison; it is a useful warning against treating hidden-state geometry as a universal uncertainty signal.

paper.title: Perceptual Flow Network for Visually Grounded Reasoning
paper.abstract: Despite the success of Large-Vision Language Models (LVLMs), general optimization objectives (e.g., standard MLE) fail to constrain visual trajectories, leading to language bias and hallucination. To mitigate this, current methods introduce geometric priors from visual experts as additional supervision. However, we observe that such supervision is typically suboptimal: it is biased toward geometric precision and offers limited reasoning utility. To bridge this gap, we propose Perceptual Flow Net

summary.core_problem: LVLM 在视觉推理时，直接对齐视觉专家（如 GroundingDINO）的几何先验（如精确的边界框）会导致“管中窥豹”效应，反而限制了推理能力并引发幻觉。
summary.importance: 揭示了视觉定位（Grounding）与视觉推理（Reasoning）在目标上的错位，提出了一种解耦感知与推理的自条件生成范式，为 VLM 的 RL 微调提供了新思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PFlowNet。核心是不再强制模型严格对齐静态的几何先验，而是：1) 将感知行为建模为结构化的“感知流”（Perceptual Flow，即 RoI 序列）；2) 解耦感知与推理，模型先采样内在分布生成感知轨迹，再基于此进行自回归推理；3) 采用变分强化微调（Variational RL Fine-Tuning），结合多维奖励和邻域几何塑形（vicinal geometric shaping），优化感知轨迹。
summary.experiments: 在 V* Bench、TreeBench 和 MME-RealWorld-lite 上，基于 Qwen2.5-VL 8B，分别取得了 13.1%、10.4% 和 21% 的显著提升，证明了该方法在细粒度视觉任务中的有效性。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Introduction 中的 Preliminary Study（图1），理解为什么精确的几何先验不适合推理。其次看 Method 中如何将感知轨迹形式化为隐变量，以及变分强化微调的目标函数设计。

summary_en.core_problem: In LVLMs, directly aligning with geometric priors from visual experts (e.g., precise bounding boxes from GroundingDINO) causes a 'tunnel vision' effect, which limits reasoning capabilities and induces hallucinations.
summary_en.importance: Reveals the misalignment between visual grounding and visual reasoning objectives. Proposes a self-conditioned generation paradigm that decouples perception and reasoning, offering a novel perspective for RL fine-tuning in VLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces PFlowNet. Instead of forcing rigid alignment with static geometric priors, it: 1) models perceptual behavior as a structured 'Perceptual Flow' (a sequence of RoIs); 2) decouples perception from reasoning, where the model first samples an intrinsic distribution to generate a perceptual trajectory, then performs self-conditioned autoregressive reasoning; 3) employs Variational Reinforcement Fine-Tuning with multi-dimensional rewards and vicinal geometric shaping to optimize the trajectory.
summary_en.experiments: Based on Qwen2.5-VL 8B, it achieves significant improvements of 13.1%, 10.4%, and 21% on V* Bench, TreeBench, and MME-RealWorld-lite, respectively, demonstrating its effectiveness in fine-grained visual tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Preliminary Study in the Introduction (Figure 1) to understand why precise geometric priors are suboptimal for reasoning. Then, examine the Method section to see how perceptual trajectories are formalized as latent variables and how the variational RL fine-tuning objective is designed.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫方法和实验表：它质疑几何专家监督的默认收益，但需看 reward 设计是否泄漏任务偏好。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and main tables: it challenges the default value of geometric expert supervision, but the reward design may encode task-specific bias.

paper.title: GEASS: Training-Free Caption Steering for Hallucination Mitigation in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) excel at grounded reasoning but remain prone to object hallucination. Recent work treats self-generated captions as a uniformly positive resource, yet we find that naively embedding one can degrade rather than help--dropping Qwen2.5-VL-3B accuracy on HallusionBench by nearly 10 points. Two structural properties explain this. First, captions anchor not only the model's final answer but also its reasoning trajectory and lexical choices. Second, caption errors are asym

summary.core_problem: VLM 的幻觉缓解里，“给模型塞一段自生成 caption 当额外证据”看起来合理，但全文指出它会因为锚定效应（caption 会重塑推理轨迹与措辞）而在 caption 有错时放大伤害；同时 caption 的错误结构是强不对称的：遗漏多、捏造少，但捏造的单次代价更大。核心问题变成：能否在不训练、不开额外 caption 质量模型的情况下，对每个 query 自适应地决定 caption 应该影响模型多少，从而只吃到 caption 的增益、尽量规避其误导？
summary.importance: 这不是预训练论文，属于推理期的训练-free steering/融合策略；但对“训练信号质量与推理行为”的研究有两点启发：1）把 caption 当作一种外部 noisy teacher signal，强调其错误分布（omission vs fabrication）会决定最优融合策略，这个视角可迁移到合成数据/自训练数据的质量建模；2）用 logit-level 的可计算代理（置信度、信息增益、分歧惩罚）做动态门控，提供了一种低成本的 test-time mixture-of-experts/mixture-of-evidence 形式。对预训练的直接贡献有限，但对 VLM 可靠性与“外部证据注入”的方法论有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
GEASS（Gated Evidence-Aware Selective Steering）是一个 plug-and-play 的推理模块，不改模型参数：
- 双路径前向：同一问题跑两次解码/前向，一次不带 caption（clean path），一次带 caption（caption path），得到两套 logits。
- 三个信号控制 caption 影响强度（logit 融合权重/门控）：
  1）Confidence gate（Gated）：用 clean path 的最大概率/置信度衡量“模型是否需要外部帮助”。高置信度时倾向少用 caption，避免被锚定带偏。
  2）Information-gain weight（Evidence-Aware）：用 caption 引入后熵下降（entropy reduction）衡量 caption 是否真的提供了对当前 query 有用的信息，而不是只改变措辞。
  3）Disagreement penalty（Selective）：当两路径预测分歧大时，提高使用 caption 的门槛；编码“caption 更常遗漏、偶尔捏造但代价大”的先验——caption 更适合用来加强模型已有判断，而不适合强行推翻。
- 关键取舍：不去提升 caption 本身质量（避免更强 captioner/外部验证的额外成本），而是承认 caption 混合质量并在 logit 层面调制其锚定效应。代价是每个 query 额外两次前向（文中表述为 only two extra forward passes）。
summary.experiments:
全文在引言给了一个强对照：Qwen2.5-VL-3B 在 HallusionBench 上，直接嵌入自生成 caption 会把准确率从 61.19 降到 51.31（接近 10 点）。GEASS 的目标是在保留 caption 对“全局内容覆盖”的帮助时，避免这种系统性退化。
从摘录能确认：评测包含 HallusionBench，且提到也在 POPE 上验证；并强调训练-free、兼容标准解码。具体 GEASS 带来的提升幅度、在不同问题类型（全局 vs 细节）上的分层结果、以及三信号的消融贡献，需要看实验表格与分组分析部分才能给出精确数字。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–35 分钟）：
- 先看 Section 3（文中提到）关于 anchoring effect 与 error asymmetry 的实证分析：它解释了“为什么 caption 会害人”，比方法本身更可迁移。
- 再看 GEASS 的三信号定义与融合公式：尤其是 entropy reduction 的计算细节、以及 disagreement penalty 如何实现（阈值/温度/重加权）。
- 实验部分重点看：按问题类型分桶（global/detail）的结果、caption 错误类型统计（omission/fabrication）与性能相关性、以及消融（去掉 gate / IG / penalty 各自会怎样）。

summary_en.core_problem: Using self-generated captions as extra evidence is a common hallucination-mitigation trick for VLMs, but the paper shows it can significantly hurt because captions anchor not only the final answer but also the reasoning trajectory and lexical choices. Caption errors are also asymmetric: omissions are frequent, fabrications are rarer but far more damaging per instance. The problem is therefore per-query: how to decide, at inference time and without training, when and how strongly a caption should influence decoding so that it helps on global-coverage queries but does not mislead on detail-sensitive ones.
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining paper; it is a training-free test-time steering method. Still, it offers transferable lessons for foundation-model research around noisy auxiliary signals: (1) treat captions as a noisy teacher/evidence source whose error distribution (omission vs fabrication) dictates the optimal fusion rule—an angle that also applies to synthetic data and self-training pipelines; (2) implement dynamic evidence gating via cheap, logit-level proxies (confidence, information gain, disagreement), resembling a test-time mixture-of-evidence mechanism. Direct impact on pretraining objectives is limited, but it informs reliability and evidence-injection design for VLM systems.
summary_en.technical_approach:
GEASS (Gated Evidence-Aware Selective Steering) is plug-and-play and parameter-free:
- Two-path inference: run the model with the original prompt (clean path) and with an appended self-caption (caption path), producing two logit streams.
- Logit-level modulation using three signals:
  1) Confidence gate: uses the clean-path max probability as a proxy for whether external evidence is needed.
  2) Evidence-aware weight: measures caption usefulness via entropy reduction induced by the caption (information gain proxy).
  3) Selective disagreement penalty: when the two paths disagree, raise the threshold for letting the caption override, encoding the prior that captions mostly omit and occasionally fabricate (high-cost).
- Design choice: do not improve caption quality (no stronger captioner or external verification); instead, control the anchoring effect by regulating caption influence at the logits. Overhead is two additional forward passes per query, compatible with standard decoding as long as logits are accessible.
summary_en.experiments:
A key motivating result is explicit: on HallusionBench, Qwen2.5-VL-3B drops from 61.19 to 51.31 accuracy when a self-generated caption is naively embedded, showing unconditional caption trust is harmful. GEASS is evaluated on HallusionBench and mentioned to be validated on POPE as well.
The excerpt does not include the final GEASS gains, per-category breakdowns (global vs detail questions), or ablations for the three signals; those numbers should be taken from the main experiment tables and grouped analyses.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–35 minutes):
- Prioritize the analysis section (referred to as Section 3) that demonstrates anchoring effects and the omission/fabrication asymmetry; this is the most reusable part.
- Then read the GEASS formulation: exact definitions of entropy reduction, how disagreement is quantified, and the fusion rule.
- In experiments, focus on: stratified results by question type, caption error-type statistics, and ablations removing each of the three signals.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 caption 负收益分析；它提醒图文中间监督要按 query 过滤，别把自生成 caption 当免费 grounding 信号。
recommendation.en: Worth reading for the negative-caption analysis; it is a useful warning that generated captions are not free grounding signals and need query-level filtering.

paper.title: MIRL: Mutual Information-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) frequently suffer from visual perception errors and hallucinations that compromise answer accuracy in complex reasoning tasks. Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) offers a promising solution by optimizing policies using answer correctness signals. Despite their effectiveness, prevailing RLVR methods face two critical limitations. First, much of the sampling budget is wasted on trajectories doomed to fail due to early visual description errors. Seco

summary.core_problem: 在 VLM 的 RLVR（用“答案是否正确”做可验证奖励）训练里，采样成本高且奖励稀疏：大量 rollout 早期就因视觉描述错误而“注定失败”，但仍被完整采样；同时失败只给一个序列级 0/1 信号，无法区分是视觉感知阶段错了还是后续推理错了，导致 credit assignment 很差。
summary.importance: 对“RL 如何更有效地改 VLM 的视觉 grounding”给出一个工程上可落地的中间信号：把互信息（MI）从推理时的 hallucination 抑制手段迁移到训练时，既做低成本的轨迹筛选，也给视觉描述阶段提供独立奖励。对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 post-train（RLVR / GRPO 系）里如何把算力花在更有希望的轨迹上、如何把视觉与推理解耦优化，有明确启发。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分两件事：
1) MI 预筛选 + forking 采样：先从当前策略网络低成本生成多条“视觉描述”（paper 中称 pre-sampled descriptions），用描述与图像之间的互信息作为质量代理，选 top-K 高 MI 的描述再进入后续昂贵的完整推理采样；低 MI 的描述直接丢弃，从而把 rollout 预算集中到更可能成功的分支。
2) 解耦奖励与更新：把训练过程拆成“描述阶段”和“推理/作答阶段”。描述阶段对所有预采样描述都立刻给 MI-based reward 做更新；推理阶段只对高 MI 分支做完整采样，并用最终可验证任务奖励（答案正确性）做策略更新。这样 MI 信号专门拉高视觉 grounding 质量，而最终 reward 仍负责推理正确性，缓解稀疏奖励下的归因混淆。
实现上强调模块化：在 rollout 逻辑里加 forking，在 loss 里加两类 reward；可插到 GRPO、DAPO 这类 RLVR 框架里，不改核心优化器。
summary.experiments: 覆盖数学推理与通用 VQA：MathVista、MathVerse、We-Math、M3CoT、MMStar、RealWorldQA 等。文中给出一个代表性预算配置：先采样 10 条描述，用 MI 选 top-6；每条描述再采样 12 条完整轨迹。对比“直接采样 16 条完整轨迹”，MIRL 在验证集准确率的收敛速度更快，并在总体计算成本下降约 25% 的情况下取得更高性能。消融结论：只用 MI reward 明显不如 MI + task correctness 的组合，说明 MI 更适合作为感知阶段的代理信号，而推理仍需要最终可验证监督。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：
- 先看 Figure 1：它基本把“为什么要解耦、为什么 MI 能同时解决采样效率与 credit assignment”讲清楚。
- 重点看方法部分对两阶段更新的定义：哪些样本拿 MI reward、哪些样本拿 task reward，以及 forking 的预算分配细节（top-K、每分支轨迹数）。
- 再看消融：MI-only vs task-only vs decoupled 的差距，用来判断 MI 信号的边界条件。
预计 30–45 分钟可抓住主要贡献；若要复现，优先核对 MI 估计方式与 rollout 预算配置。

summary_en.core_problem: RL with verifiable rewards (answer correctness) for VLMs is both expensive and poorly shaped: many rollouts are doomed early due to incorrect visual descriptions but still consume full sampling budget, and a single terminal 0/1 reward cannot tell whether failures come from visual grounding or later reasoning, leading to weak credit assignment.
summary_en.importance: The paper contributes a practical intermediate signal for VLM RL post-training: mutual information (MI) between generated descriptions and the image is used (i) to pre-screen branches before expensive rollouts and (ii) as a dedicated reward for the perception/description stage. It is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is relevant to the pretrain↔posttrain loop because it changes how RL budget is allocated and how supervision is decomposed across generation stages.
summary_en.technical_approach:
MIRL combines two ideas:
1) MI-based pre-screening with forking: sample multiple candidate visual descriptions cheaply, score each by MI with the image, keep top-K, and only then run expensive full reasoning rollouts from those descriptions. This reallocates sampling to higher-potential trajectories.
2) Decoupled rewards/updates: all pre-sampled descriptions receive immediate MI-based rewards to update the description policy, while only high-MI branches are fully rolled out and updated with the terminal task reward (verifiable answer correctness). This separates supervision for visual grounding from supervision for reasoning.
Engineering-wise, it is implemented as a modular change to rollout (forking) plus loss computation (two reward channels), and is designed to plug into GRPO/DAPO-style RLVR without changing the core optimizer.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on MathVista, MathVerse, We-Math, M3CoT, MMStar, and RealWorldQA. A representative budget: sample 10 descriptions, select top-6 by MI, then sample 12 full trajectories per selected description. Compared to directly sampling 16 full trajectories, MIRL reaches higher validation accuracy faster and reports ~25% compute reduction while improving final performance. Ablations indicate MI-only training underperforms the combined MI + task-reward setup, suggesting MI is a useful proxy for perception quality but not a replacement for correctness supervision in reasoning.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan:
- Start with Fig. 1 to understand the failure modes and the decoupled training design.
- Read the method section focusing on (a) how MI is computed/approximated, (b) the exact forking budget (top-K, trajectories per branch), and (c) which tokens/segments receive which reward.
- Check the ablations contrasting MI-only, task-only, and decoupled training to learn where MI helps and where it saturates.
~30–45 minutes is enough for the main ideas; deeper reading is needed only if you plan to implement MI scoring and rollout scheduling.

recommendation.zh: 只看 MI reward 定义和 forking 消融；它抓住了 VLM-RLVR 的 credit assignment 痛点，但别先信泛化结论。
recommendation.en: Read the MI reward definition and forking ablations; it targets a real VLM-RLVR credit-assignment issue, but do not overtrust generalization claims.

paper.title: Hallucinations Undermine Trust; Metacognition is a Way Forward
paper.abstract: Despite significant strides in factual reliability, errors -- often termed hallucinations -- remain a major concern for generative AI, especially as LLMs are increasingly expected to be helpful in more complex or nuanced setups. Yet even in the simplest setting -- factoid question-answering with clear ground truth-frontier models without external tools continue to hallucinate. We argue that most factuality gains in this domain have come from expanding the model's knowledge boundary (encoding mor

summary.core_problem: 在“有明确标准答案的 factoid QA、且不使用外部工具”的最简单设定下，前沿模型仍会产生幻觉。论文试图解释一个现象：为什么扩大知识边界（记住更多事实）相对容易，而让模型清楚知道知识边界（知道自己何时不知道）却更难。作者提出关键区分：校准（calibration，置信度与正确率匹配）不等于判别（discrimination，能否把对/错在单样本层面清晰分开）。当判别能力存在缺口时，“零幻觉”与“高效用”之间会出现结构性权衡。
summary.importance:
对预训练研究的直接贡献偏概念与问题框架，但它把“事实性提升来自哪里”拆成两条路径：
- knowledge expansion：靠规模、数据与训练配方把更多事实编码进参数；
- metacognition / faithful uncertainty：让模型的语言层不确定性表达与其内部不确定性对齐。
这个框架对预训练的启发在于：如果判别缺口是结构性的，那么仅靠更强的 truthfulness probe、更重的监督或更长的推理链，可能都难以从根上消除“自信的错误”；更可行的目标是把训练信号转向“实例级不确定性是否忠实”，并把不确定性作为 agent/tool-use 的控制变量。
summary.technical_approach:
论文主要是论证型而非算法型。技术主张包括：
- 将 hallucination 从“任何错误”重新定义为“自信的错误（confident errors）”。在这个定义下，信任与效用不必二选一：模型可以在不确定时用合适的 hedging 表达，把输出语义从‘断言’降级为‘假设’。
- 强调 discrimination gap：即便能从模型中抽取较好校准的置信度信号，也未必能在单样本上可靠地区分对错；因此若强行追求零幻觉，只能通过大量 abstain 来支付效用税。
- 提出 faithful uncertainty：要求语言层面的不确定性表达与模型“内在不确定性”一致，并给出行为语义（例如“我很确定”意味着重复提问答案稳定，“我不确定”意味着更可能自相矛盾）。作者将其归入 metacognition，并指出对 agent 系统而言，不确定性应成为触发检索/工具调用的控制层。
整体更像研究议程：把评测与训练目标从‘更少错误’部分转向‘更少自信错误 + 更忠实的不确定性表达’。
summary.experiments: 在给定全文片段中未出现新的系统实验与具体数字，更多是对既有现象的整合解释（如：truthfulness probes 泛化差、存在 confident hallucinations、训练模型“confess errors”仍无效、延长推理反而增加幻觉并降低 abstention 等）。如果全文后半部分包含形式化定义、指标或基准建议，建议核对其是否给出可操作的度量（例如把“自信度/hedging”映射到可计算的标注或自动指标），否则它更适合作为问题框架而非可复现方法。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 15–25 分钟）：
- 重点读引言中对 calibration vs discrimination 的区分，以及 Figure 1（若全文有）对“效用税”的示意，这是全文论证的支点。
- 找到对 faithful uncertainty 的可检验定义：作者如何把“内部不确定性”操作化（logprob、self-consistency、ensemble、temperature sweep 等）？如何评估语言层 hedging 是否忠实？
- 关注与 agent/tool-use 的连接段落：不确定性如何触发检索、何时停止、如何避免把 hedging 变成无信息的口头禅。
- 若你关心预训练接口，建议带着问题读：哪些训练信号能直接优化 discrimination（可能很难）？哪些信号能优化 faithful uncertainty（可能更可行）？

summary_en.core_problem: Even in the simplest setting—factoid QA with clear ground truth and no external tools—frontier LLMs still hallucinate. The paper argues that most progress has come from expanding the model’s knowledge boundary (encoding more facts) rather than improving boundary awareness (knowing when it doesn’t know). A central claim is that calibration (confidence matching accuracy) is not the same as discrimination (separating correct from incorrect on a per-instance basis), and limited discrimination induces a structural trade-off between eliminating hallucinations and preserving utility.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a framing/agenda paper rather than a new pretraining recipe, but it matters for foundation-model training goals: if a discrimination gap is intrinsic or at least stubborn, then pushing for “zero hallucinations” via stronger supervision, probes, or longer reasoning may simply shift the model toward abstention (a utility tax) or produce more confident errors. The alternative target is metacognition—especially faithful uncertainty—where the model’s expressed uncertainty aligns with its internal uncertainty, and uncertainty becomes a control signal for tool use in agentic systems.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The contribution is conceptual:
- Redefine hallucinations as confident errors, not all errors. Under this definition, trust and utility need not be mutually exclusive: the model can preserve usefulness while maintaining trust by communicating uncertainty honestly.
- Emphasize the discrimination gap: good calibration does not guarantee that confidence can sharply separate true from false answers at the instance level.
- Propose faithful uncertainty as a train/eval target: linguistic hedging should reflect intrinsic uncertainty, with behavioral semantics (e.g., “confident” implies answer stability under re-asking; “uncertain” implies higher chance of inconsistency).
- Extend metacognition to agent control: uncertainty should trigger retrieval/tool use rather than being treated as a purely communicative feature.
No new algorithm is clearly introduced in the provided content; it reads as a synthesis of empirical observations into a training/evaluation direction.
summary_en.experiments: No new quantitative experiments or headline numbers are visible in the provided excerpt. The paper references prior empirical findings: poor generalization of truthfulness probes, existence of confident hallucinations, limited impact of “confess errors” training, and observations that extended reasoning can increase hallucinations and worsen abstention. When reading the full text, check whether the authors propose concrete metrics/benchmarks for faithful uncertainty (operationalizing intrinsic uncertainty and measuring hedging informativeness), otherwise the value is mainly in the problem decomposition.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (15–25 minutes):
- Read the calibration vs discrimination argument carefully; it is the hinge for the claimed trade-off.
- Locate any formalization of faithful uncertainty: how intrinsic uncertainty is measured (log-prob, self-consistency, ensembles, perturbations) and how linguistic uncertainty is scored.
- Pay attention to the agent/tool-use section: what decision rules are suggested for triggering retrieval, and how to avoid degenerate “always hedge” behavior.
- If you care about pretrain–posttrain interfaces, read with the question: which objectives could plausibly improve discrimination (hard) vs improve faithful uncertainty alignment (more tractable).

recommendation.zh: 值得看 framing，不必期待新实验；它提醒 pretrain 不能只追 data coverage，还要度量知识边界可分性。
recommendation.en: Read it for the framing, not new experiments; it pushes factuality evaluation toward separability of the model’s knowledge boundary.

paper.title: The Cost of Consensus: Isolated Self-Correction Prevails Over Unguided Homogeneous Multi-Agent Debate
paper.abstract: Multi-agent debate, where teams of LLMs iteratively exchange rationales and vote on answers, is widely deployed under the assumption that peer review filters hallucinations. Yet the failure dynamics of homogeneous debate remain poorly understood, therefore we report findings from a controlled empirical study of teams of $N{=}10$ homogeneous agents (Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, Ministral-3-8B) across $R{=}3$ debate rounds on two high-difficulty benchmarks (GSM-Hard and MMLU-Hard). We compare peer de

summary.core_problem: 无引导的同质多智能体辩论范式是否比孤立自校正更能提升推理准确性，以及该范式的成本效益比是否符合预期。
summary.importance: 打破了多智能体辩论天然优于单智能体的普遍假设，明确了当前对齐方法带来的智能体间从众偏差的负面影响，为复合AI系统架构设计、对齐目标优化提供实证依据。
summary.technical_approach: 选取Qwen2.5-7B、Llama-3.1-8B、Ministral-3-8B三个开源模型，构建10个同构智能体的3轮辩论流程，在GSM-Hard、MMLU-Hard两个高难度基准上，对比辩论范式、孤立自校正、随机无关理由注入三种方案的准确率和token开销。
summary.experiments: 智能体最高从众率达85.5%，将团队共识率人工拉高至90.1%但实际准确率低于基线；存在最高32.3%的神谕 gap，即团队已生成正确答案但因从众被丢弃；辩论范式的token开销是孤立自校正的2.1~3.4倍，准确率无统计意义上的提升甚至更差。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读第4章的实验结果和成本量化部分，重点关注从众率、token开销的具体数值，预计阅读时间20分钟。
summary.authors_note: SensorLab

summary_en.core_problem: Whether unguided homogeneous multi-agent debate paradigm improves reasoning accuracy more than isolated self-correction, and whether the cost-benefit ratio of this paradigm meets expectations.
summary_en.importance: Challenges the common assumption that multi-agent debate is inherently better than single-agent reasoning, clarifies the negative impact of inter-agent sycophancy caused by current alignment methods, and provides empirical basis for composite AI system architecture design and alignment target optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: Three open-source models (Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, Ministral-3-8B) are selected to build a 3-round debate pipeline with 10 homogeneous agents. The accuracy and token cost of three schemes: debate paradigm, isolated self-correction, and irrelevant rationale injection are compared on two high-difficulty benchmarks GSM-Hard and MMLU-Hard.
summary_en.experiments: The maximum sycophancy rate of agents reaches 85.5%, which artificially raises team consensus rate to 90.1% but leads to lower actual accuracy than baseline. There is an oracle gap of up to 32.3%, meaning correct answers generated by the team are discarded due to conformity. The token cost of the debate paradigm is 2.1~3.4 times that of isolated self-correction, with no statistically significant accuracy improvement or even worse performance.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the experimental results and cost quantification part in Chapter 4, focus on specific values of sycophancy rate and token overhead. Estimated reading time is 20 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: SensorLab

recommendation.zh: 多智能体辩论的失效模式分析设置干净，建议看§3的失效路径拆解，可用于对齐阶段多智能体训练方案优化
recommendation.en: The failure mode analysis of multi-agent debate has clean setup, refer to §3 for path decomposition to optimize multi-agent alignment training schemes

paper.title: Geometry-Calibrated Conformal Abstention for Language Models
paper.abstract: When language models lack relevant knowledge for a given query, they frequently generate plausible responses that can be hallucinations, rather than admitting being agnostic about the answer. Retraining models to reward admitting ignorance can lead to overly conservative behaviors and poor generalization due to scarce evaluation benchmarks. We propose a post hoc framework, Conformal Abstention (CA), adapted from conformal prediction (CP) to determine whether to abstain from answering a query. CA

summary.core_problem: 为开放式语言模型回答设计可校准的拒答机制，在模型缺乏知识时决定是否回答，并给出有限样本保证。
summary.importance: 贡献是后验可靠性和幻觉控制方法，尝试把 conformal prediction 改造成开放生成场景下的 abstention 框架；它不改动预训练，但对评估模型知识边界有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Conformal Abstention，将 conformal prediction 的覆盖保证转化为参与概率和回答正确概率的保证；由于开放式生成中 non-conformity score 难以定义，方法改用 prediction confidence 做拒答决策，并引入基于模型内部表示几何的校准策略来估计知识介入程度。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体数据集、模型规模、baseline 和数值结果；核心实验应围绕拒答率、回答正确率、有限样本校准保证和表示几何校准的增益展开。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper designs a calibrated abstention mechanism for open-ended language model answers, deciding when a model should refuse to answer due to insufficient knowledge.
summary_en.importance: It contributes a post-hoc reliability and hallucination-control method, adapting conformal prediction to open-ended generation. It does not alter pretraining, but it is relevant for measuring model knowledge boundaries.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose Conformal Abstention, converting conformal-prediction-style guarantees into guarantees on participation probability and answer correctness. Because non-conformity scores are intractable for open-ended generation, the method uses prediction confidence for abstention and calibrates it with representation geometry inside the model.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report datasets, model sizes, baselines, or numeric results. The main evaluation is expected to examine abstention rate, answer correctness, finite-sample calibration, and gains from geometry-based calibration.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou).

recommendation.zh: 读问题设定和 guarantee 形式即可；若 confidence 来自生成后打分，结论对预训练知识边界只是弱探针。
recommendation.en: Read the setup and guarantee form; if confidence is post-generation scoring, it is only a weak probe of pretraining knowledge boundaries.

institutions: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)

paper.title: LLM Psychosis: A Theoretical and Diagnostic Framework for Reality-Boundary Failures in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: The deployment of large language models (LLMs) as interactive agents has exposed a category of behavioral failure that prevailing terminology, principally hallucination, fails to adequately characterize. This paper introduces LLM Psychosis as a structured theoretical framework for pathological breakdowns in model cognition that exhibit functional resemblance to clinically recognized psychotic disorders. Five hallmark features define the framework: reality-boundary dissolution, persistence of inj

summary.core_problem: 现有术语“幻觉”无法覆盖LLM作为交互Agent时的一类现实边界失效类行为故障。
summary.importance: 首次提出LLM Psychosis理论框架与诊断量表，属于原理分析贡献。
summary.technical_approach: 定义LLM Psychosis的5个核心特征，提出LLM认知完整性量表(LCIS)五轴诊断工具。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体实验验证数据。
summary.authors_note: 无公开知名机构与知名作者。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing terminology 'hallucination' cannot cover a category of reality-boundary failure behavioral faults of LLMs as interactive agents.
summary_en.importance: First proposed LLM Psychosis theoretical framework and diagnostic scale, belonging to mechanism analysis contribution.
summary_en.technical_approach: Define 5 core features of LLM Psychosis, propose 5-axis diagnostic instrument LLM Cognitive Integrity Scale (LCIS).
summary_en.experiments: No specific experimental verification data is disclosed in abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: No publicly well-known institutions or authors.

recommendation.zh: 提出的LLM故障分类框架对对齐阶段故障排查有参考，无需精读全文。
recommendation.en: The proposed LLM failure classification framework is useful for alignment fault diagnosis, no need to read full text.

paper.title: Benchmarking Complex Multimodal Document Processing Pipelines: A Unified Evaluation Framework for Enterprise AI
paper.abstract: Most enterprise document AI today is a pipeline. Parse, index, retrieve, generate. Each of those stages has been studied to death on its own -- what's still hard is evaluating the system as a whole.   We built EnterpriseDocBench to take a swing at it: parsing fidelity, indexing efficiency, retrieval relevance, and generation groundedness, all on the same corpus. The corpus is built from public, permissively licensed documents across six enterprise domains (five represented in the current pilot).

summary.core_problem: 解决企业文档 AI 管线难以端到端评估的问题，把解析、索引、检索和生成的质量放在同一框架中测量。
summary.importance: 贡献是 RAG/文档智能系统评测框架 EnterpriseDocBench，而不是模型训练方法。它的有用之处在于暴露管线各阶段指标之间的弱相关，以及生成幻觉并不简单随文档长度单调变化，这对做 RAG 评测和数据管线诊断有一定参考。
summary.technical_approach: 框架在一组公开、许可友好的企业文档上同时评估 parsing fidelity、indexing efficiency、retrieval relevance 和 generation groundedness。论文比较 BM25、dense embedding 和 hybrid retrieval 三种管线，并固定使用同一个 GPT-5 生成器，以减少生成端差异。
summary.experiments: 试验覆盖六个企业领域中的五个 pilot 领域。结果显示 hybrid retrieval 的 nDCG@5 为 0.92，略高于 BM25 的 0.91，dense embedding 为 0.83；短文档和超长文档幻觉率更高，分别为 28.1% 和 23.8%，中等长度文档为 9.2%；阶段间相关性很弱，parsing 到 retrieval 的 r=0.14，parsing 到 generation 的 r=0.17。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the lack of end-to-end evaluation for enterprise document AI pipelines that combine parsing, indexing, retrieval, and generation.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is EnterpriseDocBench, an evaluation framework for RAG-style document systems rather than a model-training method. Its useful signal is that stage-level metrics correlate weakly and hallucination does not vary monotonically with document length.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework evaluates parsing fidelity, indexing efficiency, retrieval relevance, and generation groundedness on a public, permissively licensed enterprise-document corpus. It compares BM25, dense embedding, and hybrid retrieval pipelines while using the same GPT-5 generator to control the generation stage.
summary_en.experiments: The pilot covers five of six enterprise domains. Hybrid retrieval reaches nDCG@5 of 0.92, slightly above BM25 at 0.91 and dense retrieval at 0.83. Hallucination is higher for short and very long documents, at 28.1% and 23.8%, compared with 9.2% for medium-length documents. Cross-stage correlations are weak, including parsing-to-retrieval r=0.14 and parsing-to-generation r=0.17.

recommendation.zh: 只看结果表和相关性分析即可；对预训练没帮助，但能提醒 RAG 评测别迷信单阶段指标。
recommendation.en: Read only the result table and correlation analysis; it is not pretraining work, but it warns against trusting single-stage RAG metrics.

paper.title: Prefill-Time Intervention for Mitigating Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in visual-textual understanding, yet their reliability is critically undermined by hallucinations, i.e., the generation of factually incorrect or inconsistent responses. While recent studies using steering vectors demonstrated promise in reducing hallucinations, a notable challenge remains: they inadvertently amplify the severity of residual hallucinations. We attribute this to their exclusive focus on the decoding stage, whe

summary.core_problem: LVLM 幻觉缓解里，为什么很多 decoding-time steering（DTI）虽然降低幻觉频率，却会让剩余幻觉更“严重”、更容易滚雪球；以及能否在不改参数的前提下，从源头阻断这种自回归误差累积。论文把关键矛盾定位在干预时机与对象：在 decoding 阶段持续加 steering，往往是在错误表征已经形成后被动补救，且对多模态对齐与细粒度视觉证据不够敏感。
summary.importance: 对预训练主线的相关性偏低到中等：它是推理期的可插拔干预方法，不涉及预训练目标/数据/优化。但它对“训练动态/表征”有一个可迁移的观点：KV cache 不是被动缓存，而是决定后续生成轨迹的初始状态；如果幻觉来自早期多模态表征偏置，那么在 prefill 阶段一次性把注意力的 key/value 分布拉回到更 grounded 的区域，可能比 decoding 阶段反复纠偏更稳定。这类思路也可能反哺到训练侧（例如把 cache-level 约束做成训练正则或蒸馏目标）。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 Prefill-Time Intervention (PTI)：只在 prefill 阶段干预一次，直接修改初始 KV cache，而不是在 decoding 阶段对 hidden state 持续加 steering。
设计原则对应 DTI 的三类问题：
- when：从 reactive decoding 改为 proactive prefill，一次性塑形初始状态，减少后续自回归误差累积。
- how：modality-aware，区分视觉与文本的敏感性，不用“只从文本态导出的统一 steering 向量”。
- what：从粗粒度 hidden state 转向细粒度 KV cache，直接作用于注意力机制；并利用 K（决定 attend 到哪里）与 V（决定聚合什么信息）的角色差异做解耦控制。
具体做法上，论文使用 object-vs-background 的对比来构造方向：用向量把 key 推向更 object-centric 的注意力分配，同时让 value 更像是过滤背景噪声后的表征，从而得到更 grounded 的初始 cache。之后正常解码，不再持续干预。论文还强调 PTI 与现有 DTI 正交，可叠加。
summary.experiments: 在三种架构不同的 LVLM 上验证：LLaVA-1.5、Qwen-VL-Chat、DeepSeek-VL-Chat；在“object hallucination”与更综合的基准上优于既有 decoding-time 方法，并声称能缓解“降低频率但加重残余幻觉”的两难。当前给出的全文片段未包含具体基准名称、指标定义与数值表，也未展示与 VISTA 等方法的逐项对比数字、以及 PTI+DTI 叠加的增益幅度；需要在实验章节核对。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：
- 先看引言与方法开头对“snowball hallucination”成因的拆解：为什么持续 decoding steering 可能放大残余错误。
- 重点看 PTI 如何从多模态 cache 导出方向，以及 K/V 解耦的实现细节（在哪些层做、是否对视觉 token 子序列单独处理、强度系数如何设）。
- 再看与 DTI 的可叠加实验：这部分决定它是否只是另一个 steering trick，还是更通用的干预点。
预计阅读时间：15–25 分钟理解方法；若要落地到推理栈，额外 30 分钟看实现与超参。

summary_en.core_problem: Decoding-time steering for hallucination mitigation in LVLMs often reduces hallucination frequency but worsens the severity of remaining errors via autoregressive “snowballing”. The paper asks whether a single, proactive intervention can prevent error accumulation at the source without changing model parameters.
summary_en.importance: Low-to-moderate relevance for pretraining-focused work: it is an inference-time, plug-and-play control method rather than a new pretraining recipe. The transferable insight is representation-centric: the prefill KV cache is an initial condition that shapes the entire generation trajectory. If hallucinations are seeded by early multimodal misalignment, intervening once at cache construction can be more stable than repeatedly correcting during decoding. This could inspire training-side objectives (e.g., cache-level regularization/distillation), though the paper itself stays at inference.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Prefill-Time Intervention (PTI): intervene only once during prefill by directly modifying the initial KV cache, instead of applying a uniform steering vector to hidden states throughout decoding.
It is designed around three axes:
- When: proactive prefill intervention to stop error accumulation before it starts.
- How: modality-aware steering, avoiding text-only, modality-agnostic directions.
- What: target fine-grained KV cache rather than coarse hidden states; exploit the functional split between keys (where to attend) and values (what content to aggregate).
Concretely, PTI derives steering directions using object-vs-background contrasts: steer keys toward object-grounded attention and steer values to suppress background noise, producing a better-grounded cache for subsequent normal decoding. PTI is claimed to be orthogonal to existing decoding-time methods and can be combined with them.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on three LVLMs with different architectures: LLaVA-1.5, Qwen-VL-Chat, and DeepSeek-VL-Chat. The paper reports improvements on object-hallucination and broader hallucination benchmarks, outperforming prior decoding-time interventions, and claims better control of residual hallucination severity. The provided excerpt does not include the exact benchmark names, metrics, or numeric tables, nor the magnitude of gains for PTI+DTI combinations; these need verification in the experiment section.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan:
- Read the motivation around “snowball hallucinations” and why continuous decoding-time steering can backfire.
- Focus on how PTI computes cache-level directions from multimodal signals and how K/V are modified (layers, token ranges, strength hyperparameters).
- Check the add-on experiments combining PTI with existing DTI methods; this determines whether PTI is a generally useful intervention point.
Time: ~15–25 minutes for the core idea; add ~30 minutes for implementation details if integrating into an inference stack.

recommendation.zh: 读 abstract 和方法图就够；有用信号是 hallucination 干预点应看 prefill KV，而不只看 decoding logits。
recommendation.en: Read the abstract and method figure; the useful signal is to inspect prefill KV states, not only decoding-time logits, when studying LVLM hallucination.

paper.title: Exploring Audio Hallucination in Egocentric Video Understanding
paper.abstract: Egocentric videos provide a distinctive setting in which sound serves as crucial cues to understand user activities and surroundings, particularly when visual information is unstable or occluded due to continuous camera movement. State-of-the-art large audio-visual language models (AV-LLMs) can generate multimodal descriptions. However, we show in this work that they are prone to audio hallucinations, often inferring sounds from visual cues that are visible but not heard. We present a systematic

summary.core_problem: 现有音视频语言模型在 egocentric video 中经常把可见物体或动作误当作真实声音来源，即输出由视觉先验驱动的 audio hallucination，而不是基于音频信号作答。
summary.importance: 这篇工作更像一个诊断型 benchmark，对预训练研究的启发在于揭示多模态模型的模态捷径：即使模型结构上接入了音频，训练目标和数据分布也可能让模型过度依赖视觉。对音频-视频-语言统一预训练来说，这不是简单的评测问题，而是训练信号质量问题。模型需要学习“看见某个事件”和“听见某个声音”之间的区别，否则在遮挡、运动模糊、第一视角噪声场景下会产生稳定偏差。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构建了一个面向第一视角视频的自动化评测流程。数据来自 Ego4D，选取 300 个视频片段，覆盖 50 类视觉场景，并按 10 秒非重叠片段切分音频。流程先用 Qwen2.5 Omni 生成初始声音描述，再结合 Ego4D 的时间对齐人工 narration，用 LLaMA3-70B 做两阶段整理。第一阶段是 Sound-Source Match，把声音分成 foreground sound 和 background sound。foreground sound 指佩戴者动作或物体交互直接产生的声音，例如使用搅拌机带来的机械声；background sound 指环境中存在、但不能直接由当前动作 narration 解释的声音，例如音乐、铃声。第二阶段生成 Q/A，包括 factual Q/A 和 hallucination Q/A。factual Q/A 查询真实存在的声音及其来源；hallucination Q/A 则询问场景中视觉上合理但音频中不存在的声音，标准答案明确要求模型回答该声音不存在。这样的设计能直接测量模型是在听音频，还是根据画面补全声音。
summary.experiments: 评测集包含 300 个 egocentric videos 和 1,000 个 sound-focused questions。论文报告当前 AV-LLMs 在该任务上表现较弱。例如 Qwen2.5 Omni 在 foreground sound 相关 Q/A 上准确率为 27.3%，在 background sound 相关 Q/A 上准确率为 39.5%。论文还观察到 VideoLLAMA2 在有音频和无音频输入时会生成非常相似的声音描述，说明模型输出很大程度受视觉上下文控制。结果表明，前景动作声并不一定更容易，因为模型容易把“可见动作”直接映射成“应当听到的声音”；背景声也困难，因为它常常缺少明确视觉来源。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20 分钟。重点看数据构造流程和 foreground/background taxonomy，而不是只看最终准确率。Methodology 中 Sound-Source Match 和 hallucination Q/A 的生成方式值得细看，因为它决定了 benchmark 是否真的能区分音频 grounding 和视觉补全。做多模态预训练时，可以把这篇作为 failure analysis 参考：检查训练数据中音频 caption 是否被视觉 caption 污染，检查 audio dropout 或 modality ablation 后模型输出是否变化，检查是否需要更强的音频存在性判别 loss。

summary_en.core_problem: Current audio-visual language models often infer sounds from visible objects or actions in egocentric videos, instead of grounding their answers in the actual audio signal.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a diagnostic benchmark, but it points to an important pretraining issue: multimodal models may learn a modality shortcut. Even when audio is available architecturally, the training data and objectives can make the model rely more on vision than on sound. For unified audio-video-language pretraining, the key distinction is between seeing an event and hearing a sound. Without that distinction, models will fail in first-person settings with motion, occlusion, and noisy acoustic context.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper builds an automatic evaluation pipeline for egocentric audio hallucination. It samples 300 clips from Ego4D across 50 visual scenarios and segments audio into non-overlapping 10-second clips. Qwen2.5 Omni first produces preliminary audio captions. These captions are then combined with time-aligned human narrations from Ego4D and processed by LLaMA3-70B in two stages. The first stage, Sound-Source Match, categorizes sounds into foreground and background events. Foreground sounds are directly caused by the camera wearer’s actions or object interactions, such as a mechanical sound from using a blender. Background sounds are ambient events that cannot be directly attributed to the narrated action, such as music or a bell. The second stage generates factual Q/A pairs and hallucination Q/A pairs. Factual questions ask about sounds that are present. Hallucination questions ask about plausible but absent sounds, with ground-truth answers explicitly stating that the sound is not present. This design measures whether a model listens to the audio or fills in sound from visual priors.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 300 egocentric videos and 1,000 sound-focused questions. Reported results show weak grounding in current AV-LLMs. Qwen2.5 Omni reaches 27.3% accuracy on foreground-sound questions and 39.5% on background-sound questions. The paper also notes that VideoLLAMA2 produces nearly identical sound descriptions with and without audio input, suggesting heavy reliance on visual context. The results indicate that foreground sounds are not necessarily easy: visible actions can trigger false auditory assumptions. Background sounds are also hard because they often lack a clear visual source.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 minutes. Focus on the dataset construction, the foreground/background taxonomy, and the hallucination Q/A generation protocol. The final accuracy numbers are less important than whether the benchmark cleanly separates audio grounding from visual completion. For multimodal pretraining, use it as a failure-analysis reference: check whether audio captions are contaminated by visual captions, whether model outputs change under audio dropout or modality ablation, and whether training needs a stronger loss for sound presence and absence.

recommendation.zh: Meta 揭示了多模态模型中典型的 'modality dominance' 导致的幻觉（视觉压倒听觉），对设计多模态预训练 loss 和对齐策略有警示作用。
recommendation.en: Meta reveals hallucinations caused by typical 'modality dominance' (vision overpowering audio) in multimodal models, serving as a warning for designing multimodal pre-training losses and alignment strategies.

paper.title: KARL: Mitigating Hallucinations in LLMs via Knowledge-Boundary-Aware Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Enabling large language models (LLMs) to appropriately abstain from answering questions beyond their knowledge is crucial for mitigating hallucinations. While existing reinforcement learning methods foster autonomous abstention, they often compromise answer accuracy because their static reward mechanisms, agnostic to models' knowledge boundaries, drive models toward excessive caution. In this work, we propose KARL, a novel framework that continuously aligns an LLM's abstention behavior with its

summary.core_problem: 在“可回答就回答、不可回答就拒答”的开放域事实问答里，用 RL 训练模型学会拒答往往会掉准确率：静态的三值/二值奖励会把策略推向过度保守，早期一旦进入“拒答陷阱”（abstention trap）就很难恢复。论文要解决的是：如何让拒答行为随模型当前的知识边界动态对齐，使模型只在真正超出知识边界时拒答，从而同时降低幻觉与保持（甚至提升）准确率。
summary.importance: 对 post-train（RLVR/GRPO 类）里“抑制幻觉但不牺牲能力”的目标有直接工程价值。贡献不在于提出新的 verifier 或外部知识，而在于把“知识边界”显式引入奖励设计与训练日程：用在线估计替代静态阈值，避免策略在早期被奖励结构锁死到拒答模式。对预训练研究的启发点主要是训练动态与目标函数形状：同样的模型与数据，奖励的时间变化与分阶段优化会决定能力是否被‘校准’还是被‘抹掉’。
summary.technical_approach:
KARL 有两块：
1) Knowledge-Boundary-Aware Reward (KAR)：对每个 query 做在线“知识边界”估计。实现上采用采样分组的 within-group 统计：对同一问题采样多次生成，按组观察是否出现正确答案（或可验证正确的信号），据此判断该问题是否处在模型当前可掌握区域。奖励不再是固定的三值（对/错/拒答），而是随估计结果动态调节：当估计显示模型‘有能力答对’时，强化正确作答并抑制不必要拒答；当估计显示模型‘大概率答不对’时，给“引导式拒答”更高回报，减少胡编。
2) Two-Stage RL Training：结构化地把“探索知识边界”和“校准拒答”解耦。
- 阶段一（knowledge boundary exploration）：用混合奖励更偏向最大化准确率，刻意绕开静态三值奖励导致的早期拒答激增，避免进入 abstention trap。
- 阶段二（abstention calibration）：在保留阶段一准确率收益的前提下，把持续性错误逐步转化为拒答行为（把‘不会但硬答’改成‘不会就拒答’），减少对已学会问题的副作用。
与 TruthRL/静态 ternary reward 的关键区别是：奖励强度与方向依赖于“该问题是否在当前知识边界内”的在线估计，并且通过分阶段训练避免早期策略坍塌到拒答。
